gi gi sheg gi /ribad stungs rna zla sa khusga rga ska sgos narga rganas// / /༄ 4 lu su / / /deb lnga pa/— ༷ste 15 tshesgo stordo stun4nag cha sa gnas da sa rgyus ga gnas dpyad ga 'a ༄ rgyu cha rtsom sgrig khang nas bskrun/

dkan ga4ོ ོ4ོ1 lha da jing tsho' 'a rgyus/ sngon 'gro dang po lha ri rdzong gi da lta'i rgya khyon rnam pa/ (3)/ba sngasdo tsho'i ༷ni/ 15 dro) pa:rdo:rdzo ཿdzasnonastana'u dang / bcangs 'a la ya ra ngan lha nga ra/don tshan dang po/ lha ri 'go/ (6)don tshan gnyis pa/ lha ri'i mi ser dang rtswa za ru bzhi 'am ru bdun byung tshul/ (9)1do/ 'u(bye :resditshor 1(1 rwa'i /sde/ /bye/ :gon na gsum pa/ lha 'a da na dgas dang brag skor/ (19)don tshan bzhi pa/ khral lus rta zam sa tshugs kyi skor/(26)don tshan lnga pa/ skye dngos dang gter kha'i skor/ (31)don tshan drug pa/ yul srol rgyan chas dang 'tsho ba spyod stangs dus chen sogs 'ga' zhig (33)le'u gnyis pa/ 'bri gung sbra ga'i lorghas/ thog mar dpon khungs 'bri bla'i lo rgyus lam tsam/ (44)dang po/ sbra gzhung gi dang po'i lo rgyus/ (46)gnyis pa/ sbra ga'i cha shas che ba hor ga bza' mi lo rgyus/1

(48)gsum pa/ sbra ga'i dpon rigs dang khra'/ 'ul sogs kyi skor/(52)bzhi pa/ skye dngos dang sa babs sogs/ (55)lnga pa/ yu/la srol goms gshis rgyan gos dus ston sogs kyi skor /(57)drug pa/ khral bzo dang grags yod mi sna'i skor/ (62)le'u gsum pa/ rdza 'bid (snga ra ming 'od sna )lo rgyus /gcig shog kha de'i 'go dpon rim byang / 96—)ri ri 4//gnyis/ skye dngos dang yul srol skor/ (67)le'u bzhi pa/ si rong (gseb rong )gi lo rgyus/gcig sa khyon dang sde dud 'go dpon khral rigs sogs/(69)gnyis/ thon khungs dang ri chu yul gom sogs/ (71)le'u lnga pa/ byang smi thi kha'i lo rgyus/gcig sa babs chags tshul dang gnam gshis sogs/(72)gnyis/ tsho khongs dang khral khrims dpon rigs sogs skor/(76)le'u drug pa/ snye bo'i lo rgyus/dang po/ sa nga la dang mi sde chags tshal chab dpal dar rgud 2 zir rir

sogs kyis skor/ (80)gnyis pa/ rang byung skye dngos dang ri chu yul ljongs sogs kyi skor/ (87)gsum pa/ gom gshis chas gos yul skad sogs kyi skor/(92)ོ ོ 4 ོ 'a nyu sag rdzang na dkad sag gsum gya yi rgyus/ 1 thog ma'i gnas tshul dbang sgyur skor/ (98)2 sa babs dang ri chu yul ljongs thon khungs sogs kyi skor/ (104)2 rdzong tsho'i 'go pa dang shog kha'i sgrig ming sogs kyi skor/ (107)4 khral khrims sogs kyi skor/ (115)5 ar 'ul sogs kyi skor/ (122)6 tshong las dang bun gtong dus ston sgyu rtsal gom gshis sogs kyi skor/ (125)7 dmag don dang phyi nang dgra gyod che rigs skor/ (131)〈 chos lugs dgon sde dang grags yod mi sna sogs kyi skor dang tshag tsig kha shas bcas/ (134) 3— — — — — ——/de

ོ ོ ོ 4ོ3 ra star rdzang ca kha sa ga 'a ras/〈pe/ / / 〈pe2 /༷phrodang po/ rgya ston spyi'i ba'i lo rgyus / (148)gnyis pa/ nang gses ban sgur bcas tsho ba'i 'o/ rgyas/ ༄ (156)1 ban dkar tsho ba nang gses dang po ming gi sko ra/(156)nang gses gnyis pa bla rabs dang dpon rabs skor/(157)nas gses gsum pa 'og sde dang khral khrims skor/ (163)nang gses bzhi pa rig gnas lag shes tshong las sogs kyi skor/ (167)2 shel sku lding zhabs sgur bzhi tsho ba/ (172)( 1)tsho ba'i chags stangs dang yul ming thogs lugs dpon rigs byung tshul sogs/ (172)( 2)khral rigs sgrub rgyug sogs kyi skor/ (176)( 2)phyi gyod dang nang gyod che rigs skor/ (182)(4)chos lugs dgon sde'i skor/ (184) (5)rgyas shod yul gyi ri chu yul ljongs sogs lam tsam bcas/(186)

ba min rkyang 'brong ri dwags zas la sgyu/(sngar smi thi la 'brong yod )ma tshang med pa'i thon khungs phun sum 'tshogs/tsa ri min yang tsa 'dra'i gnas mchog yod/tsha grang 'du ba sel ba'i sman rigs mang /dza dza ril ril byed pa'i pho gzhon dang /wa dmar grwa lo rgyas 'dra'i dman shar sogs/zhwa gos phyor chas gang dga'i spud byas te/gzab dus yul tshan so so'i dbyar ston rol/'a cag lha ri'i deng gi rnam pa ni/yar rgyal yar ngo'i zla la mtshungs dpe 'gran/rab btags rgyan ltar ma yin srong po'i gtam/lo rgyus byung nas bzung byas da lta'i bar/sha tsha dmangs la ches che gung khran tang /sa steng 'di ltag srid tang srid na dben/ha go 'di go med pa'i mi ma gtogs/e ma deng 'dir mi bsngags sa zhig mchis/

7 mi mi zhe 'i/ sngan zhegu dang sga/ ༈nasnang ga dalta rgyuston dang rnam sga/ :rdotherdzo :sku /de 25 1rdzo 'uste :ri11 stenalha nga (ca sa shan ) da ngas ba nga ra lha sa'i shar phyogs su gnas yod la nag chu sa khul rdzong khru'u bcu gcig gi nang nas lho phyogs kyi rdzong zhig yin/ sa gnas lte ba'i nag cha grong rdal gyi lho shar ngos su chags yod/ der sa khyon spyi li /dro/ 'jicedza btsa /re/ 25 rtog rtog/chen ri gru bzha ma bcu gsum lhag ma dang 'a ra nyas ga stang nyis brgya lhag tsam yod/ srid 'dzin khyab khongs shang khag bcu bzhi/ grong tsho brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa der thems grangs sam stong sam brgya sam bca so bzhi yod/ sa mtshams khyim mtshes ridang ribasgo ridang gi pa 7ni shar ngos dang byang shar rang khul gyi 'bri ru rdzong dang / chab mdo'i dpal 'bar rdzong bcas dang 'brel/ lho dang lho nub nas chab mdo'i spo bo dang nying khri'i rgya mda' rdzong dang 'brel/ nub ngos nas grong khyer lha sa'i mal gro gong dkar rdzong dang / 'phan lhun ra sgring dang 'brel/ byang phyogs nas rang khul gyi nag chu rdzong dang 'brel ba bcas yin/ da lta lha ri rdzong gi lte ba'i gnas sa ar rtsa mtsho mdzug la yod der rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre bzhi stong nyis brgya yin/rdzong khongs 'di rang nas byas na mtho dman snyom pa'i sar gnas 3

yod/ rdzong yongs kyi cha lhom sa mtho tshad ni spyi khre bzhi stong lnga brgya ‘ dzog zin/ 'di ga'i rdzong khongs kyi sa khamarme mtho shos byang smi thi kha yin pa der mtho tshad spyi khre lnga stong lhag zin yod pa dang / de la sa ldog pa'i kha dma' shos ni spo bo yul gyi cha las gyes pa'i snye bo lung pa de yin pa dang / der mtho tshad spyi khre sum stong lhag tsam las zin med byang gi dwangs ma dang / lho yi’〉 dwags ma gnyis ka da lta lha ri rdzong khongs su 'dus yod/ rdzong lte ba'i chags yul bcas la lo re'i drod tshad cha snyoms klung kor 'og gi ang grangs 1/de2yin/ lo mang ring kha char babs tshad la gzhigs na cha snyoms ho rmid lnga brgya nas bdun brgya'i bar yin/ dbyar dus su bod zla bzhi pa'i nang char pa 'bab 'go tshugs pa dang zla ba rapa'i mar ngos nas kha ba 'gyur ba dang / kha rlung grang ngar che ba rim bzhin dgun ri klung 'khyag pa'i khengs pa dang gangs dkar 'phying pas mal chas gyon pa ltar 'gyur gyi yod/ spyir rdzong yongs su 'brog khul gtso bo yin rung sa ma 'brog gam rong zhi yang cung yod pa ste snye bo drung yig shang la zhing kha mu'u 4695tsam yod/ der rdzong yongs la phyugs rigs kyi mgo grangs 21200 2'dug byang rong bar gsum gyi sa gshis ldan stabs rdzong khul 'dir ri skyel srog chag dang / rtsa che'i skye dngos phun sum 'tshogs tsam yod/ (ri chu yul ljongs kyi rnam pa zhib phra gsham gyi tsho shog so so'i lo rgyus las gsal yod ) bod ljongs bcings 'grol zin nas 1959bar lha ri rdzong de mdo smad mnga' khongs mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi khongs gtogs yin pa dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs nas lha ri rdzong de dang po kong po nying khri kron chas kyi 44/ la ri༅

khongs su yin pa dang de dus chus bzhi yod pa/ ca lis chus dang /thang sdes chus/ sangs pa chus/ ar rtsa chus bcas red/skabs der rmi thi kha ni nag chu kron chus kyi khongs shan gyi rim pa ldan pa'i dmigs bsal sa khul zhig yin pa dang / snye bo ni nying khri kron chus kyi zho ga shan khongs dang / sbra ga dang si rong ni lha sa hri'i me gro gong dkar shan gyi khongs su red/ 1964lo zla 6par lha ri rdzong de kong po nying khri kron chub/ nas nag chu kron chus kyi khongs su 'gyur ba dang phyogs mtshungs sngon gyi chus bzhi yi thog la/ snye bo chus dang sbra ga chus/ su rong chus/ smi thi yang chus kyi sgrig gzhi ru 'gyur yod pari de dang bcas lha ri rdzong zhabs la chus brgyad/'brog rwa tshud pa'i shang / 21yod lha ri rdzong gi gnas yul de thog mar sngar gyi lha ri'i grong pa'i nang yod pa dang de rjes lo rabs drug cu pa'i mjug tu 6 gab dong gting ring bru 7zhes pa'i dgongs don yin tshul gyis shug stag rong gi ltar ma zhes pa'i sa char 'dzugs skrun byas te shan de ru spos pa red/ 1984lo la hpha ran si rgyal khab kyi sa gshis ru khag gis brtag dpyad byas nas star ma'i rgyab ri mtsho yin te chu log gi nyen kha che ba yod lugs bstan rkyen/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i lo mjug la shan tshugs yul de ar rtsa mtsho mjug nya ri'i mdun du gtan 'khel byung nas star ma nas yar ar rtsa la gnas spos byas pa red/ sa chang der sa babs dang cha rkyen gang spyir lha rdzong rnying pa'i chags sa dang / bar pa ltar ma gnyis las legs pa yod/

—༄cu/ le'u dang po/ ngangos gzhi'i lo rgyus/bcings 'grol yar sngon gyi lha ri rdzong tsho'i skor/don tshan dang po/ lha ri 'go zhes pa'i sa gnas de dus rabs bcu drug pa'i skor naca/ bzung lo rgyuca thog mi shes mkhan med pa'i sa gnas ming chen zhig red/ de ni ching rgyal rabs sogs nang sa'i krung dbyang srid gzhung rim pa'i dpon rigs bod skyod lam bar gyi rta zam sa tshig gal mdud sa rdzong nyi shu rtsa lnga'i a ma zer ba'i gnas chen zhig yin pa ma zad/ ching rabs kyi bod bzhugs blon chen (am ban ) sbyar sgo che'i le lag dpon rigs rgyun sdod mang tsam byed pa dang / phog khang tshugs gnas yin khar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mngag gtong lha ri bla ma (rdzong dpon ) zhes pa'i gnas yul yang red/lha ri zhes pa ni 'di ga'i ri brag de 'phags pa'i gnas rten bcu drug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha yi ri zhig yin stabs lha yi ri zer ba'i ming chags pa red zer srol yod pa yin/ rje tsong kha ba chen po'i zhal slob khri steng mdzes pa'i bla chen bzhi yi sa gyal gu shri dpal ldan don grub kyis btabs pa'i bde chen gling dgon pa yang sa gnas der chags pas sa ming dgon la thogs nas lha ri dgon zhes ri bo dga' ldan pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon 'di'ang 6

'di gar mchis/lha ri 'go yi sa gnas 'di ni/ dbus dang dgas kong gis byang lha ri 'go zer ba dang / byang 'brog hor gyis lho lha ri 'go zer ba'i byang min rong min/ yus min 'brog min dbus min khams min zhig ste/ byang rong gnyis kyi sa mtshams/ khams bod gnyis kyi bar mtshams/ rgya bod bar gyi gzhung lam/ sa ri bong 'dra ba'i spor sna/ lam ko ru ris kyi mdud mdo la chags shing / yar gzhi'i mkhar med pa/ mar rmos kyi zhing med pa nyung la phug gnyis kyi son rtsa btabs/ rdo spo tho gnyis kyi khang pa brtsigs/ sa rdo gnyis la khral 'khri/ ston 'bras 'debs yul med pa/ phar btabs kyi 'bru la tshul yong yug po mi skye ba'i sa yin pa cha rkyenaskyo ba'i thad nas kha rgyun du 4 lho lha ri 'go skyid gda' zer mi de/ mi de la pha yul med le red/7 ces gleng srol yod phyogs gzhan zhig nas lha ri 'go der/ 'brog dbus khams gsum/ kong nyong spu gsum gyi tshong rigs 'gro 'ong mang ba'i tshong rdzas dngos po yod pa/ khral khrims kyi 'du 'god mang zhing sa phyogs gang spyi'i mi sna 'dzoms pa'i mthong thos kyi sgo yangs pa/'bru rigs dkon rung chang rag mi dkon par mi rnams glu sgrung mtshar rtsed la mos shing spro nyams kyi rnam pa ldan pa ma zad/ rta bzhon tshong pa nas dbyug khyer sprang po bar su yin na'ang gnas g.yar ram stabs bde sprod pa'i khyim sgo yangs shing ya rabs pa'i spyod tshul yang ldan pa yod/ lha ri grong pa'i khang pa phyi ltas spo khang yin pas nyam skyo mdog ltar yod rung / nang du phyin na gang ci'i spyod chas 'dzoms shing sdod bzo dod la gtsang sbra ldan pa de phyi nang 7

gab log pa yod/ 'on kyang de ni lha ri grong pa'i spyi'i rnam pa tsam yin pa las skabs de'i spyi tshogs yul dus kyi rkyen pas skyug bro'i rigs kyang rgya khyab du gnas pa dang 'tsho gos legs nyes mdzub rim ltar yod pa ni smos ci dgos/ lha rir man ching gong ma'i bod bzhugs blon chen aca/ ban gyi sbyar sgo che'i yan lag rgyun sdod bya gi yod pa'i skabs de dus sbun pa'i ge sar lha khang (rgya lha'i lha khang yang zer ) yod pa dang gtso lha gsum gyi mdun khros chen (mo rgyag sa ) khu ba'i yo chas kyang yod pa dang / lha khang gi sgo thog tu gser bris kyi rgya yig sgo byang yod pa red/ gong gsal am pa'i yan lag dpon rigs dang dmag mi phogs khang bcas rgyun sdod yod pa ma zad/ lha ri thon drung zhes sa gnas de ga'i mi sna skad sgyur dang drung yig gso skyong byed kyi yod pa dang gang spyi'i mi snar 'brel ba zab po yo da 'dug lha ri ni rgya bod bar gyi gzhung lam lte ba dang tshong 'grul 'drems lam song bas ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma g.yung kreng khri lo bco lnga nas man 'ju'i mtha' mjug gi shong thung khri lo gsum pa'i bar krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab bod bzhugs blon chen bdun bcu don brgyad snga rting gis bod la phebs yod pa ha lam tshang ma si khron rgyud nas bod skyod gnang stabs lha ri 'go 'di ga nas byon yod pa dang / bod kyi snga phyi'i nang zing ngam phyi nas btsan 'dzul sogs la bde 'jags btang chod ching gong ma'i srid gzhung nas dpung chen rim pa ltar chags bod skyod byas myong ba de tsho'i mang shos kyang 'di ga nas skyod yod pa dang / de bzhin dpon rigs min pa'i mdo yi rgya tshong yang zam mi chad par 'grul bzhud lam 'khel yong ba bcas mdor na lha ri 'go nas nang 8

sa'i rgya rigs dpon dmag tshong dmangs su thad la de skabs kyi 'gro 'u gas bzhin dpon dmag la skyel sgrol sgrig zhu/ tshong dmangs la rtal gtong gnas g.yar sogs tshul bzhin byung ba las gra ma 'grig dang 'gal 'khrug sogs byung ba'i lo rgyus lha ri 'go la med/ de ni mes rgyal phyi 'du shes dang 'brel 'gris zab pa'i mi rigs mthun sgril gyi nang rtags phyi la mtshon pa mngon/ lha ri 'go de bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung deb nang phyogs mtha'i rdzong gzhis gral nas dwags kong khul gyi rdzong gzhis bcu gsum gyi khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin 'dug ( de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi 7bod kyi lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam sgrigs 'don thengs 12nang gsal )don tshan gnyis pa/ lha ri'i mi sen dang / rtswa za ru bzhi 'am ru bdun byung tshul/ nang gses 1lha ri'i mi ser ni dang thog nag shod nas gyes pa'i dud kha shas kyi gzhi byas 'phel rgyas gang mtshams phyin nas lha ri grong pa chag pa dang de rjes slar yang nag shod dang /rgyas shod/ lho rta sho gsum bcas kyi sde 'khyal rim 'phel byung nas lha rir lte ba'i yul grong chags pa ma zad/ rim pa'i dgon sde byung khar sa babs kyis rkyen pa'i rta zam sa tshigs kyi 'du 'gag gcig tu 'gyur ba dang / lugs gnyis byed so'i gnas yul chags par rten mi sde de dag kyang de ga'i lte ba'i khral khrims sgrub rgyug zhu mkhan ru 'gyur nas lha ri'i gzhung rgyug mi ser zer ba red 'dugagong gsal ni 'gres rabs tsho'i ngag rgyun red/ deng kha shas kyi lta tshal byas na/ nag shod nas byung ba'i dud de 'dra ma ri rdo༅ //)/

byung gi sngon du/ yul 'dir rbad de sa stong las mi sde gtan nas chags med pa zhig ma yin snyam4 4 sgrub byed ni shug stag rgyud du mkhar rdzong rnying shul mthos chos yod pa ma zad/ sngar gtam mkhar zhing gi ming dang lo rgyus thar thor yang gleng rgyun yod khar/rgya za skor jo phebs lam gyi shing rta 'dren shul zer ba'i mis bzos gna' lam shul dum mthong rgyu yod pa'i ma tshad rab byang bcu pa'i nang lha dgon rgyag skrun skabs sa 'og nas lha sku the( pa bcas la dpag na sngar snga mo nas 'di yul du mi sde yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dug yang lha ri'i sde ni chos lugs dang nag shod 'brel ba'i skor bcas gang narnga4 dpyad na/ yon rgyal rabs kyi dus mjug tu byang ba'i che ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi bka' chems mthong ba don non 7nang 'khod 'bri phag 'khrug 'dom skor nas ‘‘'bri gung pa'i byang bod kyi dmag nyang dwags dang bcas pa bsdus nas ’ zer ba dang yang 6 nag shod pa'i mi dpon rin chen 'od sgom pa'i snying mi yin pas kho yong dgos zer ba yang sna se ri rong du gtong ba'i rang re'i thel rtse btang ba zer ba bcas tshig dum de tsho dang snga gong gang spyir gzhigs na/ de dus 'di khul bod nang sa'i rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i byang 'brog gi sde zhig yin tshod 'dra zer mkhan 'dug pas/ dpyad par mdzad 'os/spu rgyal btsan po srong btsan gyi skabs su/ 'di yul ni sum pa'i ru stong khyab brgya ldan nam nag shod stong bu chung gi gras sam der gtogs zhig e yin snyams de ni nag shod dang rgya shod stag pa tsha pa dang sa 'dres yin pas red/nang gses 2sngo za ru bzhi zhes pa'i sdes khog dang thang sdod 10

thang mag sangs pa/ tsheng pa bcas shog tsho bzhi yod pa yin/de tsho ni lha rir gtan sdod mi ser nyung zhing sa khyon chen po yod stabs/ nag shod tsho drug dang / nag bur sen gsum gyi khral khungs nas yin pa'i sde dud sum brgya skor gong gsal sa yul rnam su krig bcar gyis rtswa rin sprad nas lha khongs su gtan sdod byas pa'i rtswa za zer ba'i ming thogs pa yin 'dugagong gsal rtswa za zer ba'i sde dud de tsho me 'brug lo — — 1916lo'i gong du thems khongs nag tsho'i tsho shog gang yin so sor gtogs pa dang / de tshul chad lha ri'i mi ser ji bzhin lha rdzong khongs dngos bzhir 'gyur ba yin 'dug( 1) rtswa za ru bzhi'i nang gi sde khog ni sde chen po chags spyo ga /(1 rwate/ /chen /re/ /spros /bye( /// /spro/ 1jo sakhudi sdogang pa ga 75nga nga rgya ba ga da pa sa ga zase ba yin tshul gleng rgyun yod 'di'i shar ngos su dzum tsho ba dang sa mtshams lcags la zer ba yod pa'i la 'di rgyud nas rgya ston khams la skyod pa'i sa tshigs yin la 'bri ru rgyud hor tsho la skyod pa'e gzhung lam yang 'khel ba yin/ bar skabs lha ri la ca lis zer ba'i ming zhig chags 'dug la 'di yang la 'di dag gi ming las 'phros pa yin tshod zer mkhan 'dug sde khog gi sa dbyibs ni pad ma 'dab brgyad dang mtshungs la gnam yang 'khor lo rtse brgyad ltar yod zer/ sdes phu la rin chen sna lnga'i ri bo yod par grag shing de'ang g.yug shel gyi ri bo/ lcags la lcags kyi ri bo/ gung ser gser gyi ri bo/ rong la rong gi ri bo/ lung dmar zangs kyi ri bo/ ko lung ko ro sa'i ri bo bcas yin zer srol mchis/ gzhan yang gdod ma'i gzhi bdag brtsi ba'i ri bo ni/ lung dmar stag rtse 11

btsan rgod stag rtse/ lhun 'brub stag rtse bcas stag rtse rnam gsum dang / sdoms chung brag nag sogs yul ri brjid rngam can du mas skor yod khyon yongs su sa lhad chung zhing spangs ljongs ne'u seng khor yug tu gdal zhing / sdong thung gi shing rigs kyang yod pa bcas yin/ sngar khyung po dpal rgyal zer bas rgan sa bdam skabs ko chen lung tshan bco brgyad de rgya chen po yod pa'i che bshad byas te/rgod thang dkar gyi gshog thag chad sa/ spyang dar mas nyin skor mi phog sa yin zer skad 'dug de lta bu'i sa cha sa sde dud chags snga ba ni kha bru ya gsum yin gleng srol (kha yangs dang bru ya nge gsum )de nas khyung po dang / sngags ru/ sprel/ nag rgyud/ dmar rtsa/ a ti/ snyi ba/ nang chen/ mgar ra/ rda tsha/ gab/ha la/ rdza mkhan/ a khog thod pa/ lha rje/ nag chung /rtses tsha/ rdor shul/ gdong rgyud sogs kyi rus rgyud yin pa'i sde dus chags yod pa red 1959lor dud grangs 67yod 'dug ( 2 ) rtswa za ru bzhi'i nang gi thang sdod dang / thung dmag zhes pa ni ching rgyal rabs skabs lha rir bca' sdod sbyar sgo che'i le lag gam phogs khang gi dgos mkho'i skad sgyur thung si dang dmag mi gso skyong thon sa'i sde yin stabs ming de byung ba red zer — rgyu yod/ thang sdod ni mdo dbus bar gyi gzhung lam chen mo yin zhing nub kong la'i bcad pas rngod a la skya gang gi sde dang sa mtshams thug yod/ khams bodwa gnyis kyi bar mtshams zer don yang nub kong la 'di yis yar skyed mar skyed red zer srol 'dugs 'di yang spang dang / na thang shing rigs kyi mthun rkyen 'brog sa yag po yod/ sde dud kyi rus ming yang / khyung rgyud dang thod 12

pa/ dmar rtsa/ yon ru/ nag ru/ pa la/ ce bo/ gtsang rtsa/ hor dkar/ ha la/ ar lcags/ zho 'bi sogs yod 1959lor thang stod la dud grangs 42dang thung dmag la dud grangs 27yod/( 2) rtswa za ru bzhi'i nang gi sangs pa ni lha ri nas byang ngos smi thi rgyud dam nub mel gzhung rgyud du skyod sa'i sa lam 'khel yul dang / 'bri rgan la rgyud sangs gzhungs gang bo ni bar khams kyi phyogs 'grul ltos chen 'gro sa'i lam rgyud yin/'dir sa dbyibs ni rgya che zhing phu la gangs ri dang / bar la spang ljongs/ 'dab la sdong thung shing rigs sna tshogs/ phu chu rnams sangs chen sum mdo nas sangs che chung gi chu lag mdo sgril nas thung dmag rgyud/ lha ri'i 'phring nas sdes khog gi chu dang mdo phom ste o sog rong rgyud nas 'bab pa yin/ sangs chen su mdo'i mdun ngos ra sa lha rgod zheng pa'i ri de yul lha drag rtsal can brtsi nas yul mis bsang gsol byed pa red/ (gzhi bdag de nag shod nag lha 'dzam pa'i tshong dpon red ces gleng srol yod )gzhan yang ri dbyibs khyad mtshar can dang gleng rgyun yod pa ni/ gu yer lung pa'i g.yas ri'i rtse la brag mi gzugs hor chas byas 'dra 'ga' zhig yod pa de hor gling 'khrug skabs hor gyis gling 'brug mo btsan 'phrog byas rjes gsal shing rtser skyon skabs srung bya byed mkhan hor shan pa gtsos ba dur 'ga' yi 'dra gzugs yin zer srol yod pa ma zad/ g.yon ri'i rtse la gling gi ra mda' dpa' rgya tsha gtsos dpa' thul 'ga' yi 'dra brnyan yin zer khrab rmog ral gri chib rta dang ldan pa lta bu ya mtshan pa'i gzugs brag yod la/ da dung 13

brag ri'i rgyab phyogs rtse mo la 'tsho zhig kyang yod pa der sngar mtsho mjal mang po mthong pa'i shod srol yod pa bcas yin/sangs che chung gi sde dud kyi rus ming ni/ sde ru dang / ya nge/ a stag ma ni/ ring / zon rgyud/ lkug pa/ spus tsha/rta sga/ bhe tsha/ rke/ lto bo/ ar rtsa/ lha rje/ gnyen mo/ngor ra/ ya bo/ pa la/ rta tsha sogs yin 1959lo thems grangs 75yod/( 4) rtswa za ru bzhi'i nang gi tsheng pa ni/ lha ri'i lho nub — kyi lung pa chen po zhig yin la/ 'dir lung stod ni tsheng pa zer ba dang / bar sked ni ar rtsa zer smad ni shus rtag rong yin/ 'di rgyud nas ar rtsa bhan rda la rgyud gzhung lam chen mo de yin/ phying pa'i sa yi brag rdos nang 'brong gzhi sogs nyang po u nang dang 'dres/ phu shan chu o rong ni sbra ga dang 'dres/ gyen la sogs ni kong po brag gsum dang 'dres/ phrod la ni nyang po'i sa dang 'dres yod/sa dbyibs dang / ri chu ni shar phyogs brag ri'i ngos la yi ge a yi dbyeb yod par brten sa ming du a ta rong zhes pa yin rung phyis sgra zur chag nas ar rtsa zhes pa 'gyur ba red zer gsol yod/brag ri'i rtse la ar dgon gsang sngags chos gling zhes pa chags yod/tsheng pa'i sa char 'ja' sne g.yu mtsho zhes pa (ar rtsa mtsho ) yod/'dir sgrung gtam lta bu shod srol yod pa ste sngon thog ma'i dus su mtsho min pa 'brog thang yin pa der 'ba' tshang dang / 'bo tshang zer ba'i rgyu nor che tsam ldan pa'i khyim dud gnyis yod pa dang /'bo tshang la rta dkar po zhig yod pa des nyin zhig thang dkyil nas 14

chu thung ba mi tshos mthong bas ya mtshan nas ltas par der chu mig zangs dkar gyi kha rtsam zhig rdol 'dug par btsog pa mi 'gro ba'i ched du kha bkab nas bzhag 'ba' tshang nas de shes pa'i 'bri brgya'i phrag gtar nas blug pas phog thug ma byung / yang 'bri brgya'i 'o ma blug pas chu yig de kha lud de mtsho chen du 'gyur nas 'ba' tshang mtsho nang du nub/ 'bo tshang gis khal bkal nas ru ba spos par sbra khal mtsho nang du shor nas song /de rjes sbra bkal ba'i khal ro de kong po brag gsum 'tsho nang nas thon pa'i sbra de mtsho srung dgon pa'i lha khang nang yod pa dang khal de bshas nas srob rgyang ste 'gon khang du yod pa red a rtsa mtsho dang kong po brag gsum mtsho gnyis sna sbrel gyi mtsho gting med red kyang zer gsol yod/nyi ma ri rtse nas mtshor 'phros skabs mtsho nang du 'ba' tshang gi sbra yi dar lcog mthong rgyu yod pa dang / de min skabs 'gar rta nor lug sogs mthong rgyu yod pa'i bshad srol yod pa yin/ 'bo tshang de tsheng gzhung rgyud 'bri gung sbra ga'i sde sde khongs su phyin nas sdad par sbra gar 'bo zhes pa'i rus rgyud 'di red ces gleng /yang o rgyan pad mas bod yul zhabs bcag skabs mtsho 'di byin gyis brlabs nas mtsho sman rgyal mo dang / sman mo mched gsum 'khor la bsdoms pa'i bka' srung mgon po bcas la bka' gnyer gtad nas mtsho 'go'i mi rgod ngar la zhag gcig bzhugs skabs mi rgod gzugs kyis cho 'phrul btang bar mi rgod slob dpon gyi ting 'dzin dgongs pas brtul nas mtsho der phyag rjes bzhag pa'i shod srol yod/ sa der deng sang yang mi rgod la zhes zer/ brag rdol 15—

lung pa zer ba— der sngar gling ge gsar rgyal pos bdud 6/ khyung 'ded skabs la kha dmar gyis thog nas mda' 'phangs bas brag rdol gyi brag la phog pas brag zang thal du 'phug pa'i mda' rjes gsal po yod pa 'di yin zhes gleng srol yod pa ma zad brag 'di rgya khyon shin tu che zhing 'bri gung gter sgrom mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog gi sgo srung phyi ma yin pa gter sgrom gnas kyi dkar chag nang gsal/ yang gu ru padmas kong rje mched gsum brtul rjes brag rdol la phebs skabs sna tshogs rgyal po tshangs pa 'brug bzhon can gyis mtho 'tsham pa'i skabs su dam la btag nas yul lha brag rdol zhes mtshan gsol ba'i lo rgyus 'dug 'di'i brag gseb tu ngo mtshar ba'i brag phug mang po yod pa ste/ tshang pa'i pho brang zer ba dang rnam gsal pho brang zer ba bcas yod pa rnam sras pho brang tu rnam sras rta brgyad rang byon yod/ sngags pa'i pho brang la sngags pa'i phyag tu khro phur bsnams 'dra dang / gtor zor brgyab pa'i rtags dmar chen zer ba'i ri dmar gtor zor mgo mjug log 'dra zhig kyang yod/ sngon 'bru lha mkhan chen zla bzang gis tshangs pa'i pho brang nas zang dkar zhig gter du bzhes pa de 'bru lha ri khrod du yod/ 'di'i shar gyi sgo srung dbu ma stag gdong phra mo zer ba yod pa bcas yin/ 'di ga'i yul sde'i mi tshang gi rus ming ni/lto bo dang / ar rgod/ gor rgya/ 'brong tsha/ a 'go smar kham/ rag shi/ mgar yo/ gtsang pa/ rdza mkhan/ sho ra sogs yod pa dang / 1959lor tsheng pa shog la dud grangs 118yod/nang sras 2 ar rtsa dang / shug stag yar rtsi'i sa 16

dbyibs ni tsheng pa dang / 'dres pa'i gong du gsal ltar la ste dud bco lnga skor yod pa dang / ar dgon gsang sngags chos gling sde dgon sdom pa'i lha ri ru bdun zhes pa'i ru gcig yin/ lha ri ru bdun gyi ru gcig ste shug stag rdzis dgon ni chags snga ba'i mi sde zhi yin 'dugashug stag rong ni ar rtsa'i shar ngos lung smad rong rgyud la chags shing stag rtse yar khug la brag stag mo nyal ba'i dbyibs lta bu dang / lha shing shug pa'i stong po gzhan dang ma 'dra ba skyes yod stabs shug stag zer ba dang / sa rong dog pa'i shug stag rong zhes ming chags 'dug nyin g.yam pa thang srib snar chung mda' nas g.yas ga ring bar snye bo dang 'brel zhing / g.yon ca lis 'phrang sngo mo nas/ o rong mdo 'dus bar sa dbyibs rong rong (1) :rdordo /sdus the:tho ste:/ :re/ :the//bye(rkyang na/ chu ma 'dus nas ga nga lha chu dang — 'dres nas snye bo rong rgyud nas 'bab pa'i chu bo 'di spu bo yid 'ong gtsang po'i chu 'go yin la de nas mjug yar klung gtsang por 'dres pa yin/ ri bo g.yangs gzar che rung nyin ri'i sked rgyud brag shug spang dang / 'dres pa/ rtsir rdza ri yin/ srib ni shing nag stug pos khengs/ 'dzam ri zer sar shir tsan dan gyi stong po yin zer ba zhig yod pa dang / thang la 'dzam lha rigs lnga rang byon yin zer ba yod la/ bya khyung chos rgyal rir yig brgya rang byon 'og ma ri la slob dpon 'dzam gling zhes pa'i gter cha dang rdo la zhabs rjes bcas yod/ srib ri 'bri nang gi mu nazlo jo bo zer ba dang /mtsho la mu nam dung mtsho zhes pa yod/ lhag par phyag rgya jo bo shel dkar mdung rtse zhes pa'i gangs dkar gnam la thug 'dra ltas pa'i 17

spyi bo'i zhwa yang lhung dgos pa zhig yod pa'i ri 'di ha cang mthon po yin ba ni dbus nas bltas dus lug gu tsam/ gtsang nas ltas dus byis chung tsam/ dwags nas bltas dus sgam chung tsam mthong ba yin zer de bzhin dbyar khyim jo bo gangs ri dang mdun du nor gyi bla mtsho zhes pa'i ri mtsho mthong na nyams dga' ba zhig kyang mchis/ dmar rgyang lung pa zer ba'i nang du gna' snga mor bzos pa'i rdo yi 'gro lam dum bu sdad pa mthong rgyu yod/ de'i bshad srol ni srong btsan gyi skabs rgya bza' kong jo bod la phebs mtshams jo bo shākya mu ne gdan 'dren gyi shing rta 'dren lam gyad kyis 'dud shul red zer rgyun 'dug pa bden min gang ltar lam 'dir ga dus byung ba zhib 'jug cig byas na lo rgyus la phan thog yod pa snyams/yul 'dir thog ma'i shod srol la/ rdzong la chags snga ba ya phug nag rdzong / sde la chags snga ba gnam la rgya grong / zhing la chag snga ba srib rgyud ring mo bcas yin zer/ 'dir yul lha'i bu dang /gnam lha'i bu/ gnas mo srid thar lha mtsho zer ba ming can byung rabs ngag rgyun 'jags yod pa red/ star ma brgya grong zer ba yang byung tshul gleng rgyu 'dun pa ma zad/ 'brog sde la chags snga ba 'bri nang g.yas ru 'khyil ba zer ba'i 'brog dud chags pa yin rabs 'dug gong gsal ya phug nag rdzong dang star ma brgya grong rnams yul dus 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs rgyud phyis ru ma tsam las lhag med stabs bshad srol sdad pa dang mkhar shul lus pa tsam yin 'dug dus phyis shug stag rdzis pa zer ma yod pa/ de 'ga' zhig sngar dud kyi ru ma yin tshod kyang ma nyung tsam gsar chag yin bzo 'dug de yang 'bri nang 'brog pa nas byung ba'i rag pa zer ba 18

shug stag smad la spos pa de'i rgyud mang 'phel byung tshul dang de bzhin khyung po'i mi khyams gzhis chags sogs byung nas de tshos dgon pa'i phyugs zog kyi she ma byas te shug stag rdzis pa zer ba red/shug stag stag rtse dgon pa de sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i beeḍūr ser po las gsal 'dug pa'i dwags kong gi dgon pa'i gras shig yin 'dug dgon 'di btabs skabs star ma brgyaḥgrong de tsam ma 'thor ba'i sgang yin tshod snyam/ shug stag rdzis pa'i dud grangs ni 1959lo khyim dud 60tsam yod pa bcas yin/don tshan gsum pa/ lha ni'i dpon rigs spyi dang bye brag gi skor/sngar lha rir ching gong ma'i krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bod bzhugs am ba'i sbyar che'i yan lag dpon rigs rgyun sdod skabs mang byas pa dang / gtan sdod phogs dpon yod pa/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lha ri dgon tshan khag dang gzhung rgyug mi ser bcas kyi 'go 'dom lha ri blam zhes pa zhig btang gi yod pa bcas ni lha ri'i spyi'i dpon po red/ sa gnas de ga'i yul dpon mtho shos ni thon drung zer ba dang / thon drung ni de ga'i rgya dpon tshos gso skyong byas pa'i rgya skad shes cing thung si dang drung yig byed thub la 'jon thang nges can yod pa zhig yin 'dug 'di la bod bzhugs blon chen am ban gyis sprad pa'i go thob mgo tog rta dom sogs man ju/ri dpon rigs spyi mtshungs rim pa nges can zhig gi thob thang yod tshod 'dug lha ri'i thon drung dang po/ a dar bu tshe rgyal/(dang po red zer srol 'dug) la mu men gyi tog dang rma bya'i sgro mdangs kyi bya phod/ tham ga gru bzhi/ gos chen chu ba/ rta la brang dom bcas yod khar mdzod gos ser po'i thog bris pa'i bka' 19

gtan rgya yig can lho lha ri'i rta zam spyi khyab zer ba'i las gnas yod pa red zer/ de rjes thon drung a dar tshe rgyal gyi bu dang de nas yang a sru stobs rgyal zhes pa byang ba/ de tsho la 'ang tog dom yod 'dug de rjes thon drung rnarmo rgyal zer ba dang / thon drung tshe dbang zer ba/ thon drung sngon po zer ba sogs byung yod pa red/ da dung rjes sor thon drung kha shas byang yod pa de skabs gong nas dbang spyar mkhan 'gyar ljog byang thos lha rir thon drang skos pa 'i go gnazlo kyang rmepho ra skor byunge ba༄ red/ / ༄ yang sngar lha ri dgon pa'i bka' 'gyur bka' rgan ma zer ba de dgon 'dir nyar rgyu'i don la thon drung zhig rgya nag la phyin nas gong mar snyan sgron zhus par don dag 'grub nas lha ri dgon de ca' lis nang la yin stabs bka' 'gyur nyar 'thus zhes pa'i bka' thob par brten lha ri la ca' lis zer ba'i ming de de dus byung ba dang / bka' 'gyur bka' rgan ma lha ri'i nang rten byed rgyu byung ba red ces gleng srol yod/ 'di skabs 'brel yod tsho ba'i bar gyi kha mchu sogs kyang lha rir sbyar sgo che'i mdun zhu gtug gyod gtam byed kyi yod 'dug pa dper na/ sngar bu rdzum chis phu dang rtsa za'i sangs ba'i sde 'ga' zhig mgo 'og jag pas 'ded bcoms 'khel bar ra mda' rjes gcod kyis nag chu'i dkar gzhung nas rjes zin te shor nor tshur lon gyis rgyal kha thob nas tshur lam khri ba ru ba'i rtsa bkag thog babs rkyen 'dzing rtsod thug nas nag chu'i khri ru ba'i mi bsad smas byung ba'i don rkyen lhag pa'i kha mchu de lha ri mgo sbyar sgo che'i mdun du nag chu mkhan nang gi sku tshab 'byor nas 'grig 'doms bzos pa'i gnas tshul lo rgyus shod rgyu yod pa dang /20

yang sngar sen tsha ba ba lding dpon zer ba kha mchu'i don du lha rir sbyar sgo che'i sar bcar ba dang / dpon gnas ma thob pas sen tshar ma log par sdes khog la gzhis 'jags gnas sdod byas pa'i che/ /bo :reshāste/ :do(1) stu:rdo /rdordo zusgos ga ba ba rgyud 'a na ༄la da rgyu da/ yang sngar bu rdzum dang nag rog tsho ba gnyis zlos gyar byung nas bu rdzum dpon rabs gyen 'ded kyi lnga pa padma rin chen dang nag rog gung pa blon rtse(1sno)( (cherdotshorag /rdo//chen/bye( /// 311 ste// dus lha 'a sbyar mdun da gtam rabs rgyus nga rgyu yod pa bcas red/me phag 1911lo ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma'i srid gzhung mgo rting log pa'i dus skabs nang tā la'i bcu gsum pa'i skabs bod nas btsan nye kha bral pas am ban dang lus cun dmag phyir 'bud byas pa dang sa gnas srid gzhung gis mdo spyi bka' blon byam pa bstan dar dang / hor spyi mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal/hor nag rta spyi mkhan chung 'jam dbyang blo 'phel bcas snga rting gis bskos btang byung nas sa srid kyi bka' 'brel dbang sgyur khyab khongs sam rta zam sa tshigs bskyar bsgrigs khral 'ul gtan phabs sogs byas te me 'brug ( 1916) zhib gzhung dang 'dra drug gan rgya zer ba thon pa red/ de'i nang chu glang nas che lha ri'i rtsa za rnams tā la'i mgo snga bzhes gnang ba'i nag tsho dang kha bral phazhes gsal yod pa dus de nas bzung rtswa za ru bzhi de lha ri'i dngos bzhi'i sde ru 'gyur ba yin 'dug lcags phag 1911lo nas lcags yos 1951zhi ba'i bcings 'grol zin pa'i bar lo bzhi bcu tham pa'i ring lha ri'i dbang sgyur 'go dpon ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis btang ba'i lha ri'i rdzong dpon rkyang pa yin/21

de'ang gong du gsal ba'i dang po dgon gsum mkhan po'i ming thog nas lha ri blam zer ba mngag gtong byung ba de dgon sde khag gsum tsam gyi bla dpon byas pa nas chu glang lo snga rjes nas bzung lha ri ru bdun spyi'i 'go 'doms dpon po yin pa ma zad snye bo zam thang rdzong yang 'dir 'du dgos pa yin pa'i lha ri'i rdzong dpon dngos byung ba red/ de'i mi 'gro yang dang po rtse rnam rgyal gra tshang nas gtong dgos pa de 'di nas bzung rtse yig tshang las khungs nas gzhung zhan rtse drung re gtong srol byung bar 'gyur 'dugalha ri blam zhes pa dgon gsum mkhan po'i skabs chos lugs kyi byed sgo spel ba dang gson gshin gyi dang 'bul zhu sa yin /'di skabs kyi lha ri blam (go tshod tsam byas na ) ni thub bstan nam mkha' dang / byam pa bstan 'dzin/ thub bstan skal ldan sogs byung yod/ de rjes rdzong dpon du 'gyur ba'i lha ri blam ni/rtse drung bstan pa dar rgyaru/ dang / 'jigs bral lags/ ram yangs lags/ dpar khang rgyal mtshan phun tshogs/ blo bzang tshul khrims/ rtse mgron thub bstan mtha' yas/ skar me thar pa lags/ skal ldan lags/ rgyal mtshan dpal 'byor/ bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ rting mar gnyen mdo'i drung 'khor zhig bcas red/de bzhin sde dmangs kyi 'go ba yang 'gyur ldog byung nas gzhung bskos lha rdzong gi 'og tu sngar gyi thon drung zer ba'i go ming med par 'gyur ba dang rtswa za ru bzhi'i 'go 'doms lding dpon zer ba zhig dang / gzhung rgyug mi ser gyi 'go ba spyi mi zer ba bskos yod pa red/ de'ang lding dpon dang po ni sngon thon drung a dar 22

tshe rgyal gyi mi rgyud yin pa bsod nam brtan zer ba bskos 'dug der bod sa gnas srid gzhung ste dga' ldan pho brang pa'i sprad pa'i bkag gtan dang tog zhwa las gos gos chen lā ba shag rta la brang dom bcas kyi go thob yod pa yin/ lding dpon bsod nam brtan 'das rjes khong gi bu nor bu dgra 'dul pha rgyud bus 'dzin gyi lding dpon byas pa dang / de rjes yang grongs pa'i bar skabs shig ring lding tshab yangs pa ya nge skal rgyal nas byas pa dang / de rjes sor ya nge skal rgyam lding dpon ngo mas go gnas byung ba dang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol zin rjes steng chen don gcod las khungs kyi nor srid kho'o krang gi las ming 'khur 'dzin byas yod pa red/ spyi mi ni gnyer ba rje drung zer ba dang bu phun tshogs zer ba ('di bom phan dpon rnam rgyal grags pa'i bu yin ) bu rgyal mtshan zer ba bcas byung yod/ rjes ma'i bu rgyal mtshan de 1959lo'i rjes nag chu sa khul srid gros kyi u yon yin bye brag ru so so'i snga rjes 'go ba'i skor la/( 1) sdes khog tu rgan po 'am gtso drag zer ba'i 'go ba 'ga' zhig yod pa red/ sngar khyung po sha ba rang grol gyi gdung las byung ba yin zer ba'i khyung po dga' ring rgyud/ khyung po dpal rgyal zer ba de bod bzhugs am ba'i gnang ba'i go gnas yod tshul gleng rgyu yod pa dang / 'ji'i rgyud kyis mi rabs bzhi tsam ring sdes khog ba'i rgan po byas yod 'dug yang khams nang chen sdom pa be hu'i mi rgyud yin zer ba'i nang chen lha dge zhes pas sdes khog yul sde'i gtso grag mi sna chags te 'di'i mi thog gsum ring rgan po byas 'dug yang mi phug chab mdo rdza stod nas yin zer ba'i 23

mgar ra tshang myong dge zer ba mi thog gnyis ring rgan po byas pa dang / de nas de'i chag pa bu dzum dpon rgyud kyi bu zhig blangs pa de ga'i bu mgar ra rgyal mchog zer ba sdes khog gi gtso drag yin la lha ri rdzong gi drung yig kyang byas yod/ yang nang chung zer ba nang chen gyi bgos ya yin pa nang chung tshe rgyal mi rabs gnyis ring gtso drag dang rgan po byas yod/ yang nag rgyud lha dbang mi thog gnyis ring gtso drag byas yod/ yang rus rgyud ya nge yin pa'i dbyer chang klu dge mi thog gnyis ring sdes khog gi rgan gnyer byas myong rā bcas red/ gong gsal gtso drag zer ba de pha tsha bu rgyud byed srol dang / rgan ni lo gsum nang brje bskos byed pa red rting ma'i sdes khog gi 'go gtso ni gtso drag nag rgyud phyag rtor dang /nang chung o rgyan gnyis red/ nag rgyud phyag rtor 'di 1959lo'i rjes sa gnas srid gros kyi u yon yin/( 2 ) thang sdod dang thung dmag gi ru la 'go ba gtso drag dang / rgan po kha shas yod pa red/ de'ang rting ma'i gtso drag thod pa chos dbyings dang / dmar rtsa dbang rgyal/ rgan po lha dbang dang bu rabs rgyal zer ba sogs yod la/ thung dmag rgan po nam mkha' rgya mtsho zer 1959lo'i rjes thod pa chos dbyings 'di sa khul srid gros kyi u yon yin/( 2) sangs pa shog la 'go ba rgan po 'ga' shas dang gtso drag zer ba yod/ de'ang sngar sde ru bstan 'dzin zer ba'i skabs sde ru tshang la rgya bod shan sbyar gyi bka' shog dang tham ga sog zhwa/ rgya gri phor shub bcas yod 'dug la de'i bu bstan rgyal gyi go thob de tsho spyad yod pa ma zad kho rang la gzhan dang ma 'dra ba'i cha 24

lugs khyad chos yod pa red zer/ de nas sde ru stobs 'byor dang / de'i bu gro bdag yin/ sangs pa'i rting ma'i 'go rgan ni sde ru gro bdag dang / lha rje kun khyab/ spus tsha pa sangs gsum red/ sde ru gro bdag ni 1959lo'i rjes nas sa khul srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon yin/(4) tsheng pa shog la 'go ba gtso drag dang rgan po kha shas yod/ sngar tsheng pa la/ lho bo phun tshogs zer ba gtam yig rtsis gsum 'dzoms shing dpa' rtsal che ba (yul lha'i bu yin skad )zhig yod pa de'i mi rabs gsum gyi ring 'go gtso byas pa dang / de nas ar rgod dhi rdi bu bstan pa rab rgyas mi thog gsum ring 'go ba byas pa/ de bzhin gtso drag yim chi bsam 'grub dang / tsha kha'i rgan po nyi ma zer ba bcas yod/ rting ma'i 'go pa ni chos skyong dang / se shes gnyis yin/( 5) ar rtsa'i 'go ba ar rtsa sde ba zer ba zhig yod pa 'di snga tsam nas yod par mngon/ sde ba rting ma de rnam rgyal tshe ring yin/ (6) shug stag 'go ba sngar rdzis dpon zer ba yod pa dang rjes su rgan gtso zer bar 'gyur 'dug de'ang rdzis dpon thog ma 'gu 'gu zer ba nas rim par rdzis dpon bstan 'dzin dang phro rgyal mgon lha/ rdo rab nas rgan gtso'i las 'dzin tshe lha rab brtan sogs byung yod/ rting mar shug stag gi dge slong 'jig pa zer ba de gtso bo yin/(7) ra lung nang pa'i dud dum zhig tshad pa'i lha ri'i mi theg dzog lag:rno zir lag:spochesgo skyes zheng zir dretshor gya spya 'ag ba sbya ra ba da pa da gang smas ltar la da dung 25

mi ser 'go ba rgan po zhig yod pa red/ rting ma'i rgan po dpal ldan zer ba yin/yang rdzong gi zhabs phyi zer ba rdzong g.yog dbul dud bco lnga skor yod pa der 'go ba rgan po pad rnam zer ba yod pa bcas lha ri ru bdun gyi dpon rigs che phra'i grangs 'dren tsam de ltar yin/don tshan bzhi pa/ khral zhus rta zam sa tshugs kyi skor/ sngar mi tshos ngag rgyun du lho lha ri'i rta zam dang / shar gong ma'i dngul khral zer ba yin pas/ lha ri 'go rta zam 'dzin dgos rta zam zer ba ni rgya bod bar gyi lte ba'i gzhung lam ni gser lam zer ba dang /am ban gtsos dpon rigs phebs bzhud dang / chin khral gor rten bcas skyel sgrol zhu bar rta yi zam pa 'dzugs dgos pa yin pa'i rta zam zer/ gal te 'gro lam chad pa 'am rta zam thus shor phyin na gser lam sked pa cad pa'i 'gan nyes 'khri gi yod pa red/lha rir sa lam sgrig skyel 'khri mkhan gi lte ba'i lha ri 'go ba smos ci de bzhin hor tsho'i khongs dang / 'bri gung gi khongs bcas nas kyang 'du 'khri dgos yod 'dug (de tshor bcad grangs yod pa 'dra )lha sa nas chab mdo bar sa tshigs 2 4zer mkhan yod rung dngos su rtsis na lha sa nas bde chen dang gcig de nas mal gro dang gnyis de nas 'od zer rgyang dang gsum/ de nas rin chen gling 4 de nas mtsho mor 5de nas nu ma ri 6de nas kyim mda' 7de nas rgya mda' 〈de nas gla ru9 de nas gram mdo 1༷ de nas ko leb 11 de nas ar rtsa 12 de nas lha ri 'go 12de nas rim bzhin tshwa chu kha/ 14 rdo dug 15 ca gang 16a la mdo 17 rnam rgyal dgon 1〈 āon rta mda' 1926

dpal 'bar 2༷ lha rtse 21 ba re nang 22 sho ba mdo 22dzi tho 24 lho rdzong 25 bya dbye 26 wa kho 27 dmar ris 2 la gang sngal mda' 29 la smad 2༷ gla dma' 21 de nas chab mdo 22 bcas yin pas khyon sa tshugs 22yod lha ri ni sa tshugs bcu gsum pa yin/ lha ris yar 'gro rgya dma' bar skyel dgos pa de'ang lha ri nas yar rtsa bar me li bcu gnyis ar rtsa nas ko leb bar me li bco brgyad/ ko leb nas gram mdor bar me li bco brgyad/ gram mdo nas gla ru bar me li bcu bzhi/ gla ru nas rgya mda' bar me le bco lnga yin/ (lho lam gzhung lam rgyud rto bskos me li'i mtshon rtags rim ltar yod pa red/)mar 'gro rngod gro sked bar/ yang rngod rong gi gzhung lam bde min skabs lcags la rgyud rgyal shod nas skyod kyi yod pa de dus rgya shod ban dkar bar yin/'khyon lha ri nas la lam drug rgyud sa rdzong nyi shu rtsa lnga'i skyel 'dren zer ba yod/ la lam drug ni lcags la dang / nub kong la/bhan rda la/ khrod la/ ling la/ la kha dmar dang drug yin/sa rdzong nyer lnga ni/ shar gyi sa tshigs dang po kong chen sum mdo 2dkar g.yam sum mdo 2gsa' mda' bon dgon 4rgya shod ban dkar bcas rdzong chas 1 shar gyi sa tshigs gnyis pa lha ri nas tshwa chu kha 1tshwa chu kha nas rto thug rto sgron ma bar 2rto sgron ma nas lcags gang bar 2lcags gang nas rngon gro skad bar 4bcas rdzong chas 1nyo yi sa tshigs lha ri nas ar rtsa'i bar 1ar rtsa nas ko leb bar 2ko leb nas gram mdo bar 2gram mdo nas gla ru bar 4gla ru nas rgya mda' bar sa rdzong 1nub lha ri nas sangs chen sum mdo 27

bar sa tshigs 1sangs chen nas ling chu rabs bar 2ling chu rabs nas rkyang mdo bar 2skyang mo nas khem mdo bar 4khom mdo nas sgar chags bar rdzong chas 1byang lha ri nas sangs chen sum mdo bar /12) 1rdo// /dro///skye/ 15rdo /dro/ /bye)1sangs na sum ma nas 'a da sum ma bar 2'a da nas smi thi gtsang rog bar 2gtsang rog nas ram rgyal sum mdo bar 4khrong chas 1bcas yin 'dugarab byung bco lnga'i me 'brug 1916lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mdo spyi dang / hor spyi/ rta spyi bcas nas zhib 'jug gis rta zam sa tshigs skyar bzos bgyis 'brel hor tsho'i khongs nag shod tsho ba dang / 'bri gung sbrangs sogs tsho shog so sor 'phral nas byang lam bar ma zheb pa'i sa tshigs gsar btsugs dang rke sgur leb gsum gyi zhib gzhung bkod nas khral 'ur gtan phabs byas pa yin 'dug de skabs gong gsal sa rdzong nyi shu rtsa lnga'i nang nas shar lho gnyis kyi khral 'ul rang 'jags sdad pa dang nub byang gnyis kyi khral lam rgyug mi dgos pa byung 'dug 'dra drug khra ma zhes pa'i nang du lha rir rta khal mi gsum gyi grangs bcad ni/ khal ma 400rta 12 0mi hreng 5༷yan chad rgal na nag shod tsho bas sgrig skyel dgos pa yin 'dug nag tshos dngos su mi khal slebs ma thub pa lha ri bas gnas skabs rgya 'ub 'du tsam byung na rjes su 'khri khongs bcad rgal gyi tshab dbyug ma zer ba'i dngul nor len sprod dgos pa yin 'dug yang nag shod tsho ba'i sgrig skyel rta khal mi gsum gyi 'gro song de dag nas hor tsho'i sde khag bcu gcig gis nang khul nag tsho la dbyug gsab sprod srol yod 'dug lha ri'i nang khul du khral khongs so sos rgyun du sbra gur rta khal mi hring rgan po 28

bcas gtan sdod sgug res bzung ba red/ sa dbang ngam phogs mda' rtsis sras kyi dpon rigs che ba dang dpon dmag 'bab skabs lha ri ru bdun mnyam rub kyis gra sgrig dang / skyel sgrol dgos 'dug pa las chung rigs ni rtswa za ru bzhi dang mi ser ma gtogs ru gzhan gnyis 'du mi dgos pa yin/ mdo smad sa dbang ngam sa tshab mkhan chung / de bzhin dpon rigs che btsan bcas 'byor rgyu'i sngon du mda' yig slebs yong ba dang / de phral gra sgrig rta khal mi gsum gtsos dgos rigs 'du 'dzom byed dgos pa dang / mgyogs yig dang a drung slebs skabs sa tshigs 'go ba rnam dngangs skrags kyi sgo nas nam nyin ltos med du rgyug dgos pa red/ sku 'khor sa gnas su 'byor mtshams chibs bsu dang /mjal zhus 'bul dgos shing rta rdzi thab g.yog zan me shing 'thus shor med cing rta khal mi gsum gyi skyel 'dren le thog med pa sgrub dgos kyi yod/ le shor ram phran bu'i gra ma 'grig pa byung na nyes rdung dang chad pa gzad dgos pa ma zad/ sgrig dod dang kong gla zer ba sprod dgos pa'ang yod khral chen dmag chen skabs 'gro song lag sne dngul phon chen dgos stabs tshong dgon sogs chen khag sa nas dngul dom len dgos pa dang rjes su bu lon mi sod pa'i ོdka' sdug bcas mi ser la gcig thog gnyis rtsegs myong thong khur dgos pa red/ gong gsal khral 'ur sgrig skyel rta khal mi gsum rkang 'gro lag 'don rnam ru so so'i khral thob thog bgo dgos pa dang de nas ru nang khul du mgo 'gram la gzhigs nas cha gses byas pa yin/ zhib phra'i rtsi stangs ni nor khal 48la mgo re/nor khal 24la 'gram re/ nor khal 4la sug re/ ra 2la lug 29 — — ——

re/ lug 5re la nor re/ nor 5re la rta re rtsis pa'i rang thob kyi khral 'jal dgos pa red/ sems can gcig kyang med pa'i mi hring la'ang rkang 'gro'i khral 'khri ba yin/lha rdzong gi khongs gtogs snye bo stod pas 'ul lag rta khal mi gsum rgyun mi dgos shing lo ltar 'bru bogs sprod 'jal dgos pa yin/lo rabs bzhi bcu dang lnga bcu'i sbrel mtshams dus skor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khams skyod dpon dmag chu gnyer bzhin gcig thog gnyis slebs rdzogs rgyu med pa yod pa dang / skabs shig lha ri 'go gcig por sgrig khag gsum brgya lhag byed dgos pa byung ba dang 'gro song spyi byings rnam phud nyin re'i bzhu rdzas rkyang par mar 'degs khal sum bcu lhag 'gro (rgya ma 18༷lhag ) gi yod/ dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun 'khur dgos khar nyes rdung dang gshe gshe 'phrog bcom phog la brjod las 'das pa ma zad brgyad cu'i rgan mo zhig kyang grong grags dmag gis me mda' brgyab nas rkyen lam btang ba red/ mdor na de dus/ bka' mda' ngo las bcings 'grol dmag la 'thab dang zhor gyi gros su gnas/'khor g.yog dang ni dmag mi'i dpung tshogs mi ser bcom pa'i las la zhugs/ rdzong dang gtso drag rgan po sogs ni rta khal sdod sgrig byed rgyur 'brel/ mi ser rnams ni 'khar ma'i khral lci'i du: khas mnar bzhin 'o dod 'bod/ ces pa de 'dra rang byung yod pa yin/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol zin nas dmag sde bco brgyad pa'i sngon 'gro'i nying lag dmag dpung si ling yon wang chi mi'e dang 30

tshan mu'u krang khreng cin pos sne khrid gnang ba'i dpung sde de 1951lo zla 〈tshes 21nyin lha ri 'gor phebs 'byor skabs mi ser tshos lha dmag red zer ba dang lam thag ring po nas yong ba'i 'brog pa dga' g.yang dang / sri thar gnyis kyi ma'o kru'u zhi dang /spyi khyab si ling kru'u te gnyis kyi sku par gnyis sprad rog zer nas sku par de dag mgo thog la gtug gtug byas nas mthe bong bsgreng ste 'brog sde'i nang bstan rgyu yin zer ba sogs kyi gnas tshul mi —dmangs bcings 'grol dmag chab mdo nas lha sar dpung skyod byas pa'i lo rgyus ( ‘wang shan me'i 7bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam sgrig deb dang po'i nang ) du gsal pa de ga rang byung yod/ skabs der dpung sde'i za 'bru mi 'deng pa'i dka' sdug 'og chu bo'i nang nya chen mang po rgyug pa mthong dus za 'dod chen po lang rung / nya bsad na bod mi'i yul goms la 'gal dogs byung nas nya ma bsad pa ma zad lam la 'gro skabs rdo 'bum dang la rtsas mthong dus g.yon phyogs nas skor ste 'gro ba dang rdo chung re zung kha snon rgyab pa sogs zhib tshags kyi yul srol goms gshis la brtsi srung gnang lugs mtshon pa byung yod pas/ mi ser nas sde pa gzhung gi dmag dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gnyis spyod tshul gtan nas mi 'dra ba mthong dus der 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur yang mi 'dra ba rang shugs kyis byung ba red/don tshan lnga pa/ skye dngos dang gtenakha'i skon/ lha ri ru bdun khongs kyi skye dngos (1)shing rigs shug pa dang sbom shing / phras ba rigs gnyis/ stag ma/ dmar mo/ tsha ru/shākya dbying mong /gla rog mjo shing / lcang ma dkar nag su ru dkar nag se 31

ba rigs gnyis/ skyer ba/ spen ma/ mtsher ma dmar mo/kun ṭa ka ri bcas yod/( 2 ) rtsa che'i sman rigs/ dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu dang /be smug g.ya' gro sha ra/ gla rtsi bcas/( 2) bod sman sman rtsa'i rigs zhib par/ rtsa ba lnga/dbang lag chu sder/ re ral/ btsun mo re ral/ brag skya ha bo sga tig ser po sgu drung / 'bri rta sa 'dzin/ lug mur sman chen/ thang rtse/ thar nu/ re lcags/ rtsad rgod/ spru dkar/spru skya/ tang kun/ sdong gzer/ a krong dkar po/ a byagagazer 'joms kyi lce dkar nag a rgyag mtsher sngon/ a rgyag lug lag urlal rgyal ba'i spyan can ming can ser naga.utpal/ ser po/ ug chos/ spang rgyan dkar sngon khra gsum/sgang chung / bya rgod spos/ gnyen 'dul klu bdud rdo rje/gza' bdud dkar po/ gso lo dkar smug dmar gsum/seng ge zil ba/ bong nag bdud rtsi lo ma ba sha ser sngon/sum tig zangs tig lcags rigs nag po g.ya' khyi ra mgo/dngul tig re lcags/ khron bu/ tang kun chu rtsa/ rtsa mkhris/phur mong / glang sna dmar po/ tang ngu rigs gsum/ lug ru dkar ser dmar smug bzhi/ lo btsan nang ma g.yu lo/ zangs rtsi/ dug nyung / re rkon/ sngo sprin gla ba sran chung / grang rigs dkar sngon dmar nag bzhi/ lce tshwa sngo de ba/ gharna bha 'dra/kring ku/ 'jib rtsi dkar po/ hon len/ sngo dga' sha la yul ring sogs/ sman sna khyon 220bskor yod gzhan yang ri skyes zas rigs su rung ba'i 'gang che chung sna tshogs te/ ro mngar la 32

nus pa ldan pa bod kyi rten 'brel gyi zas su brtsi ba'i gro ma dang /tshal rigs zhim shos gser sha dang / mod ro de bzhin lug sho dang ra sho/ rug pa bcas yod la/ rta chags sam mi zas thabs chag rung ba'i ram pa sogs thon zhing / de min byis pa'i kha zas su rung ba'i a lum dang / mtsher shing gi shing thog sna tshogs bcas yod/( 4) srog chag ri dwags kyi rigs/ sha ba/ gla ba/rna ba/ bgo ba/ gnyen/ rgya gor bcas dang / gcan gzan gyi rigs gzig dang gsa' gzin/ gsa' bo/ dred mong / spyang ki/ wa/ sbe sogs yod/ bya rigs ni rgod dang/go bo bcas bya chen dang / khra glag ne/ 'od bcas sha gzan/ 'jol mo khu byug bcas skad snyan/ khrung khrung dang / ngang ngur bcas 'dam gzan/ zil mo dang bya gan bcas spu sdug phug rta dang mchil ba sogs sgum mthun bcas bya rigs khag mang po yod/( 5) lha ri ru bdun gyi sa khongs su gter kha ni rang cag gi mthong thos la gzhigs na lha ri'i sar chen nang du gser dang /zha nye yod skad dang / sdes khog nang lcags dang / zangs/ to ko ro sa/ shel bcas yod tshul gleng / sangs chen nang /btsag dang cu gang yod/ o sog rong du/ mtshal dang mthing /mtshur nag rdo gnyen bcas yod zer la tshwa chu gnyis yod/tsheng pa'i nang / cong zhi dang / zha nye/ mtshur dkar nag mu zi nag po/ ar ka sa yod pa bcas yin/don tshan drug pa/ yul srol rgyan chas dang 'tsho ba spyod stangs dus chen sogs 'ga' zhig (1) lha ri ru bdun khongs spyir btang / 33

khyo ga rnams kyi chas gos rgyun du dgun gos la pags slog rgyan nag zhing kha chung tsam yod pa dang / pags pa'i rkang gos sam sgyid dkris zer ba gyon/ thag lham sna gnyis phrug thig mas lham rgyan brgyab pa'i lham gyon/ dbyar gos snam bu'i chu ba nag po dang /dmar po/ sngon po gang rung thog ras nag po 'am sngon pos kha sos sbrags pa gyon mgo'i zhwa mo dgun tshar ru dang / wa zhwa/dbyar 'phying dkar bzos pa'i zhwa mo 'am/ yang zhwa bcas gyon gyi yod/ rgyan chas ni rke la gzi byur g.yu sogs kyi mgul rgyan 'dogs pa dang / sked par gri dang / me cha khab shub/ glo khug bcas 'dogs pa red/ mgo skra lhas ma/ skra shugs nag po 'am dmar po brgyab nas mgor kyud skor byed kyi yod/ bud med rnams mgo skra gnyis lhas byed nas skra shugs dmar sngon gyi dza los rgyan te dung zhib kyi skra sbing zer ba thad du sbrel ba dang / mgo bor rtsi g.yu zer ba brgyab nas dngul gyi phra rgyan byed srol yod/ rke la g.yu byur sogs dang / dngul gyi ga'u gcas 'dogs pa yin/sked par chab ma zhes pa dngul dang / lcags sogs la g.yu byur gyis phra brgyan spros pa bcings/ glo g.yas su/ mgon bu bltar ba'i phe tsha zer ba gru bzhi zhig yod pa de 'dogs/ glo g.yon la gri chung dang / 'gron bu dngul sgor brgyan pa'i glo sar (dzar ) zhes pa zhig 'dogs pa yin/ dgun slog pa rgyan khra 'ja' sgrig dmar ljang byas pa gyon/ dbyar chu ba nag po 'am sngon po sogs la ras gos kyi phu med kha sbrags byas te gyon/ mdun la spang gdan bod mo las che tsam yod pa rgyag pa bcas yin/ma gzhi gyon chas rgyan cha ni rang rang 'khos 'byor la gzhigs 34

nas bzang zhan dang rgyas bsdus mdzub mo'i rim pa bzhin yod pa las mtha' gcig tu nges bzung med/ 'on kyang spyi'i cha nas byas na gong gsal ltar yin/( 2) 'brog sde rnams dgun khar khang pa re gnyis yod pa dud nyung shas tsam dang / mang shos ni dbyar dgun gnyis dkar rtsid pa'i sbra len gnyis sam len gsum byas pa yang na de las skyo bas sbra chung nag rgu tsam bcas sogs dud tshang che chung ltar sgra che chung sna tshogs phub nas sdod kyi yod/ sbra mkhar ma dar lcog gnyis re gsum re brgyab pa/ nang chas ni spyir gdan chas lcog rtse khro sno/ dkar dmar sder ru spag phor zer/ skam ches ni gzi byur ru/ dar gos chen/ phrug 'bu ras/ gri me mda' rta sga chas zer/ zas rig ni ja 'bru mar gsum/ sha thud 'o zho zer/de bzhin byes chas sga cha gdan/ sgro bring snod zer gzhan yang dkar snod/ rgya mdong dang / zis mar zam/ chu zam sogs gong gsal tshang ma 'dzoms dgos pa yin rung 'byor ba'i cha rkyen mi 'dra ba'i bzang zhan sna tshogs yod pa yin/ nang chas zangs dkar dang / khro ril de rtsa chen brtsi ba ma zad sngar gyi yul thon rdo gnyen dkrug ma'i snod rdo rdza zer ba de rtsa chen po brtsi ba de'i nang bkol bar dro ba mi 'chor ba yin zer srol yod/zas rigs ni spyir btang 'grog par skom ni ja srub ma dang /ja dkar/ ja 'o yang zer ('o ma chu 'khol sres pa ) btung ba dang / zas ni sha dang / rgyu ma/ zho dang dar ba/ 'o zho dang dar zho shang zho bcas la rtsam pa dang / phyu ra gro bcas kyis ram btegs nas dmar dmar bkrag bkrag za ba las/ tshal rigs 35

sogs 'deb 'tshol mi byed la bzo yang mi shes/ 'tsho ba dbus rigs kyis/ ni rtsam tshab ram pa dang / sha tshab khrag sha sogs la rten pa dang da7ra chu dang sbrel nas zas 'tsho byas pa yod/ rong rgyud dang lha ri grong pa sogs la ni nyung la phun gyis zas rigaca/ sbyor thub pa'i thug pa'am tshal rigs kyi za ma spyod kyi yod pa yin/( 2) lha ris rtswa za'i sde 'brog sde cha rkyen yod pa tshang mas 'bru tshong len srol yod pa so so'i rgyus yod gnas por brten nasadabus khul dang / rgya mda' kong po brag gsum sogs su brje tshong la 'gro ba yin/ 'ga' res 'bru tshong tsam min par nam rgyun lha sar bshas btsong dang kong po brag gsum nas rta nyo bar kham tshong pa dang lag sbrel te tshong gi 'khor lo skor nas rgyu ma nyung tsam bsags mkhan byung yod/phar tshur 'gro skyod skabs kyi gzhon rgyu ni rta dang sna lo yin sna lo zhes pa ni khal a yu chung nas 'dus sbyong byas te sna la thag pa drang nas sga ldan ji bzhin gtad de bzhon pa de yin/ (ra co yod pa'i sna lo yang yod ) lha ri mgo rgyud la kong 'gros ma mang po yod/'dir dre'u ni ha lam gcig kyang yod ma dar zer na chog pa tsam yin rta la sga chas dang rta sgro la dang 'dod chen po yod/ nye mtshungs phar tshur skyod dus za chas mgron chas tshang ma rta sgro'i nang blugs nas sha dag dos po 'dra ba zhig brgyag gi yod pa yin/( 4)lha ri'i rgyud kyang spyir bod kyi sa khul gzhan dang 'dra ba las sdod gnas dang 'tsho ba'i dmigs bsal de tsam med rung lha ri'i shug stag rong sdod rdzil pa zer ba'i sde dud de tsho'i sdod stangs ni ya nga ba zhig yod pa de ni gdod ma'i spyi tshogs nas kha bral tsam 36

yin pa'i 'tshor snang skye ba zhig yod/ sdod khang ni shing shug pa'i lo mas spyir bu thabs chag gcig yin/ gyon gos ni nor dang ra yi khu rtsid kyi snam bu'i chu ba yin pa dang / mi phal cher lham gon rgyu med pa rkang rjen ma red gda' 'dir rgyu med pa shug pa'i shug pa btings nas gyon chas las nyal chas ha lam med/ za rgyu ni ri dwags kyi sha dang sems can gyi 'o ma bkol nas 'thung / ru ba spo skabs 'byor ba che chung gis dos khal gcig nas gsum bar ma gtogs 'gel yas med pa bcas red/ gsar brje byas pa dang lhag par ca lis shan shug stag rong du spos pa nas de ga'i gong gsal rnam pa la 'gyur ba ha cang chen po zhig gzhi nas byung ba red/(5) skabs de'i spyi tshogs lam lugs kyi rkyen pas las lam bsod thes gang skos dang / pho mchog mo dman bcas kyi 'du shes gtso bo 'dzin gyi yod rung / rgyu nor ldan pa zhig dgos na las la brtson nas 'bad pas ma sgrub na bsod the shag po lta bu'i phan mi thogs pa'i lta tshul chen po lhag yod (shod srol de ni lha sgrung du mi zhig bsod the dang 'phrad nas shan po byas rjes khos da ni bsod the dang shag po bsgrigs thub stabs gang yang 'gubla ma dgos pa nyal rkyang byas nas sdad pa las tshwa len tshong skor gang yang ma byas stabs rgyu nor 'phel rgyur phar bzhag phran bu yod pa'ang rdzogs nas yas la thug par yid gdung gis bsod the yang yang bos nas sdad pas nyin zhig kho bsod the dang 'phrad/ des nga la 'bod pa gang yin brjod par khos nga khyod dang shag po bsgrigs rjes phyug tu ma song ba dbul du phyin song da ji ltar byed lab pas bsod thes ngas khyod dang shag po byas rjes byang gi tsha khar phyin dus khyod mi gda'/37

lho 'bru khar song dus khyod mi gda' bas nga la byed thabs ci yod ces bshad par kho gnyis sad pa ltar 'gyur zer ba'i gtam rgyud gleng zhing skyid 'dod las 'tsher gyi mi la sun 'byin byed srol yod/der bstan bcos logs bshad nas ma bsdus pa rgya khyab ngag rgyun du gleng ba ni/ skyes pa 'go ba la tshang dgos pa/ gtam yig rtsis gsum 'dzom shing phyi dpa' rgod rgyas gsum gyi dgra 'thul le nang yangs khog lhod gsum gyi gnyen skyong le dgos zer/ 'bring po la/ dpa' skyen 'phen gsum 'dzoms pa yar go bzhag na dpon go 'phel le/ mar go bzhag na g.yog go nus le dgos zer/dmangs ngal rtsol 'brog par zog rdzi ri 'gro mngags sna bang mgyogs/ shing 'thu rta lam/ mnyed yog rko 'thu gang yang 'phel ba zer/ bud med ni khyim gyi 'khor yug las kha ma bral pa'i 'jon po dgos rabs te/ 'gron chu skal brda/ dkar zho 'o bshin/ thag 'thag par 'khis/ lci rdzi smyu las ces 'phel dgos tshul gleng srol yod/spyi yongs nas chos la dkar ba/ kun dang mthun pa/ lha mi mtshan ldan/ 'gris gzhung bzang ba/ mna' phral ldan pa rang rgyu sman 'dra byed pa/ mi rgyu dug 'dra byed pa blo gshog yangs pa/ gtong phod che ba sogs legs rabs dang / bzang rabs brjod yang bden pa'i las byas na khe las gyong mang de bas phra rgyu sprul rgyu g.yo rgyu'i sgo nas gyon mi la sprod cing khe rang gis len mkhan la 'jon pa can pho tshar ba brtsi mkhan ma nyung ba yod/(6) lha ri 'go'i yul skad dang gyon pa rnam 'gyur bcas la 'khor yug gi shugs rkyen thebs yod/ rtswa za ru bzhi dang 38

po mang che nag shod tsho khongs nas yin rung / gos lham gyi rnam pa dang skad gshis sogs rim 'gyur gyis rjes sor nag shod dang 'dra chang du gyur de bas rgyal shod stod rgyud dang 'dra sa che la 'bri rkyeng dang yang 'dra ba'i cha yod pa ma zad/ nyang po dang kong po'i rnam pa yang mtshon rgyu yod/ lha ri'i gro gzhas kyi nang du dbyangs dang tshig don kong po can du ma yod pa red/ lha khongs snye bo'i skad mkhrigs po yin pa phud/ de byings spyir btang 'brog skad bde po zhig la yul skad dang dbus skad kyi g.ya' phran tsam yod pa zhig yin blo bur ha las pa'am dngangs skrags skabs 4 lha ri'i srung ma mkhyen zer ba kha la gom nas spyod pa yin/ 'ga' zhig gis mna' tshab tu brjod pa red/ yang lha rir khang pa'i rgya khra la khrung tsi dang / byam tshe la can to/ yangs zhwa la yang mon/ cog rtse la/ sgrog tse sogs rgya skad sngar nas rgyun 'jags yod pa de spyod gom chags par yul la la dang mi 'dra ba yin/(7) lha ri'i dgra lha dpang bstod ces pa sde dgon thun mong gi dus chen zhig tshugs srol yod pa de ni lo lor bod zla 6tshes 1nas tshes 7bar yin/ tshes 1la sde dgon 'dzoms 'go tshugs pa dang tshes 2nyin lha ri bde chen gling du dgon pa'i gur mo che dang spyi sger gyi gur khag tshang ma phub thub pa byas thog dbyar skyid kyi sta gon yongs rdzogs 'grub pa byed/ tshes 2nyin rgyug chung zhes pa'i rta rgyug dang tshes 4nyin rgyug chen yin de nyin dang po bsang skor byed pa ste/ dgon pa'i bla gra mang mas gzab rgyas kyi bsang gsol gsung ba dang sbrags bsang bskor sngon skyod sna 'dren dgon pa'i las sne rnam ser chas kyi gzab gos gyon nas phebs mjug dge 39

bkos zhal ngo'i gzab chas kyis yongs su slub nas lcags rgyug gru bzhi kung khre gcig lhag tsam pa dkros ma gser tshags can dar tshon sna lnga'i phang phung brgyan pa zhig khyer nas byon/ de nas lha ri rdzong dang / lding dgon gnyis so so'i go thob kyi las gos kha gsar bsnams pa dang zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa'i khar tsho shog gi 'go mi gtso drag sogs gzab 'phyor spras pa'i chibs hrag bsgrigs nas thon/ skya mi me mda' khur mkhan gyi ru dar dar dmar gyis brgyan/sked gri gser tshags ma sked par drangs/ dpa' lung la dar gyis chun pos brgyan pa 'am tong skud kyi rdza lo rgyag dngul gyi 'bral spang dang / ga'u sum sgrig ma rgyab la khur/ bzhon rta la sga chas legs shos med na min pa de gtod rnga rngog la dar tshon dang / rke la g.yer dril gyis brgyan pa bcas byed/ bsang bskor byed skabs ki ki bso bso sogs kyi sgra gnam sa 'geng ba ltar yod/bsang dud ni lho sprin phyur ba ltar mchis/ gra ba rnams kyis rnga sbub dung gling gi sgra yis yid dbang 'phrog cing mos gul skye dgos pa'i snang ba ster ba zhig yod de lta bu'i bsang bskor rta rags des g.yas bskor gsum dang / g.yon bskor gsum rgyag rjes rang gnas su cung tsam log nas rten 'brel gyi gsol tshig re drangs zin pa dang / rgyug ma rgyug ring 'go tshugs kyi yod/rgyug rta ni sngon tshud nas bdam yod pa dang / rta de tsho'i rnga rngog la ling dkar dmar gyis dpa' 'ching mdud kyi yod pa dang /spyi btsugs tu bya rgod kyi thul lu bcings dgos/ bal stan 'go rnam g.yon can bab le ljang gus brgyan pa rgyan srol yod/ rgyug phrug rnams stod gos rkang gos dang gos chen chu ba gyon nas mgo la 40 —

ras dkar zhwa mo rgod 'phru brgyan pa gon/ lag la sba lcag tshigs gsum gyi lcag tshan re thog te rgyug ma rnams lha thang gi gsham du ches/ser skya 'go dmangs kyi ltad mo ba rnam thang stod nas gral bsgrigs tshar ba dang / rta mgo bsgrigs mi rgan po zhig 'gro dgos pa des lha chung btsan mkhar rtse nas me mda' thengs gsum 'phen pa yin/thengs dang po'i dus rgyug ma tshang ma rta mgo sgrig tshar ba dgos/thengs gnyis pa'i dus rgyug chog yang sar byed/ thengs gsum pa 'phang ba da gar kha mnyams glod kyis rgyug dgos/ mgyogs bur snga phyi ltar shir byang sprod pa dang / shing byang bzhin ang grangs tshan pa sprod kyi yod/de rjes yob 'gyur dang gong 'phen sogs kyi rta rtsal ston pa bcas yin/ tshes 5nyin lha ri dgon pa'i rten phur ba lha khra zhes pa de mjal kha dang rten dbang bskur ba yin/ 'dir snub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi brag la phur ba gdab zheca/ pa'i phur ba de yin pas rten 'di lo gcig dus gcig de nyin ma gtogs mjal kha dang dbang bskur mi thob pa yin/ dgon pa'i de nyin tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen btang ba dang phyogs mtshungs sprul pa'i sku dang lha rdzong lhan rgyas thog grwa tshang yongs rdzogs ston mor rol ba yin/ tshes 6nyin lha ri ru bdun gyi 'go gtso rnams rdzong gis 'gron 'bod dgos pa dang / ja chang gis gsol 'dren gzab rgyas btang srol yod/ dus tshod de'i ring mang tshogs rnams gzhas dang /zhabs gro/ glu dang sgrung / sho sbag bang gyad rbad gsum sogs rtse mo ci rigs rtsed pa ni 'phrul dga'i dpe la 'gran nus pa lta bu yod/41

de bzhin dbyar dus rtswa za'i shog tsho so so'i nang nyi grags tshang gi bla ma gdan zhus kyis chos 'khor bskor ba dang dbang zhu spyi rim dbyar ston rta rgyug sogs byed srol yang yod/(8) chos dad dang kha mchu sogs tsag tsig kha shas/chos dad thad nas lha ri ru bdun khongs kyi mi ser nas spyir nang bstan grub mtha' tshang mar dad zhen byed kyi yod kyang lha ri'i mi ser sogs nas lha dgon bde chen gling gtsos ri bo dga' ldan par dad gus che zhing 'di ga'i khongs dgon sde gtso bo rnams grub mtha' 'di rang yin/ dgon par ban de bu khral bsdu rgyu yod pa dang /dkor sa dge khongs sogs dmigs bsal dbang cha chen po yod pa red/ rtswa za'i 'brog sde'i nang gsang chen rnying ma ba'i grub mtha' la dad zhen chen po yod cing lhag par chags ri nyi grags chos skor gyi rgyud 'dzin sngags rigs dang slob rgyud yod pa ma zad/ chags ri'i bla ma glang nag dang / chos gling zhes pa'i sprul sku gnyis ka rtswa za'i nang 'khrungs pa zhig red/ yang sdes khog dang sangs che chung nas sngar gyi sde khongs bu rdzum tsho ba la gtogs pa'i pha dgon gsa' mda' bon dgon yin pa de tshos g.yung drung bon gyi grub mtha' la dad zhen yod cing mchod rtsa 'dzin pa dang grwa ba yang de ga'i dgon par zhugs kyi yod 'dugartswa za lha ri'i sde khongs dngos su 'gyur rjes dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs nyi shu pa'i nang sangs sdes kyi grwa ba'i skor la lha ri dgon dang / gsa' mda' dgon par zlos gyar byung ba'i gnas tshul byung myong / yang dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs bzhi bcu 'am lnga bcu'i lo stod/ lha ri dgon dang / kong po 'brug lha dgon 42

gnyis bar lo yag byams pa zhes pa'i zlos sko ra lha sar gzhung gtug kha mchu byung myong yod/ yang lha ri'i kha mchu gzhan dag che gras grangs 'dren tsam byas na hor sde sde khag nyi shus lha 'gor nag tsho'i rtswa za ru bzhi'i sde dud khyon che khral bsnon du sprod dgos byung khar da dung grangs bcad kyi rta khal mi gsum sgrub rgyug khral gyod rta gcig sga gnyis chag te bral ba zer ba'i snyan zhu phul don lha ri dang sde khag nyi shu bar lha sar ra sgring rgyal thog skabs gzhung gtug kha mchu byung ba yang sangs pa yang de skal rgyas dang / tsheng pa'i ems grags pha bu bar gyi kha mchu/ yang lha nag bar lha rir shug gsab skor gnyis phyogs kyi 'go ba 'bri ru la 'dzoms nas nang mol byas pa de min lha ri sprul sku dang rdzong thub bstan mtha' yas bar 'gal zla byung nas gtug grabs byas pa sogs byung yod pa bcas yin/mi shi 'das mchod byed stangs ni lha ri'i yul sde yang so so'i chos lugs grub mtha' gang yin bzhin dgongs rdzogs bdun tshig 'dzin rgyu sogs byed par yul gzhan dang gcig mtshungs yin rung gshin po'i phung po skyel yul de lha ri rtswa za'i nang yin na phal cher gyis rab na 'bri gung mthil dang chags ri dang brag dkar lha chu bcas la skyel ba yin/ 'bring na so so'i dgon pa'i dur khrod la skyel/ tha na nye skor du bshes bsnyan gyis sa brtag nas skyel srol yod pa bcas red 'dug43

༄7/ le'u gnyis pa/ 'bri gung sbra ga'i lo rgyus/lo rgyus rgya mtsho gting mtha' mi dpog kyang /lo mang song ba'i rgan rabs ngag rgyun rnams/lo ma'i nang nas 'bras bu 'tshol sdud kyi/lo rgas bgres pos rig pa sgrim nas 'brithog mar dpon khungs 'bri bla'i lo rgyus lam tsam/sbra ga'i lo rgyus 'gor dpon po'i dpon khungs yin pa'i 'bri gung bla brang gi lo rgyus lam tsam gleng na cha tshang bar snyam/ 'bri gung bla brang ni bod kyi sger chos bla khag nang nas chags snga shos kyi gras 4ga yin pa dang sngon bod khri skor bcu gsum la khri skor rer khri dpon re yod/ 'bri gung pa khri dpon gcig yin pa dang / da dung 'di'i sngon chos rgyal mes dbon rnams gsum gyi dus su 'bri gung gi mi sna re bod blon du bzhugs dgos pa red ces shod srol 'dug kyang yig thog nas gsal ba cig la srong btsan sgam po'i dus lha gcig kong jo bsu skabs blon po mgar gyi mnyam du 'bri si ru gung stong zer ba'i bod blon zhig 'dug pa de yin par snyam/mnga' bdag khri ral skabs bod blon 'bri nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zer ba cig yod skad 'dug 'bri gung gi gdan rabs dang po rje 44

'jig rten mgon po ni mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs ldan stod gtso ngur grong du skyu ra'i gdung brgyud/ yab rnal 'byor pa rdo rje rgyal po dang / yum rag shi gza' gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs nas de nas bzung 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung zhes pa bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha khungs ldan du mar gsal/ de nas gdan rabs nyer gsum pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i dus su gdud brgyud chad nas skye sprul yang srid ngos 'dzin byed rgyur 'gyur pa red/'bri gung pa khrims sgo rang btsan dang / 'dzin dbang bdag thob kyi sa cha gnang ba bcas kyi skor/ zhal gsal 'khod pa/rgya nag gong ma'i gser yig gser tham dang bod skyabs mgon gong sa lnga pa'i shel bam/ drug pa'i rgyab gnon/ sog gu thi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi tham ga bcas yod par brten/ 'ja' sa shel bam gyi bdag po dang dbu gdugs rta dar/ rta mgo gser tog gi go gnas yod/ bla ma gtso bo 'bri gung che tshang dang / chung tshang gnyis/ de'i 'og bu slob sum cu zer ba yod/ 'bri bla'i rtse shod las tshan bcu gsum ni/ gzim dpon/ chos dpon/ gsol dpon/ yong 'dzin/ phyag drung / gsol thab/ shod la/phyag mdzod/ sde pa tshang gnyis/ mgron gnyer/ las drung /gnyer pa/ shing gnyer/ chib dpon bcas dang / las tshan rer sger g.yog mi gcig nas gnyis gsum bar yod/ ma dgon dgon pa bzhi ste rtse/ ka/ sgar/ mthil bcas yin cing de dag la dwags dang mtsho sngon yun nan sogs nas grwa rgyun 'bor chen zhig yong srol yod/ tsa ri/ gangs ri/ la phyi gsum la rdor 'dzin zhes pa'i bla tshab re gtong dgos la gnas gsum gyi bdag po 45

rgyal ba 'bri gung pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin par 'dug rgod phug rdzong la 'tshams grwa bzhi dang nag shod 'bri ru 'gom dgon gsar/ tsho khongs nem tshwa dpal 'khyil dgon dang / rdzar dgon/ mnye mo rta bshags gnyis bcas la bla ma bla tshab re gtong srol yod/ mtsho sngon du dgon pa mang po yod pa/ lho mgar khri gsum gyi gdan sa skyong rgyu dang / la dwags su rtogs ldan bla ma'i gtso skyong mdzad de dgon pa khag 'dzin skyong byed srol yod/ yun nan la 'jang sprul chos grags tshang gi dbu bla mdzad pa'i srol 'duga'abri bam̐'i chos gzhis mi ser ni zhing pa 'don bdun cu don gnyis dang / 'brog sde sbra ga smam 'brog srib rong bcas sde shog gsum yod/ dang po/ sbra gzhung gi dang po'i lorgyus/thog mar gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus gleng srol du byang mer gzhung zhes pa/ mer stod khams pa ja 'khur dang mer smad kun dga' rwa ba/ mer dkyil gad pa gru gsum zer ba bcas stod smad bar gsam gyi sa yal de sa rgya che zhing rtswa cha 'dzom po yod par mer sde ru ririg ri pa riring tsho bco brgyad zer ba chags/ de'i 'go 'dzin mtshal dmar rgyal po dang / dar bza' skyid gnyis la bu mo mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags can zhig 'khrungs (skye sa mer stod lha lung zer )ming la mer bza' 'bum skyid btags/ bu mo de gzhan dang ma 'dra ba zhig yod stabs/ lha klu gnyan gsum bu mo dang mnyam du 'tshogs nas mi ༵ba kyi lto chas bkol skabs thab bsur shor bas rkyen la brten

bdud po klu btsan (a khyung rgyal po ) la phog thug shor bas bdud a khyung gis mer sde brlags nas mer bza' chung mar khrid pa 'i gleng srol de 'dra 'jags yod pa red/ skabs der bdud po klu btsan rgyug sa'i lam dang mer bza'i rta rwa rdo brtsegs bcas da dung mngon sum mthong rgyu yod pa ma zad/ 'di rgyud la gna' snga mo'i rdo yi lag cha dang / rdo snod sogs kyang yod skad gleng rgyu yong pa red/bdud kyis mer sde bcom skabs lung khug kha shas su lus pa'am/bros 'khyam byas pa'i sde nyung ngu lhag yod 'dug pa de dag sbra ga'i mes po yin bzo 'dra/ sbra ga zer ba'i ming thogs stangs ni sngon du yul der gegs bar tshabs chen byung ba de re nag kha sbyor byas pas len par rtsis nas de tshun sbra yi khug ling dkar po bzos te sems can gyi spu ga ltar byas na ga pa yin stabs sbra ga zer ba'i ming btags pa red zer rgyun 'dug la/ nga tsho'i dran thog la'ang sbra thams cad de 'dra red/ de la 'bri gung zhes pa'i tshig grogs sbyar dgos don ni/'dam sba ga rwa sgreng sba ga sogs ming 'dra kha shas yod pa de dag zlos skyon mi yong pa'i ched du dpon ming sde la sbyar ba yin 'dugachags yul gyi sa cha ni shar phyogs rdzong phu dang / la kha dmar rgyud lha ri dang sa 'dres/ shar lho gye gsang mtsho phu g.yab 'grung bcas kyi la so rnams rgya mda' dang 'a dres/ lho phyogs gangs dkar mdu nag smam pa dang sa 'dres/ nub phyogs stag la la nyin sreb re rong dang 'dres/ nub byang 'dam rtswa la rgyud dang / na dzum dang /gro lo bcas 'od sna dang sa 'dres/ byang smad du deng skabs gling rdel shang dang chags yul 'di ni sngar nag shod yung dkar tsho ba la 47

sa g.yor byas nas rtswa rin yar khal 2 ༷༷tham pa dang / dngul srang 9༷tham pa yung dkar nas 'bri blar phul te sbra ga'i khral mar thog bcag srol yod/ byang stod/ nag shod tsho pa gzhan dang sa 'dres yin/ de skabs rgya 'bum gnyis sba ga'i gzhung shing yin/bod 'dzob gnyis mtshon gyi pa lung yin zer srol yod pa'i rus rgyud de dag las gyes pa dang / sa gnas gzhan las gyar pa ni so hrug las gyar pa grags shul/ sbyob zer ba rgya mda' las yong ba/chung rgyud ni kham las yong ba rngos pa ni rngod gro sked las yong ba/nag chu zer ba ru rnying las yong ba/ nya ru zer ba dmar yon las yong ba bcas rugs bsdus byas nas chags pa zhig yin stabs/sde grangs yang mang po yod tshod mi 'dugaganyis pa/ sbra ga'i cha shas che ba hon ga bza' ma'i lo rgyus/de yang sngar byang rigs a mdo ga ja dpon tshang gi bu mo zhig bar tha'i jing ger dpon gyi mna' mar song bas rjes su nang kha 'grig min tha dad byas pa'i rgyu nor skal thob sprad rjes su ga bza' yis/ nga rang thog mar khyim 'dir yong dus jing ger dpon tshang gi phu lha btsugs nas mda' sgo them yan gyi bdag mo dang / bar tha tsho ba'i dpon mo yin pa khas blangs zin pa zhig yin stabs/sde skal med na mi 'grig ces brjod par lab gleng mthar/ bar tha sde gzhung ma yin par mgo btags zhus pa'i 'khyal sde kha shas dang /a ban skor ba sogs sde dud 'ga' shas mo rang gnyug rogs yin zer am stod nas mnyam du yod pa bcas 'khrid nas/ nga tsho sa 48

gnas 'di gar mi 'grigs bzhin du mi stod la/ bu mo'i 'dun ma len gcig yin pas phar rang yul la yang mi logs sa cha gar skyid pha yul byas nas 'gro chog zer nas yul lung dga' shas la phyin pas lha ri'i sa khongs su lo shas sdad skabs/ khral zhib byed skabs la te lha ri'i khral khongs su tshud kyang lha rdzong dang ma 'grigs par mo rang rdzong khang la skyod de nga khyod kyi sa char mi sdod thag chod yin/lha ri'i lha thang sde po/ rtsod mi dgos lha ri'i sde la zhog ab kyang gro ma 'bel po ma/ rtsod mi dgos lha ri'i sde la zhog nyang ra'i lhas khug dro po ma/ rtsod mi dgos lha ri'i sde la zhog lha ri bla ma dge ma mgo dge mas 'khor gsum bskor le las/ bu mos 'ur rdo 'phang le dga' zer ba sogs bshad de/ gong g.yer la rgyab nas shar re song / ra mdas rjes zin kyang glag ma rnyed par smi thi khar 'byor/de nas lha rdzong gis gzhung sar snyan zhu phul bas phyir phebs byung don ga bza' ma lha ri'i khral khongs su phyir log khral 'jal byas na smos med dang / ma log tshe khral dod khal dbyug so gnyis yan nas kha tshang man go 'khor bdun dang / ja bag brgyad lo ltar lha ri dgra lha pang bstod skabs (zla 6tshes 15) la ga bza' nas le 'khon med par sprod dgos zhes phebs pa lha rir phyir log ma dgos par khral dod de don ltar sgrub rgyu'i khas len byas nas/ sdod gnas smi thi smad la byed rgyu'i blo mos yod stabs sba ga la 'brel ba byas te khyod tsho'i sa char rtswa chu gang bzang sar bkag sdom ma byas na/nga tshos byang a yer gyi dgra sgo bkag chog bshad par sba gas de don ltar yong ba'i mos mthun byas stabs a yer gur mtsho ga nang bcas la 'tsher sa sbra mal mthong rgyu yod/ ga nang du ga bza' khug zer 49

ba mi ming sa thob yod/ sa gnas de rgyud sdod skabs nyin zhig del phung tshwa kha zer ba la sems can tshwa bslud skabs phyugs rigs rdzi bos chu mig gi nang du rdo bkrag bslugs pas rlang pa nam mkhar 'phyur nas nya ro bya rgod mang pos bza' rgyu yod pa byung 'dugayul lha jo bo pad dkar ri rtser mtsho zhig yod pa de'i nang nas kyang rlangs pa thon pa zer srol 'dug de nas yun ring ma song bar nad yam zhig byung nas ga bza' tshang rtsa stong song ba ma zad gzhan dag la gegs bar tshabs chen byung / dpon tshang stong sa g.ya' chen nang du sba dang thug gi tshal ba can rabs mang po'i mthong yul 'gyur ba yin 'dug go skabs dang bstun nas sba gas gzhung sar snyan zhu phul te/ nga tsho'i mi ser 'khos zhan grangs nyung la brten gser lam sked pa chad nyar thug pas sa gnas su zhib gcod phebs grub yong ba zhus par lcags 'brug lor zhib gcod byas te sa gnas der rtswa chu dge bed gcod mkhan sger pa yan sdod rnams bka' 'gug gis 'dri rtsad skabs ga sa ma'i rgan 'brug rgyal zer ba nas brjod na/ nga tsho dpon tshang stong pas mgon med skyabs bral la brten khral mjal khrims 'khur gyis sa chags sor gnas thub te bral bas sprang po gar chags dbyag pa gar gnas kyi lto gnas 'khyams skyod chog pa dang / 'ordo sna bas nga tsho sger dpon la nang khral mjal dgos pa'i thog yang skyar rta gcig sga gnyis 'gel ma dgos par zhus kyang don smin ma byung ba ja ba gsal rab kyi nye 'gram du/ ga sa dang / 'od sna gnyis kur rgan po re bskos te rgan sa sprad pa dang 'brel ga sa ma sde spyi 'gre ltar dngos po'i thopa thang ltar khral 'jal rgyu dang / 'od sna bas sger dpon gyi nang 50

khral zhar chag med pa'i thog lam thog gi khral rigs rkang 'gro lag 'don tshang ma sba ga'i drug zur 'jal rgyu'i dpyad khra byung ba de nas bzung ga bza' ma'i 'khor sde de sba ga'i khral sder 'gyur pa red/ sa spre lor mkhan chung pha lha nas lha rir khral zhib byed skabs ga sa'i 'go pa a ban skal bzang dang / rgo rdzi nor tshe gnyis kyis nga tsho sba ga'i sa gnas su khral 'jal khrims 'khur byed rgyu dang lha rir khral 'jal rgyu de gnyis rta gcig la sga gnyis kyi dpe ltar ma dgos pa mtha' nan zhus skabs gong gsal ja khral rnams dngul rtsis kyi bod dngul srang bdun bcu don lnga dang rdzong la mjal zhus phul 'thus chog pa byung bas der ga gzhung sbrel nas mi rabs re gnyis song zin kyang / da dung phyogs zhen dang 'gal ba nges can zhig yod pa dper na/ ga bza' mas sba ga'i spyi khyab byed mi chog pa dang de skabs mdo sgar dpon zer bas gtsos tshong 'grul 'bor chen skyod kyi yod pa de'i rdal gla'i 'go pa la tshong pa'i sar nas ja dngul dang /mi ser gyi rdal dngul nas 'khri 'then byed rgyu sogs bza' sgo che tsam yod pa der zhugs mi chog pa sogs yang rnying bza' mi 'chams pa'i 'gal zla yod pa skabs der ga sa mi shed cung che bar rten 'bri gung che tshang zhi ba'i blo gros kyis ga bza'i 'go pa a ban dbang rgyal dang / rgo rdzi tshe nor gnyis la 'jam bshad blo 'gug thog gzigs gsol gnang ba dang 'brel phyogs gnyis nas sba ga spyi khyab rim byung thun mong thog sba ga ba'i 'go 'don 'tsho skyong byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba ma zad/ gong gsal rgo ban gnyis mi mus rgyud bcas la sba 4 spyi khyab dang / khyad med pa'i khral chag byed rgyu'i lag 'khyer re gnang ba red/ de nas bzung ga gzhung gnyis chu dang 'o ma 51

'dres pa ltar 'gyur nas gdags gzhi yang 'bri gung sbra ga zer ba'i nang du 'dus pa las zur du med rus rgyud/ rgo rdzi/ a ban/dbul ba/ sngo sangs/ da ge/ dge chen/ si ri/ yon tshang / btsan tsa bcas las gyes pa red/ kha rgyun du sba ga sba dud lnga brgya du rtsi gnam btang bdun brgya zer srol yod/gsum pa/ sbra ga'i dpon rigs dang khral 'ul sogs kyi skor/sbra ga'i dpon rabs rim byang ni thog mar bod po spyi khyab mi thog gsam me/ bong ror ba ngarngo / bong rab brtsam bong ma / rig cam / / rig / / ( / / shasgyu sdis gsum sgyeb mi thog gnyis te skyeb bsod tshe dang / skyeb ga med gnyis/ grags shul bstan pa dang / rgya a mdo/ chung rgyud 'od zer/ rgo rdzi bkra rnam dang / rgo rdzi tshe nor/ rgo rdzi phun tshogs bar mi rabs bzhi'i ring gtso drag a ban don grub nas mi 'gyur gtso drag brgya dpon mi rabs drug bcas red/ thog mar spyi khyab kha shas 'bri bla'i zhabs khongs nas yin 'dug sbra ga'i 'go dpon gyi go rim ni/ spyi khyab dang stong dpon/ brgya dpon/ dmag dpon/ rgan po bcas yin/ spyi khyab rting ma dud sa gre 'bum dang stong dpon rgo rdzi phun tshogs/ brgya dpon a ban mi 'gyur bcas yin pa dang / rgan shog bzhi yod pa/ mer ba'i rgan shog she ma ru ba'i rgan shog nya 'bo'i rgan shogasmad pa'i rgan shog bcas bzhi la rgan po re re yod/ rting ma'i brgya dpon a ban mi 'gyur (sbra ga'i lo rgyus 'di rtsom pa po ) deng nag chu sa gnas srid gros u yon yin/52

'ul lag skyel 'dren gyi skor/ sbra ga'i rta khal mi gsum sogs khral rigs rnams sngon dus lha ri 'go ma gtogs gzhan la skyel lam med pas khal bco lnga dang / rta 'ul gsum man mthil mdun nas smam rong dang lha rir skyel rgyu grangs tshad de las rgal na sbra 'od gnyis kyis ja gsal nas lha rir skyel rgyu ma zad/ rgya am 'ba' yar phyir phebs skabs ar rtsa grong du zhag gcig bzhugs sgrig dang /mtsho 'gor khra gtan gcig bcas dgos yod/ de nas byang lam bar ma tshags par 'di ga'i 'go dmangs nas sngar med gsar srol 4zig /bye// mjug /)sgo /speshā lag tsho rto gagya khral gas skyal lam da sa brjad skabs sa gnas srad gzhung gis gzhung sa chen po'i chab srid 'phrin las rgyas pa'i dgos mkhor zhig ste gzhung lam gsar gtod byed rgyu gzhung gi bka' 'brel yin zhes lab gleng byed yul ma rnyed/ de nas bzung khral rigs 'grul bzhud byed mkhan rnams kyi sa cha de rgyud mi ser snyoms zhing rta khal 'bel ba lam thag nye ba bcas kyi khyad chos yod lugs bshad par rten btsan po yar phyir 'grul bzhud chu gnyer lta bu byung ste/ byang lam bar ma zhes yongs grags kyi lam chen du 'gyur pa red de nas rta khal/ brje mtshams sdong po sgang du chags/ der rgya mtsho smad pa zhes sger gzhung bzhi 'dus dgos/ sger 'bri gung dang / rgya ma khri gang pa/ phag mo lhas sding pa bcas gsum dang / mal gro gong dkar rdzong khongs gzhung rgyug mi ser bcas kyi sdong sgang nas ja ba gsal rabs bar skyel rgyu/ de nas sbra smam rong gsum dang /'od sna bcas kyi gtsang rabs skyel rgyu/ (rdzong skyel )nang khul cha gses byed stangs rta'u dos khal tshang ma phyed ka sbra 'od gnyis dang phyed ka smam ror gnyis kyis byed rgyu'i lam srol yod klung 'gro rnams 53
