la sa skyel ma tog rdzong skyel byed srol med dmag sgar che rigs la smam rong rgya mtsho sbrel te ja gsal nas/ dbyar rdal 'brugadagun mthil mdun bar skyel rgyu de skabs zhag sa sgrig rgyu/ sba ga nas rtsig rogs sum mo ja ba gsal rab/ lcang mo gong bcas zhag sa gsum sgrig dgos thog stag brag rgyal thog skabs nag shod 'tsho ba stag brag la chod pas 'byed zhib zer ba sa gnas so sor ngo skyod thog kho pas 'gan dbang spyad de sger don gnyer nas sngar lam rtsis med thog dung lung sa tshig sba ga'i go btsan g.yog byas pa ma zad/ 'bri brgyad skye med 'chi med du ham 'jog byas pa red/dus de nas bzung tsho pa gcig gis zhag sa bzhi sgrig dgos byung ba red/ skabs der khral 'grul re re'i 'gro song mar dngul sha thud rta'u dos khal mi sogs 'gro gron ha cang che ba'i thog sgrig cha gcig pur cha mtshon nas bshad na dmag sgar re la sbra gur brgya tsam dgos pa/ rta thab me shing / chad ja zhu mar sogs mdor na dgos mkho tshang ma 'dod nag ngo sgrig gis so sen gang 'theb byed pa las 'char gzhi lam srol dang / ngo tsha zhe khrel gtan nas med sbra gur gyi mi lding bar brten nye 'gram mi ser gyi mgo sbra tshang ma bshu dgos stabs dbyar char pa dang / dgun gangs lhags sogs kyi nang du mgo brjen du sdod dgos pa ma zad/ nyes rdung dang /bshad bshad zed dgos pa sogs skabs de'i gnas tshul bshad tshar yas mi 'dug lag 'don khral gyi skor/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bla phyag las khungs dang / rtse mdzod chung / gzhol pa las khungs/ de bzhin dga' ldan stong mchod bcas khag bzhi la gzhung khral mar 54

khal lnga brgya 'jal sprod dgos pa dang / da dung g.yu thog par mtsho phu'i rtswa rin zer ba mar khal dgu stag brag bla brang gi 'bri bdun 'chi med mar khal nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ sger khang 'bri gung bla brang la thang 'bru bil mar zer ba dang / bka' brgyad ka mar zer ba bcas bsdoms mar spor khal ( 250) dang dngul srang nyis brgya phyur skya khal nyi shu tham pa/ phyur ra sngon po khal bcu/rnga ma dkar po dang / bal nag po khal bcu re/ re ba 'dom bcu gnyis bcus pa bcas dgos pa red/ rkang 'gro rta khal mi gsum gyi skyel 'dren ni 1951lo nas bzung ha cang mang po med/lag 'don gyi mar dngul sogs ni sngar lam ltar 1951lo nas bzung ha cang mang po red/ lag 'don gyi mar dngul sogs ni snga lam ltar 1959lo bar 'jal dgos byung ba red/bzhi pa/ skye dngos dang sa babs sogs/skye dngos rigs ni/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu dang / g.ya' gro/ gro ma/ spen gro/ gser sha/ hong len/ parla ta/brngan ka ser po/ bong dkar g.ya' skye ser po/ gangs lha me tog su ru dkar nag sum tig tig ta ser sngon po/srad dkar sngon re rkon/ gang ga chung / rtswa dres ma sogs sngo sman yod pa dang / rdo sman ni cong zhi rdo byis mgo/ smug po mdung rtse sogs yod/ srog chags rigs/ gla ba/ rna ba/ rgo ba/rkyang / gcan gzan/ spyang ki/ dred/ gsa'/ dbyi/wa/ og dkar/ sum/ grum pa/ khyi ba/ sre mong sogs 55

dang / bya rigs/ khu byug bya rgod/ go bo/ bya blag khrung khrung / ngang pa dkar ser/ cha skyar/ 'jol mo sogs bcas skyesangasdo/ ra༅sa babs rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre ( 4800) tsam yod par shang rdo rwa shar ma gnyis red/ mtsho stod/ mtsho smad ni de las cung dma' tsam yin/ gnam gshis grang ngar che la/char pa 'bab pa'i dus thung zhing / gangs dgra che tsam yod/yul gyi kha dpe ru/ byang mer gzhung lhags pa mda' las tsha mgo wa zhwa drin can pha ma 'dra zhes zer srol yod/ 'on kyang spang ri dang / na thang rgya che tsam yin pas rtswa chu 'dzoms po yod pa red/ri chu dang gter kha sa 'dzin gyi 'khor yug skor ba'i nang nas ri bo grags che ba yul lha dge bsnyen bar lha zhes pa de ni/ ri de'i g.yas nas bltas na/ brag dkar rgod gshog rgyang pa 'dra/ ri de'i g.yon nas bltas na nags ri lho sprin 'khrigs pa 'dra/ ri de'i mdun nas bltas na dung seng gnam du 'khyong pa 'dra/ ri de'i rgyab nas bltas na g.yu yi maṇḍal bkod pa 'dra/ zur bzhi mchong gi padma rgyas pa 'dra/ na bun lang len rgyal po'i la thod 'dra/ de 'dra'i ri bo lhun chags khyad par can/ de ni sbra ga pa yi yul lha ste/ me dud stong la nye ba'i khyad lha yin zhes zer srol yod/ de min ri ming che ba/ shar du kham pa bya tur/ lhor bar lha'i sku mkhar/ nub rta mgo'i gnas ri/ byang du jo bo dpal dkar bcas yod pa red/ shar du mtsho mer gyi mtsho/ lhor smug yon mtsho/ nub tu sha bo'i mtsho/ byang du mtsho dkar mtsho sogs yin chab phal 'dra yod/ yal de'i 'bab cha tshang ma stag la la 56 rig ༄༄mi rir

'og nas thams cad 'dus te dkyil chu'i chu 'go red/gter kha ni/ zhwa nye dang / rdo mu zi nag po/ lcags/mtsho smad 'bon khyim zer ba'i phu la nyi ma kha chu dang / gangs tig yod zer/lnga pa/ yul srol goms gshisargyan gos dus ston sogs kyi skon/sbra ga smi thi/ rdza 'bed bcas yul srol goms gshis lugs sogs phal cher gcig mtshungs red/ de'i nang thun mong min pa'i cha lugs la/ sba ga 'od rna gnyis kyi bza' zla yod pa'i bu mos 'bri gung a phyi'i chas lugs yin zer/ shing gi g.yu gdan sgor mo gser mdog mtshal ris can zhig gi steng du g.yu dngul thum ma gcig la dpa' g.yu zhes ming 'dogs pa red/ de'i brgyab tu spyi kheb ces dngul phab gcig la g.yu khra mang po brgyab pa gcig dang / spa phrug ces pa/ dpal g.yu zer ba de bza' zla shi na lam seng dkrol ba dang bu mo go mas btags na ngo tshar brtsi srol yod pa ma zad/ brgyab gzhung du len shub zhes pa ras sdeb thog tu len shub g.yu byur dngul chas sogs mang nyung 'dra min sna tshogs yod/ rgyun du skyes pa rnams dgun kha lug slog dang ra slog rgyan nag dang / kha shas nyis khra can dang snam bu'i rkang gos dmar smugakha shas lug lpags kyi rkang gos snam bu'i yul lham rgya log dang /phrug sogs kyi bul dkris yod pa/ dbyar gos snam bu'i phyu ba dang / khag gcig ras stod yod pa/ mo gos dgun khar lug slog rgyan khra can dang / lham snas lnga'i bul dkris can dang /57

dbyar khar snam bu'i phyu pa sngon po dang / khul snam nag po spun khra yod pa dang med pa/ dbyar kha 'bi 'jo zer ba'i phying zhu'am ras kyi char zhu zhes gyon/ kha shas res tha'i lham yu can gyon/ 'o/ gsar gnyis dang gzhan dus chen sogs la gzab mchor spras skabs skyes pa rnams spu phrug dang / tshar tshag sum gzig yod med sna tshogs dang / kha bos/ gos chen dang / mgo snam ras sogs gang 'byor gyon gyi yod 'bu ras kyi rkang gos dang / stod gos/ zhwa mo/ lcags mda' dang / sog zhwa/ yang zhwa/ phying zhwa/ lham shul ci/ ko mgo/ ras mgo sogs gyon/ rgyan cha rgyab tu 'phrul mda'/ mda' 'khor/ lnga 'dogs/ bod mda'/ rdzas khug glo zung / phor shub/ glo gri/ me cha sogs/ g.yu byur gyi khra yod pa dngul thag ske la gzi byur gyi mgul rgyan dang / srung 'khor mgo skra ltag lhas la ga'u dang / ba so/ skra shug ba so'i theb skor bcas kyi rgyan/ mo rgyan la/len shub thog la g.yu byur dngul chas dung zhib mgron tshom rgyan ldan glo zung / glo bkrang / gser rna/ dngul rna/ gzi byur/lag gdub/ sor gdub dang / mo gos tshar tshag sram rgyan yod med sna tshogs dang / kha gos/ mgo snam/ gos chen sngo ljang /spu phrug kha shas ras dang / snam bu bcas kyi gyon pa yang yod skad lugs smi thi dang phal cher gcig mtshungs yin yang / sbra 'od gnyis 'bri gung dang sa thag nye ba'i stabs kyis snang mi snang a bo khe ye thang ma chad sogs zer srol yod/thon skyed byed thabs 'brog las gtso bo dang zhor du tshwa 'bru brje tshong / 'bu g.ya' gro brko ba dang / rtswa sogs brnga bsdu/58

pags rigs mnyed 'tshims spu rigs sred yog 'khel thag snam las/ dkar chu 'o dkrog mar phyur bsdu len sogs kyi las ka byed kyi yod pa red/gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dus chen skabs rten 'brel zhu ba'i byed sgo'i skor/ spyir bod ljongs yongs la rgyal po lo gsar zhes bod zla dang po'i tshes gcig la yin yang bre brag 'brog khul du bi'u lug lo gsar (lo chung ) zer ba gcig kyang gtong srol yod 'on kyang gal 'gang che ba ni lo gsar che mo zhes bod zla dang po'i lo gsar gtso bo 'dzin gyi yod/ skabs de'i byed sgo mi rnams kyi bya spyod gtam gsum sogs phyogs gang cir rtags rten 'brel gang 'grig byed pa yin/ bod zla 12tshes 29nyin dgong gro sbra mkhar gyi du grig dang / zar chag phur chag ja ro/ rus pa/'khrud rta sogs dgu glud phyir btang ste nang du dgu thig zhes gro zhib kyi g.yung drung dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rna bdun sogs rten 'brel mtshon pa'i ri mo gang shes 'bri srol yod/ tshes 20nyin ja chang zas rigs gdan chas sogs so so'i dngos 'byor la zhig pa bzhin gra bsgrigs gang zab byed pa dang 'brel/bsgrigs gshom byed sa phying dkar khebs ldan gyi gzhi gcig bzos te de'i thog zas rigs sna tshogs kyi phud dang lug mgo dar snas brgyan pa/ phye mar mda' dar sha mar thud/ kha zas bcas kyi sder kha spam mtho brgyab thog brtsegs ldebs su thang sku bshams pa bcas byas nas phyi nyin mtho rangs la nang mi rnams bzhugs gral gtong nas phye mar chang phud bkyag te bkra shis bde legs zhus nas tshang mas phud gtor byed pa dang 'brel phyi lo nang mi mnyam 'dzoms 59

kyi dga' spro'i ngang lo gsar gtong rgyu yong ba'i smon 'dun rang rang gis gang shes rgyas bsdus ci rigs ngag thog nas shis tshig brjod/de nas lo sgo phye mkhan zhes mgron du thog mar 'bod rgyu ni lo tho nang gsal lo bzang pho mo khyad med pha ma kha 'dzoms ming spra legs pa lo rtags lo khams sogs cha tshang bas zhig snga sa nas mngags bcol byas pa'i mi des phye srol dang 'ga' shas ni mi 'dis phye na 'khrod 'byor yod ces mi de rang 'bod srol yod/ de nas mgron 'khor spro skyid dang / rtsed mo'i rigs sna tshogs la ci dgar rol/ tshes gsum nyin yul lhar ri gsol dang / so so'i khang khyim la dar lcog 'dzugs pa/ tshang mas rgyan gos zab 'chor spras thog rta rgyug sbod 'khen rkang bro glu gzhas sho sbag shed tshad rdo mgyogs sogs gang ltar rtsed mo nyin bdun phrag bar byed kyi yod/dus chen che shos ni mnyam 'dzoms rta rgyug yin/ (dbyar skyid yang zer ) rta rgyug dus tshod ni bod zla 6pa'i tshes 15yas mas su 'bri gung bu slob re/ skabs de dang bstun nas phebs srol yod/tsho bar rgan shog gnyis romanyam du rta rgyugs srol yod/ rta'i grangs tshad shog kha rer rta 12re bsdoms 24las ma nyung ba dgos kyi yod/ tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas de'i thog shod rgyu ni/ nga tsho dbyar skyid kyi dus tshod 'di'i nang phan tshun gyod kha mchu dang bu lon snyog 'ded sogs mthun sgril gtor bshigs kyi bya spyod gtam gsum gleng lhag med pa rtsed rigs sna tshogs la longs spyod nas/mi tshang ma blo bde bag pebs ngang dbyar skyid gtong rgyu dang / de bzhin rta rgyug dngos gzhi'i skabs bden pa bden thub kyi sprad pa'i shing byang gzhi 'dzin pa las nga yin kho yin gyi 'gran tsod mi chog pa 60

/mi 19 skyes :she1sngo che//mi:re65bcas nan bshad da la da/ na nab/ na pa sprad srol mi 'dug pas bar skabs nga tsho mi kha shas gros bsdur thog ta rgyug gi tshan pa cung che tsam ma sprad na gcig na phyis lta mkhan nang nyan mkhan yod pa dang / gnyis nas rta sbyang skabs mi rta gnyis la dka' ngal che tsam yod lugs bshad pa yin/ 'go bas bka' garu/la gnad don da lta nga tshos sde thog nas tshan pa mang tsam sprod rgyu'i thag gcod byas na rjes su tshan grangs len mkhan ni dbang cha yod mkhan nam rgyu nor yod mkhan zhig la phal cher 'khel srid kyi red/ de ltar mu mthud lam ngan mu 'byams byas na rta bdag dmangs dang / rta med mkhan rnams la lo ltar gyon gun phog par brten mthong phyogs dang kha 'phangs yong nges yin pas rgyan chen po ma sprad gsung byung / der brten nga tshos pha gtam bu 'jags kyi de don lag len byas te yang dang po la bod dngul srang 15nyi shu tsam las sprod srol med nga tsho'i las thog rta sngon rjes skor rtsod gleng rtsa ba nas yong ma myong / phyogs phan tshun nas yong ba'i ltas mo ba tshos brjod par rta rgyug gi ltas mo ni sde shog gang sar gcig pa yin yang lo ltar rtsed gleng rtsa ba nas med pa 'di ni khyed tsho'i khyad chos shig red ces shod mkhan yang yod pa red/ rta rgyug gi dus yun nyin bcu tsam gyi ring rta rtsed sbos rtsed sho sbag chang 'thung sogs byas te tshang ma skyid por sdod kyi yod/ lo lnga drug re'i mtshams su 'bri gung skyabs mgon byang phebs te byed srol yod skabs der shog bzhi rta mnyam rgyug byed pa dang / rta yang 40nas ma chag pa byed dgos/ bla brang gis tshan pa gnang rgyu ni ma gzhi deb gsal yin 'dug kyang bod dngul dza thang chag stabs phran bu re spar te rnam 61 /de——/de——/de

phrug dar tshon solas dang/ yi/nga dang por srang 250skor gnang ba dang / sde spyi'i tshan pa yang bla brang dang phal cher 'dra ba sgod srol 'dug skabs der yob 'gyur dang / gong 'je na/'gros bsdur sogs rtsed sna tshang ma la dar dang dngul gyi gnang sbyin mang po yod pa red/drug pa/ khrul bzo dang grags yod mi sna'i skor/sbra ga ba'i khral bzo stangs ni/ be'u yar ru phud/ de 'phros rang zog ji yod pa dang / she nor drug la nor re/ rta rer nor gsum re/ 'bru phyur rgyab gsum la nor re bcas rtsis pa'i nor 160tham pa la brgyad cha/ nor 80tham pa la bcu drug cha nor bzhi bcu la so gnyis cha nor 2 ༷pa la bzhi cha nor bcu la reb phyed cha bcas zer srol yod/ gong gsal brgyad cha gnyis la bzhi cha dang bzhi cha gnyis la phyed phyed gnyis la khal mgo re zer ba red/ khral dud tshang mar khyon gcig tu bsdoms pas khal mgo bcu gnyis bcu gsum yas mas yong gi yod pa red/khral chag byed tshul ni/ bzang chag dang / ngan chag gnyis las/ bzang chag ni sbra ga spyi khyab rim byang la/ khral rtsa chag dang / khral rtsis skabs dud sgo btsugs rkyo mjal zhu so so'i blos gang sgrol zhig sprod dgos pa dang / rgo rdzi a ban gnyis la nor bcu re'i khral chag rgan po bzhi la nor nyi shu re'i khral chag yod/ ngan chag ni mi re shi na/ nor nyi shu re chag yang yod/dgra shor dang / nad yag sogs kyi skyon cha tshabs chen byang ba la /bya/shāstu) riri ༅ ri ji

gegs bar phog tshad che chung la gzhigs pas khral chag byed srol yod/ grags can mi sna'i skor/de snga sbra ga spyi khyab dang / stong brgya sogs kyi nang la mi ser myo/go 'don 'tsho skyong byed rgyu dang / phyi'i sde shog phan tshun bar spyod kha mchu gzhung sar bde sdug snyan zhu byed rgyu sogs 'go ba'i ming khyer ba ngo snong mi dgos pa mang po byung yang de'i nang nas skad grags dkar she bsam dga' zer ba de che ba yin 'dug sa rang phar tshur 'gro skabs mnyam du khrid rgyu dkar she'i ab phrug bu dgu zer ba de dag la nam rgyun khral rigs mi dgos pa phar tshur 'gro ska bas rta sbod rang 'grig shar gtong byed pa las dgongs zhu mi chog ba 'i skad cha 'dug ab phrug tshos gri dang / me mda' la kho rang gis rtags rgyab yod pas gzhan la phyir 'tshong mi chog pa dang /kho rang phyi la song nas dgra gyod gang byas kyang de ring dkar she pham nyes byung ba red zer ba rgan rabs tshos go myong med pa'i skad cha 'dug re re bzhin bshad na tshig nyog tsam 'dug pas bris med dpe mtshon lo rgyus sne gcig bshad na/ sngon sbra ga lug mang zer ba gsang gzhung du phyin nas sdad pa de dag tshur 'gug skabs/skabs der so hrug che ba la lha ba tshe 'dzin zer ba zhig yod 'dug pas/ des mdang gsum smi lam du pho dgra lha can zhig sa phyogs 'dir slebs song / 'di'i phyogs kyi yul lha gzhi bdag tshang mas chibs bsu byas song kong ga pa rjes su lus par bshad bshad btang song bas/ de ring rtags shig yong bar yod ces bshad pa phyi nyin 63

gsham gshes dwangs po yod kyang / kong ga pa/'i rtser nyin gang rmug pas gtum nas sdad pa red zer rgyun yod /1950g.yas g.yon du/ dgra phar rgyab rang gnang tshur len ram mda' rtsed gcod byed skabs cung skad grags che ba ni dmag dpon rgya don tsheng zer ba zhig byung ba red/༄7/ le'u gsum pa/ rdza 'bid (sngar ming 'od sna )lo rgyus/sngar ming 'od sna dang / deng skabs rdza 'bid shang gi lo rgyus go thos tsam zhus na/ ming 'od sna zhes 'bod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dgon pa phyag 'debs mkhan bla ma gyer sgom pas nga yi dgon pa pha gir brag 'od sna sna yod sar bzhengs rgyu yin zhes pa'i gsungs bgros der brten 'od sna dgon pa'i 'brog sder song stabs dgon ming sde la thogs pa yin 'dug 'od sna dgon pa'i chos gzhis mi ser/ bod pa mi ser dang / ru kha mi ser khag gnyis yod pa/ru ba mi ser sa zhing dang / phyugs zog yod pa/ ru ba/ sdod gnas dang po sa cha spang nang du yin par phyugs zog lo ltar 'phar bas rtswa kha ma 'dong bas si rong la mi thog re zung sdad (si rong yul lha bya zhu zer ba de deng skabs su yang sde dud kha shas phug lhar brten gsol 'dug )yang de gar rtswa khas ma 'dong pa dang 'grig min byung stabs da lta 'od sna sdod sa 'bri gung sba ga'i sa khongs der de dus sa stong yin pa ri dwags/ rkyang 'brong / sha ba/ rna ba/ rgo ba 64

sogs yod sa der ru ba sdad nas gzhis chags pa dang / de'i steng lo shas song mtshams/ sgar lcags sa khongs su khral 'jal gzhis chags byung nas khral sa de'i shar ngos rdo ra shang dang /shar ma dang sa 'dres/ lho ngos ni mtsho stod dang mtsho smad sogs dang sa 'dres/ nub ngos dga' ldan ru ba dang sa 'dres/ byang ngos so hrug che ba dang sa 'dres yin/ sde gzhung thog ma'i dud ming ni/ rta ba/ byi ba/ spa sngags/ bod pa/ ga yu bcas kyi thog mgar ra/ 'bo/ be tshang / mi ṇi/ lha ri (sog po yin zer ) dmar yong am mdo khol ba sogs kyi rus rgyud dang mi tshang de tsho gtso bo yin/gcig shogakha de'i 'go dpon rim byung /thog mar 'od sna bla brang gi ngo tshab spyi pa'i grwa pa zhig gi bcu 151 /ste/321 :ji /rje/1re/ /bye(/ste/(1kyi /rdo1 )ji1da na ga kha shas byas sa ga na pa bcu da na ga mar kham pa a nos de'i bu gras lnga dbang phyug de rjes rta pa nor tshe/ de rjes kham pa tshe dbyangs dang / mchog grub/ 'bo ri 'bus/ ban tshang kun mdor/ bod pa tshal dmar/ a mdo sbo lo/ kham pa dbang rgyal bcas red/ dbang rgyal da lta sa gnas srid gros u yon yin/khral 'jal skor/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung sa'i phyi khral sgar lcags sa 65

khongs su chud nas/ thog mar sba gar brgyad zur dang / de rjes 'phel rgyas cung zad byung nas bdun zur/ de nas sde dud 'phel rgyas byung nas lcags 'brug zhib gzhung skabs drug zhib gzhung skabs drug zur yin pas sngon dus khral rigs rnams sgar lcags nas lha ri bar skyel rgyu dang / a 'ba' yar mar phebs skabs ar tsa grong du zhag gcig bzhugs sgrig dang / a tsa mtsho mgor khra can gcig bcas sbra 'od mnyam du bsgrigs dgos byang lam bar ma gsar gtod byas pa nas bzung la 'gro ja gsal nas gtsang rog bar dang klung 'gro ja gsal nas mthil mdun bar skyel dgos/rkang 'gro rta khal mi gsum dang / lag 'don sha mar 'bru da ngul rtsam phyur sogs 'gro song tshang ma sba ga tsho pas drug zur 'jal dgos pa red/nang khral ni/ 'od sna dgon pa'i 'dzin bdag rtse yig tshang las khungs bcas la bla 'dzin zer ba rtse drung re yod pa ngo ma'am tshab bcas de bzhin 'od sna dgon bla brang bcas kyi ngo las dbyar dus byang 'brog sar zla gcig tsam bzhugs ring / dkar zhabs nyi mar nyin phyur zer ba dang / sha dang lci ba'i dod mar rgya drug tsam dgos pa dang / lo 'khor gnas tshul che rigs yod tshe thag gcod byed kyi yod/ spyi gso'i dkar rtog mar spor khab lnga bcu/phyur dkar khal bcu gnyis/ dge skos dkar rtog mar nyag dgu re sde dud tshang mas sprod dgos/ gong gsal zla 1ring tsam la sha mar zho sda gur gdan bcas gra sgrig dgos pa red/

gnyis/ skye dngos dang yul srol skor/ skye dngos dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ g.ya' gro/ gro ma/spen gro/ gser sha/ hong len/ parla ta/ ba sha/ ka ser po/ bong nga dkar nag g.ya' skyi ser po/ gangs lha me togasu ru dkar po/ sum tig srad dkar/ re koni/ gaṅgā chung / tag sha/ sro lo dkar po/ de min sman rdzas rnam grangs mang tsam yod/ rdo sman rigs/ cong zhi/ rdo rgyus/ rdo klad/rdo ghi wam/ g.yu rdo/ tang zil bcas yod/srog chags rigs/ gla ba/ rna ba/ rgo ba/ rkyang /gcan gzan spyi ki/ dred/ gsa'/ dbyi/ wa/ sbe/og dkar/ sram/ grum pa/ phyi ba bcas dang / bya rigs/khu byug bya rgod/ go bo/ bya glag khrung khrung / ngang pa dkar ser/ chu bya/ sa babs ni/ gnam gshis grangs ngad che la char pa 'bab pa'i dus yun thung zhing / gangs dgra che zhing rlung shugs che ba yod/ spang ri dang / na thang rgya che la rtswa chu 'dzoms ngo yod/ri chu'i chags tshul la/ sbra ga'i nub byang ngos kyi sa phyogs la sa cha khol babs mtho dma' snyom tsam yod/ shar phyogs yangs shing lho phyogs spung pa 'dra/ nub phyogs gtsang chu sngo mo dal gyi 'bab/byang phyogs rdza spang gral ltar bsgrigs pa 'dra/ dbus su khrag dkar 'bras drug spungs pa 'dra/ sa zhing nags tshal la sogs med na'ang / 'brog las bya yul mthun rkyen che tsam yod/67

yul srol gom sa gathis skad 'u gachu/ sogs phal cher gcib mtshungs red la thon yin gyi cha lugs yang sbag dang gcig mtshungs red/ thon skyed byed thabs 'brog las sogs sba ga dang gcig mtshungs yin pas zhib phra ma zhus/ gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dus chen skabs rten 'brel zhu gsol dang / 'das mchod bcas sba ga dang khyad par med pa yin/bla brang rta rgyugs zer ba dbyar dus spro skyid dang 'brel/ bla grwa tshang ma byang du pebs 'byor zin tsam la/ rta rgyugs pa'i cha 'phrin 'byor ba dang sde tshogs nas/ rta pho chen dang / pho chung /rgod ma bcas rgyugs khag gsum la dbye nas/ zhag bdun nas lnga bar sbyangs rjes dngos gzhi'i rta rgyugs tshar nas mgyogs dar tshan grangs shing kyang so sor thob tshar rjes/ dar tshon sna lnga dang /gos chen ra gcig gnyis/ bul dkris thig ma dang snas lnga bcas gnang tshar rjes/ rtsed mo'i rigs kyi rtsal 'gran/ me mda' tsha kha yob 'gyur/ gong 'phen sogs gang dga' byed kyi yod/khral thob bzo stangs sba ga dang rnam grangs gcig mtshungs yin 'dugakhral chag thob stangs skor/ dmigs bsal bcu dpon dang / rgan po gnyis la rtswa bkag 'os 'tsham yod pa dang / nor brgya dang nyi shu re'i khral thob rtsa yangs yod pa red/

༄7/ le' bzhi pa/ si rong (gseb rong )༄ gi lo rgyus/ gcig sakhyon dang sde dud 'go dpon khral rigs sogs/si rong zhes pa'i sa cha'i chags tshul ni shar sbra ga dang sa —'dres yin la/ lho 'bri gung gter sgrom dang sa 'dres/ nub phyogs rwa sgreng dang sa 'dres/ byang phyogs dmar yong dang dga' ldan dang sa 'dres bcas yin/ shar nub bar nyin lam gnyis tsam dang / lho byang bar nyin lam gcig yod pa'i sa dbyibs sa khongs nar mo zhig yin/ smi thi gtsang po rong 'di rgyud nas 'bab cing ri klung tshang ma shing rigs sna tshogs kyi nags tshal yin/ sde rgya chen po med cing dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs dud grangs chig brgya bcu skor zhig yod/ sde dud byung snga ba stag la dang /phyug po/ hor dkar gsum ni 'go dpon yongs khungs yin la khral pa'i gtso bo yang red/ de min rus rgyud/ btsan tsa dang /she ma/ 'od ru/ zur chung / khre kha/ snye ba/ bag 'go/dud gsar/ gtsang pa mgar ra/ sba chung / sba chen/ lhas sdo/'bo pa sogs yin/'go dpon rim byung ni/ bag mgo snyan grags/ de rjes brgya dpon chos bzang / sba chung byams pa/ mgar ra dpal 69

rgyarma / 'or dalar ma nor/ thor dkar baya nga drung / thor sna 7 ribasgo dkar ma ror ne brgya dpon byed rgyu ni/ dmangs kyi re 'demaca/ byas rnga4 dang / 'a bri gung bla brang gis chog mchan sprad nas dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur bar brgya dpon byas pa red/ rgan po rjes ma ni 'ur chung mi 'gyur zer ba de yin/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi mi ser rkyang ru zer ba dud grangs 20skor yod pa deng skabs si rong khungs su tshud yod/ khral rigs skor/phyi khral dang nang khral gnyis 'jal dgos pa las phyi khral sde pa gzhung la rgyal po lo mjal la khral mar lha khal 2༷0tsam 'jal dgos pa dang da dung dga' ldan khri thog la mar khal 20tsarma 'jal dgos/ nang khral 'bri gung bla brang la mar khal 150 da dung bka' brgyad dkar mar lha khal 70tsam phyur skya 'bo 20tsam/'bri gung rdzong la sgrub pa tshogs byed mar slong khal 50tsam dngul khral pho lo la ga dngul zer ba'i bod dngul srang 60tsam/ mo lo la sba 'dur zer nas dngul srang 60tsam re dgos/rkang 'gro rta khal mi gsum khral rgyug dgos pa ni/ bod zla dang po nas bod zla bzhi pa bar 'bri mthil mdun du si rong gi sa tshig sgugs dgos/ yig skyel a drung / bod dmag khar 'gro tshur yong sogs dang rgya stong mar dos/ bod dmag khar 'gro rnams rdzong skyel ra se nas gtsang rog bar sa skyel dang / ra se nas ja gsal bar dang tshur yong rnams ra se nas/ mal gro gong dkar bar rdzong skyel/ ra se nas la 70

bdun bar sa skyel bcas red/ gnyis pa/ thonakhungs dang ri chuyul gom sogs/thon khungs dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ g.ya' gro gro ma sogs sne kha grangs drug cu tsam yod/ shug pa/ spa ma/ lcang ma sogs shing sna sne tshang tsam yod/ gter kha/ rdo sol phran bu yod skad 'dug bya rigs/ gong mo/ khu byug bya ngar/ srig pa/phug ron sogs gtso bo byas pa'i bya rigs grangs sum cu tsam yod/gcan gzan rigs/ gzig gsa'/ spyang ki/ 'khar ba/dred mong / dbyi sogs dang / ri dwags sha ba/ gla ba/ rna ba/rgo ba bcas dang / da dung stag ma khra ril wa mo/ og dkar/ri zhim/ til lo/ grum pa/ 'phyi ba bcas yod pa red/ ri chu ni ri klung nag gseb kyi rong du smi thi gtsang po rgyug khul gyi lung pa yin pa/ ri 'dabs dang ri sked la shing sna sna tshogs kyi rgyan du spras pa/ ri rtse la rdza dang / g.ya'/ gangs sogs kyi ri bo 'am mkhar rgyal mtshan bsgreng pa 'dra ba/ dbyar gyi dus su rtsi shing me tog sna tshogs bzhad pa/ sman gyi dri zhim 'thul bas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i lung pa zhig yin/yul srol goms gshis skad lugs sogs phal cher sba ga rdza 'bed sogs gcig mtshungs red/ mi 'dra sa/ nag mo'i mgo chas lan shub skra sgor gyi tshab tu/ rgyab gzhung la tshe khra zer ba'i ras steb khra bo zhig gi thog tu/ g.yu dngul 'thum ma gcig bstar gang byang rgyag srol yod pa red/ bza' zla yod pa la dpral g.ya ririg shā/11ra ci — — ——— /de/—

yod pa ma zad/ bu mo go ma yang spu shu zer ba'i g.yu zhig la 'dogs srol yod/thon skyed byed thabs 'brog las sogs sbra ga rdza 'bed gcig mtshungs thog phran bu'i ri dwags rngon rgyag pa dang / tshwa len rgyu gnyis shugs che tsam yod pa red/dus chen lo gsar snga phyi gnyis ni sba ga rdza 'bed gcig mtshungs red/ rta rgyug dus snga tsam yod pa/ dbyar skyid 'go tshugs skabs 'bri bla'i gnyer pa ngos phebs thog tshwa len gra sgrig byed rgyu dang / rta rgyug tshar rjes mgyogs dar tshan grangs sogs 'bri bla'i gnyer tshang nas zabs tsam gnang srol yod pa red/mnyam du 'bri bla'i 'debs tshwa yang rong pas len dgos kyi yod pa red/ sngon byang spyi lha'u rta ra'i skabs gser rdung khram skor gtor sa yang si rong gi sa 'dir yin/ de'i gnas tshul byang rigs tsho ba'i lo rgyus su gsal bas 'dir ma bris/༄khya/ le'u lnga pa/ byang smi thi kha'i lo rgyus/gcig sa babs chags tshul dang gnam gshis sogs/smi thi kha zer ba byang thang sla nga'i mthil lta bu zhig yod pa sa babs ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre lnga stong lhag gi mtho tshad yod pa dang grang ngar che ba char dus ha cang thung thung las med pa bod zla 5pa'i zla dkyil du gzhi nas char 'bab 'go tshugs pa dang zla 7pa'i 72

zla mjug nas babs tshad kha ba la gyur gyi yod/ ri rnams kyi rtse mor dar dkar gyi la thod gyon pa ltar gyi dbyar dgun med par 'khyag rum stug pos khengs yod/ smi thi stod kyi ze rag pa zhes pa'i rdza ri de mtho tshad ha lam spyi khre bdun stong yas mas yod pa de bod khams sa yi ze ba yin pa'i shod srol yod/ dgun dus klung gzhung yongs la gangs kyis bkab nas 'phying dkar bting ba glubazhin skya leb kyi song ba ni mig rgyang mi chod pa yin/ dbyar dus shin tu nyams dga' ba'i gnas shig yin pa ste phyogs dang phyogs mtshams tshang ma spang ljang gi ne seng 'khor ra 'khor yug yin pa (bye thang sa lhad mya ngam thang lta bu btsal kyang mi rnyed pa )der rtsi me tog 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar yod la/ mtshams mtshams su mtsho dang mtshe'u phra rgyan btabs pa ltar mchis mtsho ra ga pa zer ba'i rdza ri rin chen zur brgyad kyi dbyibs mtshungs shig yod pa de'i gsham phyi ba nya ga zer ba der lo rabs brgyad bcu pa'i nang sa gshis ོbrtag dpyad pa'i shod tshul la 'di rgyud sa 'og gi brag ri nag 4chags rtse rgas ('bri ru rdzong khongs ) bar yod 'dug zer/ smi thi'i phyogs bzhi'i ri rnams sku mgron sgrig pa ltar mtha' nas skor yod la lung 'go shar la snyas shing lha sa'i skyid chu'i chu 'go smi thi kha la thug pa yin 4'bri ru'i lo rgyus nang lho skyid chu sngon mo shar nas nub tu 'bab pa'i 'go bos zer ba'ang 'di la go ba yin/ smi thi stod phu mtsho gong 'og gi mtsho rnga de rim 'bab smi thi rmad rgyud la slebs skabs smi thi gtsang po zer ba dang de nas sbra ga 'od sna si rong sogs rgyud nas 'bri gung klung shod nas 'bab pa'i chu de yin/deng gtsang po gcig dang cha bo gnyis ces pa'i lha sa'i skyid chu'i cha ri mi rwarto/)ri ba

'go la gnas yod/ smi thi kha'i 'khor yug rgya khyon ni phyogs bzhi'i ri bo ste/ shar ka ba ze dang / lho gu yer rdza/ mdung ri/nub sha mdangs smug mo byang sbo ba ra dkar bcas kyi nang tshud der smi thi zhes 'bod sa mtshams sa 'brel gtso bo shar nas bu rdzum dang /lho lha ri rtswa bza nub nas 'bri gung sbra ga byang nas nag chu rdzong dang 'bri ru rdzong gi sa mtshams bcas yin pa red/ shod srol la smi thi zer ba'i ming de sngar jo bo smi thi ja sna yun ring bzhugs myong bas ming de byung ba red zer/ 'on kyang khong bod kyi btsan po srong btsan gong du thon pa yin na de ga 'grig pa dang / de min srong btsan gyi rjes su yin na srong btsan skabs bod yul ru chen dbye ba'i nang ming 'di 'khod yod stabs 'gal bar snang bas dpyad pa 'os/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi bka' chems mthong ba don ldan nang du yul ‘ phud la smi ti lha yi lung mo che phul zer ba 'khod 'dug pas sngar 'bri gung chos rje 'jigs rten mgon po'i sbyin bdag gam khongs 'brog lta bu yin bzo yang mchis yang / hor gyi rgyal rabs don 'dus nyi zer 'dra ba'i nang / lha rgyal dar gyis hor tsho gcig sgyur bzo skabs kyi rting ma gleng skabs 66de rjes nag shod la rgyug rkyang khyim gzhung la dmag sgar brgyab/ 'bes sngo leb kyis nas khal brgyad cu phul/ nag shod tsho drug mgo btags zhus/de rjes lha ri ar rtsar rgyug smi thi gzhung la dmag sgar brgyab/smad ma khag gsum mgo btags zhus 7 zer ba 'khod 'dug par 'di'i smad ma khag gsum zer ba de nag bur sen gsum la go dgos 'dug pas de 'brel dpyad rgyu yod par snyams/smi thi kha ni phyogs gcig nas sa rgya yangs shing rtswa chu 'dzoms 74

pa dang / sa shed bzang bas phyugs rigs dkar nag skye 'phel 'gro ba'i 'brog sa dwangs ma de yan med pa zhig red la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas grangs lhags che zhing rang byung gi gnod 'tshe gangs nyen sogs phog mang sa/ dgra jag gis 'tshe ba che sa bcas yin la lam la bgrod skabs kyang na ru na 'khor che bas sa rgyus med pa 'gro khag po yod pa bcas la brten ngag rgyun du che byang smi thi'i byang lam bar ma la/ rta 'do ba med na sa mi bgrod/ rgyab me mda' med na mgo mi thon/ gos dgun rtsag med na lus mi drod/ bu byaspu 11:skuthen mi 'edro chen 19 spre'u /spro:pertsisangang sdi/jirngo thad zug/ shur thag/ thab bsdo 95 ngasdo/ phu mtsham stod la rang byung khams kyi gsang ba lta bu nyams mtshar ba zhig mthong byung yod pa ni/ ri rtsed zer ba de red/ dgun zla bcu pa bcu gcig pa'i nang mtshan mo gnam g.yer (dwangs ba )zhing nang par nyi ma ri rtser thog mar phog skabs smad nas yar lta dus stod kyi ri rnams 'phur ba dang rgyug pa/ khang pa dang mi rta'i gzugs sogs mngon rgyu yod pa zhig yod/ de skabs skabs las rtag par med/ der tshan rig gis brtag dpyad byed myong med/smi thir rang byung gi gter kha thon khungs gter kha dang sman rigs srog chags sogs gang 'tshams yod pha lam dkar po dang /ko ro dkar po/ cong zhi phug ron ske/ lhang mtsher rdo mnyen/zha rdo sogs yod la/ gser dang dngul lcags gzi bcas yod pa'i ngag rgyun tsam las dngos su thon pa ma byung / sman rigs ni dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu dang g.ya' gro gnyis phran tsam las mi thon de min dma' sar mi skye mtho sar skye ba'i sngo yi bu mo spun gsum dang /zil pa rigs lnga gtsos sman sna mang tsam skye ba bcas yin/ de 75

—yang mi kham chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas skyes tshad mthong tshad sman du ma song na/ nyams chung dbul phongs nad de ci yis gso zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ phu mda' ri klung shog gsum sman rigs med sa med pa khyab yod/ mtho sar mi skye dma' sar skye ba'i lcum zhes pa de yang sa khag gsum la nyung ngu re skye ba yin/ rtsa ba'i srog chags rigs ni/ sngar smi thi la 'brong yod pa rgan rabs tshos shod rgyun tsam las deng dngos su med par gyur rung / de min gyi ri dwags rkyang dang / gnyan rna rgo sogs yod cing / gcan gzan rigs/dred dang / gsa'/ g.yi/ spyang ki/ wa/ spe/ phyi ba/tis lo/ ri zhim/ sgrum pa/ kre mong bcas yod/ smi thi la mtsho che chung sum cu lhag tsam yod pa der gnas khrung khrung dang ngang ngur sogs chu bya'i rigs 'khor sdod byed cing / nya sbal lcong gsum sogs chu gnas mang po yod pa smos ci dgos/gnyis/ chokhongs dang khral khrims dpon rigs sogs skor/bcings 'grol gyi gong du smi thi ni hor tsho'i khongs 'bri ru rdzong zhabs kyi char gtogs pa'i yul sde zhig red/ de'ang smi thi smad ni 'gom tsho pa'i yung dkar shog hril pos gtso bo byas pa zhig yin pa dang / stod ni 'bri ru tsho pa'i skyar rgyud dang phyung rgyud shog kha'i shas sogs kyi gtso byas khra ring dang / rag shi'i sde sogs 'dus yod pa yin la stod la bu rdzum sde yang cha shas sdod pa red/khral khrims sgrub rgyug ni/ tsho khongs so so'i khungs su tshud pa 76

— yin pas 'bri ru rdzong tsho'i lo rgyus las gsal ba ltar ma gtogs skyar zlos mi dgos snyams nas ma bris/ smi thi 'dir sa babs gnas tshul gyi rkyen pas sngar nas phyogs gzhan gyi khral dud yun ring ngam/ gnas skabs kyi gnas sdod byed mkhan yod pa yin/ lo lha'u(/spros /khye/1jo //sgyu 1dro/ /rje/ 151/trī/rabs lnga bcu pa mjug tu khams nga nga sa mang thir slebs sdod byas pa red/ 1959lo zing 'khrug zhod — —'jags btang ba dang / sgol gsum gnyis phan gyi srid jus lag bstar skabs smi thi 'di bzhin shan gyi rim pa ldan pa'i dmigs bsal sa khul zhig 'dzugs myong ba red/smi thir gnas sdod yul sde'i 'go pa'i nang nas mi rabs drug tsam ring dpon ming bgrang rgyu yod cing / ming grags kyang cung zad yod pa ni 'gom yung dkar brgya dpon red/ (yung dkar dpon yang zer )'di thog ma'i mi rgyud smad mgo log mkhar rna nas yin pa'i mgar ba zhig yin pa dang / nag shod yul rong du yod der kon lha bus rdzus bu zer ba'i yung dkar rgyal mtshan zhes pa byung 'di ba pho rtsal sna dgu la mkhas zhing dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la gzengs su thon pa'i lo rgyus sgrung 'dra ba zhig mchis/ rmis ltas la gzhigs nas smi thir gtan sdod byas na bzang po yod lugs kyis smi thi 'jon sna khug la sdad/ de nas yung dkar sde'i 'go dpon du 'gyur pa dang slar yang sdod gnas g.yang ra la spos/ am pas sprad pa'i bka' yig dang thob thang rag tog dang dung tog sogs yod cing / smi thi kha'i dgra sgo bkag mi zer ba'i ming grags che ba zhig yin 'dug gsham 'og a phrug dpung can yang yod pas skabs der shod srol du/ dgra rgyab na 'jon sprin gnyis mtshon gyi 77

dpa' lung yin zhes dang / gzhis sdad na skyid sog gnyis gos kyi gong ba yin zer rgyun chags 'dug mi rabs gnyis pa yung dkar chos mdzad zer ba dang / gsum pa yung dkar mdangs shel zer/ 'di'i skabs hor tsho so dgu de bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bzung ste mkhan chung grags rnam hor spyi byed pa'i skabs yin 4dug mi rabs bzhi pa yung dkar dbang rgyal brgya dpon go gnas pha shul bu 'dzin byas pa dang / hor spyi khyung ram pa'i skabs 'bri ru'i sha bo dpon tshang gi sde gzhung gtogs pa'i rus ming khyung rgyud yin pa'i khyim dud gnyis kyi rtsod gzhi byas te kha mchu thug skabs khra ma yar rdzogs byas pa'i nag nyes bkal nas dbang rgyas rta lcag gzad dgos byung bar nad ma theg par rma shul thum po sgril nas lha sar gzhung gtug phyin pa dang zhu tshig ra 'khrod byung bas khyang ram gnas dbyang btang ba'i cha rkyen gras sa 'gyur yod pa red/sa rwa rigi ༅ ri rgyadabang rgyal 'di spyi tshogs thog ming grags che tsam yod de'i bu mi rabs lnga pa ni yung dkar lha rnam zer ba ming chen zhig byung yod/dpa' rtsal ldan la gtam yig 'dzoms pa gang spyi'i bya bar 'jug pa zhig yod pas brgya dpon go gnas rgyun 'khyongs khar lo nyer lnga'i thog 'gom tsho pa'i dpon tshab byas te dem ji'i khul du dgra gyod don rkyen 'dom par phyin nas rang sde bcu bzhi tshur blangs pa dang de min sa cha gzhan nas kyang 'gom gyi sde 'thor thems dud nyi shu skor tshur 'gug byas te sde don 'grub pa ma zad/ phyogs gzhan dang mthun gshib bde 'jags kyang byung yod pa red/ de bzhin 'bri gung sbra gar sa tshig dang / sa gyod rtsod gzhi skor la rgyal kha thob pa'i 'jon nus che ba'i ming grags yod khong lo 27thog khral pa 78

them dud gsum gyi rta jag pas ded song zhes thos ma thag tu a phrug dwang yul sder len rgyag long med par sngar gyi snyan grags dang /tsha kha/ gzi brjid sogs la blos bkal nas khong bu spun gargum nang g.yog kha shas bcas ra mdar song bas nyin mtshan khyed gnyis kyi thog u thog spom rong zer sa nas rjes zin 'thab ra sprod skabs sa stabs dang lag snga phyis rkyen pas brgya dpon lha rnam de gar dkrong pa dang spun gnyis gri bton nas mchong rung nus pa ma thon par spun rnams jag pas bkum pa red/ de'i bu mi rabs drug pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nar son pa dang las 'gan rgyun 'dzin byas yod pa dang deng skabs khong nag chu sa gnas srid gros gyi rgyun las u yon yin/ yung dkar shog la de min brgya dpon khur myong ba dang 'go pa brgya dpon skyid 'grub zer ba/ brgya dpon a khang zer ba/ spyi mi nor rgyas zer ba/ rgan po mang gar dga' dang /thang stod dpal 'byor/ 'jo dge legs bcas zer ba yod/yung dkar la them grangs 12༷yas mas yod/ brgya mgo'i a ma ni rkyang ri dkon mchog dang / tshag gsum rgyal mtshan gnyis red/sde dud kyi rus ming ngam/ dud ming gtso bo/ yon tshang dang /ban dkar/ khyung rgyud/ btsan 'go/ thang stod/ rkyang ru/lha bzo/ 'brong ngu/ tshag gsum/ mdo ba/ sga ba/ ar rgod/ bes rdzi/ bo na khro thung gtsang pa sogs red/smi thi stod la chags pa'i 'bri ru'i sde dud gtsos pa'i rus ming dud ming gtso bo 'di tsho yod/ skyar rgyud/ khyung rgyud/ nag rgyud/ 'jon 'dra/ hor dkar/ go ngan/ kha re bcas yin la/ yang phyogs gang sa nas yong ba'i rus ming / dog long /79

nong chen/ ar rtsa/ rke/ ri/ 'i/ 'brong pa sogs yin/smi thi stod smad la bsdoms dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs them dud brgya dang bdun cu skor yod/ stod kyi 'go ba rgan po ni/rag shi rab brtan/ mkha' re a rgya/ sgrub sde'i sga ba tshe 'khel bcas dang / smi thir 'bri ru ba'i khyung rgyud bsod nams khra ring shog kha'i dmar kham rgan po bkra shis rdo rje dang ka rong rgan po bco lnga bcas de tsho mi drag gtso che zhig yin pa red/༄7/ le'u drug pa/ snye bo'i lo rgyus/dang po/ sa yul dang mi sde chags tshul chab dpal darargud sogs kyi skor/snye bo lung pa zer ba der/ lo chung zhes pa'i lung pa'i lho phyogs ni brag gsum dang 'brel ba/ lho stod rgya mda' gla ru dang 'brel ba/ nub byang ni rgya glag thang dang 'brel ba/ byang phyogs ni shug stag stag sting dang 'brel ba/ byang smad ni rngod a mdo dang 'brel ba/ shar phyogs ni spo bo brag gad dang 'brel ba/ phu rnams gangs ri dkar po rtse mo gnam la zugs 'dra gtso bo ni sha yo gangs dkar zer ba'i yul lha dang / de bzhin ga par bcu gsum zer ba'i gangs ri rngam brjid can ha cang mang po yod pa de 'dra re'i mdun du mtsho re chags/ lung pa'i mda' na spyir btang nags tshal stug po yin pa bya dang bye'u sna tshogs skad snyan gyis yid 80 ༄

dbang 'phrog pa/ dpyid dbyar gyi dus su char rgyun dang / smu4 sprin sogs tsa ri tra dang ha lam 'gran nus pa phu la dgun dus su dar dkar gyi yol ba rkyang pa ltar skya theng nger yod pa/ chu bo rnams ca co'i sgra med pa grong pa phan tshun 'khyag pa'i steng du la ma bu bgrod nus pa/ stod smad kyi bar yang 'grim 'grul gyi lam 'phrang gcig las med pa nags kyi tshang 'tshengs rab tu 'khrigs pa 'i skabs 'gar nyi zla'i 'od mi gsal ba'i nags khrod yod pa dang /rdzong zhabs sa cha dma' shos su rtsi chog pa rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 2༷00lhag tsam yod pa/ gna' rnga mo'i dus la stod la gangs dang / smad la mtsho yin pa bar mtshams zhig sa stod kyi gangs zhu ba dang / smad kyi mtsho bri nas gangs dang nags 'brel ba'i sa der mi rgod dang / spra spril/ stag gzig sogs gcan gzan gyis bzung nas sdad yod pas lo rgyus mang dag zhig 'dug de'i rjes su mi sde thog mar byung tshul skor lha sgrung lta bu shod srol 'dug par snyigs dor bcud len gyis dpyad mdzad 'os de yang byang phyogs shug stag rong gi phyug po gang bzang zhes pa la lha mi 'brel ba'i bu gsum dang bu mo bzhi dang bdun yod pa'i bu gsum ni shes rig dang mda' rtsal ldan pa dang bu mo bzhi gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba mgo la g.yu rgyan dang /skad la dung chab gdams pa/ dung gi phe tsha la dngul gyi g.yer khas kha'i brgyan am khrag rdo'u btab pa/ lag tu 'ur rdo thogs nas sha ba dang dred mang bzhon nas gtsang chab phan tshun skyod nus pa 'ga' byung / de'i dus su bu mo gcig ni rngod rgyal ba phyug bdag sar bag mar btang ba'i rgyas stag mo 'dzum skyid du grags pa 81

yin zhes dang bu gsum ni yul lha'i bu dang / gnam lha'i bu/gnas po'i bu zer ba'i bu gsum yod pa khong gsum gyis nyin zhig ri dwags sngon du song ba'i gnam lha'i bu lam yan du song nas gangs kyi gser bar 'brug nyal ba'i rna bar lhung nas dpyid gar 'brug nam mkhar song ba'i gnam lha'i bu steng phyogs lha yul du slebs/ yun mi ring bar lha dang 'khon nas lhas mi yul du bkar ba'i sa der da lta lha skal rtse zhes ming chags 'dug gnam lha'i bu yul der sa chags pa'i ming la gong ma 'brug lha rgyal po zhes zer/stod nags ri'i rdza mtshams su sdad pas gong ma rdza gong kha ma zhes yang zer srol yod/ yul lha'i bu dang gnas po'i bu gnyis ga ring chu rgyud nas song bas thang dkyil zhig tu 'byor nas thang der ri dwags sha ba brgya lhag tsam phyu dang phyu byas nas zas la gram pa dang nyal bas khong gnyis mthong ba dang sha ba nag po rwa ldebs can gzhan las bong tshad che tsam zhig 'dug pa de'i sna bshu dang lag bro 'khrab pa'i sha ba rnams la gram lung gram du song bas de ma thag rngod pa gnyis kyis mda' re 'phang bas sha ba lnga re zang thar du phug pa ma tshad mda' mo spang khar gzug pas sa der sha ba spang mda' zhes grags pa byung de nas sngon pa gnyis slar yang ga ring chu rgyud ded nas lung pa'i mda' la slebs pa'i lung pa de rgya che la yid du 'ong ba zhig byung ba'i gnas po'i ri sreb ri nags kyi dkyil du sdad pa'i cha yan nag grong kha ba zhes pa'i sde gcig byung / phu la bla mtsho chags/ming la nag ro mtsho zer/ yul lha'i bu nyin ri'i shar ngos su sdad pa'i shar grong khang ba zer ba byang / sa der gnam gshis bzang la drod grang snyom pa 'bru rigarlo kyi skye dngos ha cang bzang ba'i lo 82

rer ston thog thengs re nas gnyis gsum bar bsdu ba 'bru rigs dang shing thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa ma zad lhag par gnas po'i bu nyin gyi nub ngos su chags pa'i spyir 'bru sran gang yang 'debs kyi yod pa lhag par gtson sgog dpe med tshar yod pa nyin ngos nas 'phrad la 'gyel skabs srib ri'i ngos su rtse mo slebs pa'i mi rnams thams cad ngo mtshar te btsod dang sgog skya'i ming la snye'u zer ba'i ming de sa cha la btags nas rnye bo zhes grags so ces pa'i lo rgyus gleng srol yod/ lung pa'i stod smad la rnye bo stod smad zhes pa'i ming rgyun 'jags pa red de'i rjes sde dud rim bzhin 'phel rim byung ba ni 'brong la rgyal ba rgya mtsho bu sdug tshang bar grong pi rti pha ma ge sgal tshang / pha rtog mi drag rgyal ba/ padma bstan 'dzin tshang /grong bdag skyid dga' bcas chags pa dang / de'i rjes rim bzhin grong tsho dgu bo de gzhis chags nas 'phel rgyas byung ba ma zad rnye stod gong ma rdza 'go kha ba zer ba yang chags nas mi rabs mang dag song rjes stod kyi gangs zhu nas grong chags pa'i thog mar srag ma zhes pa grong pa der smad nas sde rim bzhin 'phel rgyas song ba'i nang g.yung drung dpal ldan zer ba byung ba des srag ma'i sa der rgyab ri bkra shis rtags brgyad sa gzhi padma 'dab brgyad/ gnam bla bre sngon po/ 'go phyogs klu yi pho brang / mdun ri glang chen 'gying 'dra/ shar ri dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs lhag par sa der rgyun du zhogs par char dang smug zhag na bun thul yod pa ha cang rtags bzang po mngon nas khong sa der chags pas rim bzhin do srag gnyis dang / rtsi 'bras gnyis/ dpyi rong gnyis kyis gtsos me dud brgyad cu zer ba'i grong tsho zhig byung / de nas 83

spo bo āḥ gnam rgyal rabs 2 1nyi ma rgyal po'i dus ka rgyan pho stog snying rdzong zer ba'i rdzong zhig chags sa gnas der stag gzig dom dred mi rgod sogs kyi 'thab rtsod byed pa de'i sngon mi rgod kyi lo rgyus mang dag zhig bshad srol 'dug kyang 'dir ma bris/ de nas sa zhing gsar bzo dang lcags zhu ba/ gser 'don pa/ phyugs skyong ba sogs kyi bya bar brten nas bde skyid kyi snyan grags che tsam byung nas mi rabs kha shas song rjes rdzong yang je btsan du song ba dang chabs cig sa khral/ lcags khral/ gser khral/ nor phyugs kyi khral sogs bsdus pa ma zad snga dro ri ma'i 'gro lam bkag pa'i mdun ri shing kham spi ri rta so snyed pa nas gcod dgos zer bka' phabs pas mi thams cad 'dus nas ci drag gi gros gzhi byas kyang ri bo gtor ba'i sems shugs ni mi gcig la ma byung thams cad 'u thug gi smre ngag der re sdad pa'i mi zhig gis smre ngag bton pas phan pa med/ nor bu phyung mdog la kha la/ bya mi res skad re ma rgyab na/ ri ske gcod rgyu'i gros mi mthun/ re re bzhin skad cha shod dgos zer bas bud med rgas mo zhig gis gzhan thabs ma rnyed na/ ri ske las dpon ske snyi gi red zer bas mi thams cad kyis de la gros mthun thag der bcad nas log rdzong la 'byor nas mi ser tshang mas rdzong dpon gyi sku mdun bcar te rdzong dpon lags nga rang rnams kyis rdzong dpon rin po che'i bka' rtsal dang du len pa yod rung / ri bo mtho dman tshad gzhi tshod gam ma theg pa'i sku mdun ma bcar thabs med song ba'i da ni sku ngos rin po che rgyab ri'i ngos nas spi ri rta so mtho dma' gong nas gcod dgos phyag mdzub kyis tshad gzhi gnang grub pa zhu rgyu yin zhes zhus pas 84

rdzong dpon thugs dgyes te ja chang a rag sogs khyer nas dbu ri'i ngos su a rag btung nas dga' spro'i ngang nas der sdad dasong mo log khar rdzong dpon gyis spi ri rta so rnyed pa nas gcod rgyu'i mdzub mo'i tshad gzhi len skabs phan tshun gcig gis gcig la mig brda dang ki sgra sgrogs te rdzong dpon de gar dmar bsad btang nas slar mi rnams rdzong la 'byor ba dang / gzhan tshos rdzong dpon gar phebs ces dringatha pas rdzong dpon ni 'jam rting 'gro song zer ba'i da lta sa der 'jam rting zhes ming du grags yod/ de'i rjes nga ring bya pho mtshal dmar yag zer ba'i snye bo stod smad thams cad ka brgyan pho rog snying rdzong 'og tu 'dus dgos par gda'/ mi rabs kha shas song rjes me dud nyung du song / dpalama'abyor je zhan du song / de nas bar 'tshams zhig tu 'bum dmag lha sgral sreng 'brug dgon byang chub gling zer ba chags nas stobs che ru song / phyogs kyi grwa rgyun mang po grwa sa der bzhugs pa dang pho rog snying rdzong gi dbang cha thams cad dgon pa des bzung nas rdzong tshab zhig kyang bskos pa/ snye bo stod smad thams cad mi 'dus yig drug zer ba'i sa der 'dzoms nas khral rigs bsdu ba dang phan tshun gros kha'i rigs gong gi bka' 'beb la gzhigs nas der thag gcod dgos pa snang / rjes su rdzong 'go des sger gcod las gong la stun gyi med pa red bar mtshams zhig la lha skal ting 'brug byang chub gling ni spo bo ku: gnam rgyal pos ltag 'gra la song zhes pa'i lung zhig la rten nas spo bor dmag phabs nas rdzong dgon gnyis ka gtor nas med par bzos yang mi rgod je mang du song nyin la mi'i bya ba ci byas na'ang / mtshan mo mi rgod kyis ltad mo lta bar byas 85

nas mi rgod kyi gnod 'tshe tshabs che tsam byung rabs 'dug mi dang mi rgod kyi 'thab rtsod byas pa'i lo rgyus mang tsam yod rung 'dir ma bkod mthar mi rgod rnams rim bzhin rdzogs nas med/ de'i skabs kyi mi rgod kyi zhing kha dang brtsegs pa skas ring ka ba sogs da lta rming dong yod bzhin pa 'dug de'i rjes su kuX gnam rgyal pos snye bo stod smad thams zam gdong rdzong 'og tu 'du dgos pa bzos nas ka chen pho rog snying rdzong mjug rdzogs nas zam gdong rdzong mi rabs kha shas song rjes zam gdong rdzong thang stod dpon bkra zer bas bdag po byas nas spo bo gaX gnam dang bod sa gnas sri da gzhung gnyis la khral 'jal khrims 'khur gyi bya ba 'brel thag bcad nas lo kha shas song rjes bod dma' phab pa dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung slar 'bru bla dgon gyi ser dmag rgyab snon bskul ba'i thabs jus la rten nas zam gdong rdzong phabs dpon bkra dpon blon po gnyis bsad/ dpon bkra'i go lag gong 'bul byas pa de 'bru bla dgon gyi mgon khang sgor btags yod pa/ rig gsar skabs bar mthong rgyu yod pa red/ de skor lo rgyus mang dag zhig yod 'dug kyang sgrung gtam ltar song bas snyigs dor bcud len tsam las ma bkod/slar zam gdong rdzong ༷: gnam pas bzung de'i rjes su bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / maḥ gnam 'khrug skabs gaḥ gnam rgyal po lho yul nas rgya gar bros snye bo zam rdzong bod kyis bzung ba red/ sa gnas srid gzhung gis spo bo bzung rjes/ snye bo dum bu gnyis bgos te/ snye bo smad yid 'ong rdzong gi 'og la bsdus/kham khongs su bcug snye bo stod lha ri rdzong 'og la rtswa za ru bzhi'i 86

gras bsnon brgyab stod smad bar la spa lung rdo mig zer ba'i sa cha dpyad mtshams bzos/ snye bo stod la dbyi dkar lding dpon dang /srag ma lding dpon gnyis bsko bzhag byas nas gzhung khral ske leb sgur gsum bzos nas lding dpon mi rabs bdun brgyad tsam song 'dug lding dpon zer ba bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis gnang ba'i go ming yin pa dang de'i gong du rgya dpon zer ba dang nang gses rgyal dpon kha shas yod pa bcas yin/ rting ma'i srag ma lding dpon bkra shis dang / dbyi dkar lding dpon chos dbyings yin pa de gnyis 1959lo'i rjes sa gnas srid gros kyi u yon red///// //// /rdo/rdo 11rdo //// //// ////////ga sa pa/ nang byung da sa dang chu yul ngas gas na/ ( 1) snye bo'i lung par nags tshal shing cha'i thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod pa shing rigs mi 'dra ba 'di ltar yod pa ste/'bras ldan kham shing star shing dang / srom dkar nag sgron shing / smyug ma/ be shing / shug pa/ stag pa/ sbyar pa/skyer pa/ dmar mo/ mdzo mo shing / 'ol mo shing / lcang ma/stag ma/ spen ma/ 'om bu/ tsha ru/ su ru dkar nag gro gag shing / gla rogs shing / kun ṭa ka ri dbyi mong / ko langs shing / shākya shing / se ba shing / gser shing / rgya shing / mtsher dkar/ skrag shing / nya 'khrug tshar bong shing /u shu shing / smyag shing / 'brug shing / spa shug bse shing /glang ma bcas ning sna bzhi bcu yas mas su yod/ sman rtswa'i rigs kyi rnam grangs/ rtag ngu rigs 2 rtsa mkhris 2 ba sha 287

ming can 2 a ba 〈 klu bdud 2 ri ra : spru ba 2 sro lo 2 nyig ta 2 sa 'dzin 2 lcags tig 2 mkhan pa 2tsha ba 2 re rkon 2 spang rgyan 2 glang rna 2 lug ru 2khur mang 2 'jib rtsi 2 spyi lce 2 thang khrom 2 rtsad 2a krong 2 nem pa 2 phur mong 2 bdud rtsi 5 rtsa ba 5shang dril 4 hong len 1 rta pags 1 sro gong / g.ya' phyi/gnyen 'dus/ sgod spos/ gnyan thub/ bya rgod sog pa/rgyad pa'i spyan can/ mtsher sngon/ sngon bu/ khron bu/ de wa/stabs seng / gza' sdum/ u dpal/ lug chung / lug migargu drus/ chu 'jom/ chu ma rtsi/ ga dur/ byi shang dkar po/thar nu/ gser me/ khyung sder/ spang rtsi/ lo btsan/ pa yag snyi ba/ 'bu su hang / 'dam bu/ ka ra/ yog po/spor/ 'bam po/ rang spun/ da ba/ chu lcam/ zang rtsi/chu srin sder mo/ 'ol mo se/ brag skya ha bo/ bre gu/ gser thig go bra/ spyang mtsher/ tha ram/ na ram/ ri sho/lhum/ sga rig dbang rga/ lug mur/ mda' rgyus/ 'bri mog dug nyung / pa to la/ lhan pa tra/ sbrul zhags/ sa jig zhim thig sgang thog phrag phrog pa/ sar sā ta/gzer 'jom/ bre ga sog ka/ go nyod/ 'u su/ skam lcags rgyu/ sdam khrag gcod/ bye rug bya pho rtsi rtsi/ kyi 'brum/ 'brug shing / ka ṭas ka ri/ stag mtsher/ ltar bu/srin shing / se ba/ smyug ma/ bcas da dung sman sna kha shas yod 4tshod 'dug kyang mngos thub pa'i ldum rigs 'di tsam yod pa lags de min gyi skye dngos spang rtswa/ 'jags rtsa/ bye rtswa/ za bo sogs 88

phyugs rig gso byed sna tshogs dang / mi yis 'debs skrun byas pa 'bru rigs/ zho khog la phug pad tshal/ ku shu'i 'bras bu/si pan sogs yod pa ma zad mes rgyal nang khul nas/ shes skong gtsos 'bras ma gtogs lo rabs brgyad bcu'i nang tshod lta byed myong 'dug pas tshang ma skye tshar yong nges yin pa gdengs thub byung skad/ ( 2) gnyis re skyes srog chags la mtshon na ri dwags sha ba gla ba rigs 2 rna ba/ rgya go ra sprel sngo dmar 2 (thang sprel dang rgya sprel zer srol 'dug ) ri bong / gcan gzan rigs/dom nag dred mong / gzig 'phar ba/ wa/ 'om/ g.yi/ gsa'/ og dkar/ te lo sre mong / bra byi bcas dang / 'dab chags rigs/ rgod/ go bo/ 'ol pa khra khwa/bya dkar/ ze pho/ 'ug pa/ ko ko/ bya te/ ngang ngur/'jol mo/ mchil pa/ ze mo/ ka slog ne tsho sogs gshog ldan dang 'bu srin du mar mchis kyang / gtso chen min pas ma bris/( 2) sa phab ni stod la sa ma 'brog dang / smad la rong chen yin pa/ sa dbyibs btsan zhing / lam 'phrang dog pa/lung chu rnams zam chen med na phar tshur bgrod dka' ba bcas yod/(4)ri chu'i skor ni/ ri bo rnams spangs mtho zhing rgya che ba sa rong tsub pa/ phu yi ri bo rnams dar dkar gyi na bza' gyon pa dang mtshungs/ bar gyi ri bo rnams rtse mo brag ri dang / rked pa spang ri mtha' 'dabs nags ri stug po dang brag g.yang gzar can gyis khengs pa/ mda' yi ri bo rnams brag ri rtse mo mdung rtse blong 89

ba ltar mtho zhing rtse mo rno ba/ bar du brag rdza rngam brjid ldan pa/'dab la shing rigs sdong po dang mtsher mas kheng pa/ dmigs bsal che ba zhig la mtshon na/ srag ma shang khongs gangs ri rtse mo nas lung chu'i bar zam ma chad pa bshad srol la gzhig na lo ltar gangs je cher du rngam gyi yod 'dug pa 'dir deng skabs tshan rig gis brtag dpyad gnang rin yod pa 'dug snyam/ de min gyi nyams mtshar ba zhig la lca la khrab btsan zhes pa'i ri de'i rtse mo na dgun gyi dus su spang sngo thing nger yod pa'i khar/ shing tsa ru'i me tog dang 'dab lo sogs sngo sang nger yod pa dang / zil pa khrom mer yod pa zhig da lta'ang mthong rgyu 'dug (snye bo rked la sgron ma ri zer ba zhig 'dug de'i khyad chos dang bshad srol rnams gnas dgon gyi le'u nang gzigs na gsal )mda' la ri skad grags che ba lha mo dril bzhon zer ba sngar mo yin stabs klu sman zhig gnas pa de slob dpon pad mas bka' dam la btags nas 'brong lha mo zhes mtshan gsod ba zer srol deng skabs kyang yul des mthong chen brtsi srol lug de'i skor lo rgyus sgrung gtam 'dra ba yod pa 'dir ma bkod/ chu chen rnams dang chu phran rnams grangs las 'das pa yod kyang / nyams mtshar ba'i shod srol yod pa/ si li rdo bcag zer ba der ge sar sgrung las sngar mon shing khri'i bla gnas lcags sdig mgo dgu dang / zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum sogs kyi gnas yul ma ne ne'i lung las/ thang me long 'dra ba'i mdun ngos chu rta rnga tsam zhig 'bab sa zhes pa'i chu de yin pa'i bshad srol 'dugade nas bdud gling gi skabs dang mon gling gi skabs sogs kyi lo rgyus sa rdo mang dag zhig 'dug kyang / kha rgyun du song bas yid 90

cung the tshom du song bas 'dir bkod med/ snye bo lung pa'i phu la ri re re'i mdun du mtsho re yod kyang mtsho'i dkyil dang rgya khyon sogs phal cher gcig mtshungs yin pas re re bzhin bkod med/'on kyang dmigs bsal rang bzhin gyi khyad chos ldan yod pa/stag rong mtsho dang / phyung khri ra 'og zer ba'i mtsho gnyis kyi nang du mtsho glang dang / lug rta sogs yod pa mthong srol dang glang gi rigs yin zer ba gzhan dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba kha shas yod srol 'dug dpung dkar gzhung gi thad la rtsa ri chu 'phyar zer ba de drag char 'bebs bzhin rngam drag dang ldan pa'i chu 'phyar zhig 'bab pa de dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs bzhi bcu pa'i nang phyi gling mi zhig slebs nas de'i nang nas me tog mthong ma myong ba 'khyer song ba'i gnas tshul byung myong 'dug dbyi dkar chu 'phyar zer ba grong tsho'i nye 'dab g.yas ngos kyi ri rtse nas 'bab pa 'ur sgra brag cha 'khor 'khor zhing sbu ba 'khyil chu 'phur ba ltar yod pa nyams mtshar ba'i chu 'phyar yod pa yin/ de min gyi mtsho dang / 'bab chu chu 'phyar sogs nyams mtshar ba'i nang du nya rigs dang / sum sbal gcong chu bya'i rigs sogs tshan rig gis zhib 'jug brtag na ma gtogs nges can blo rmongs ba rnams kyis rtogs dka' ba mang po yul der yod/( 5) yul der gser dngul dang / zha nye lcags sogs yod pa'i bshad srol yod pa red/ mthong thub pa zhig la si ru ra/ya bag kā ra/ mdung rtse gsum/ ta shig rdo rgyus/ cong zhi/ma zi nag po mtshar sogs mthong thos kyi sa steng du mngon pa 'dugari ring ma sgro 91

gsum/ gom gshis chas gos yul skad sogs kyi skor/yul gyi cha lugs skad rigs mi gcig pa'i tshul mthong thos rnams mdor 'dus zhus na/( 1) yul srol skor/ rgyun gyi gom gshis skyes pa rnams ras dang / rnam bu'i stod thung dang / gos thung gis phyi la chu ba'am phal cher ni rgya lpags khrab lag zer ba rgyab mdun kha skyar gyon nas ab shag zer ba'i gri khre tsi do tsam re sked la 'dzer ba dang /gri thung re glo la 'dogs pa sogs zhwa mo khu lu'i 'phying pa'i yang zhwa mthar gos chen gyi mu sgris yod pa/ lham rnams bu'i 'bo bu zhes pa zhus rnam lham yu dang / gtsang khra'i 'gag 'khri'i rgyab pa'am/gla lpags kyi brgyan srol yang yod/ bud med rnams kyi rgyun chas ni/rang rnam phyu ba'i steng kong po'i rtsis sbris kyi mgo shus zer ba rgyab mdun kha sbyor skyer 'gab dkar po'i mtha' rgyan rgyab pa dang /sked par dngul lam lcags kyi chab ma 'ching srol yod kong zhwa mgo leb zer ba/ zhwa mo rtsi sgris nag po skye 'gab dkar pos mtha' rgyan rgyab pa sgor mo zhig la ltag rgyab nas g.yas g.yon gru rtse yod pa re gyon gyi yod pa red ske rgyan dang skra shub sor gdub lag gdub sogs gcig mtshungs red/ 'khos 'byor zhan pa rnams ko ba'i mgo shus yang gyon srol yod/ gzab 'phyor skabs skyes pa rnams gos chen phyu ba dang / 'bu ras nang 'jam sogs zhwa mo tshe ring skye 'gab dang / yang zhwa bcas gyon srol yod/ bu med rnams sprin dmar sngon gyi mgo shus sum rgyun dang gos chen bcas rma/tha' brgyan gyon srol yod/ dar phra'i nang 'jam dang ling skad sogs brgyan 92 rabye

nas rke ga g.yu byur gzi sogs kyi 'gul brgyan 'dogs srol yod/'tsho ba'i gom gshis ni ja bsu ma dang / rtsam pa sha zho sogs gcig mtshungs khar chang dang / yul bzos a rag gro'i a sgor/ khag sha/ tshal rigs/ si pan/ sgo nga / bya sha/dom dred sha dang / rgya gor spril/ gla ba/ rna ba/ nya bcas kyi sha rigs sogs rgyun spyod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang spyod srol yod/( 2) dus chen lo dus dga' ston rten 'brel srol rgyun ni bod zla 1tshes 1la mgron gyi gnam sko yin pas mal gso ba dang /de nyin zhogs pa 'bras dar bshod pa dang / tshes 2nyin nas grwa sgrig dang / mgron gyi sgo phye/ tshes 2nyin la lha gsol dang / lha tho 'am bsangs mkhar ji yod sar go rim bzhin mi tshang ma'i khrus dang gtsang sbra brgyan gos phun sum tshogs pa'i ja chang la longs spyod pa dang / bza' tung ci dgar rol zhing / shug pas gtsos shing sna dang / dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ sman sna dam rdzas—sogs sbyar ba'i gsur dang 'bru sna shel tshig dar lcogs rlang rta tshe thar ja chang phud phye mar zas phud bcas khyer te bla grwa yod rigs rnams kyis bsang dang tshogs gtor sogs dkyil 'khor bsham nas spyi sger yul lha'i bsangs mchod 'bul ba dang de dag sogs sgrub tshar nas phye mar mchod g.yang 'bod/ chang rag gis bzi nas bro 'khrab pa/ 'bras dkar bshod pa bcas byed nas phyi mgron 'bod pa'i 'go tshugs/ tshes 5la byis pa'i bsangs —mchod zhes pa yod/ tshes 12nyin bar grong chen so sor mgron 'bod pa'i goms gshis yod rung zhib phra ma bris/ yin na'ang sngar srol go rim la gzhigs na rgyu nor 'dzoms zhing / ya rabs 93

ldan pa'i mi zhig gis gtam gyi 'go mo khral 'jal na mnyam 'jal dgra 'thab na ma nyam 'thab/ rta rgyug na mnyam rgyug gur phub na kha sprod byed pa/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba'i lam lugs ma nyams par skyong / bar mtshams su sgrung rnam thar/ rgyal rabs bstan bcos/ bka' 'bum/ 'das log sogs 'don pa khag gcig de ni phyi ma'i don rkyen gyi go rda bkrol ba'i phyir dang / khag gcigagro gzhas/ glu/ gtam dpe/ 'gu mo/ lde'u/ rbad sogs ni nyams 'tshar la rgyal pham gyi shan 'byed pa khag gcig de bzhin lag rtsed la sho mig mang 'grigs rdo'u dmag rgyal po brje len/lag rdo/ 'ur rdo/ am mda'/ spen mda'/ chu mda'/smyug mda'/ me mda' phogs tsha kha 'gran pa/ rta rgyug shed 'gran rte'u 'gran pa sogs che chung rtse dga'i rgyal kham khag gcig dang / bu mo rnams yid mthun pa'i gsang brda gtong res brda lan byed skabs khag gi khongs su mdzub mo dkrol ba khag gcig gling bu dang rdza glang sogs 'dra min glu len yid sems 'khro ba byed srol khag gcig pho mo rgan gzhon rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog pa'i khrab tshan ma gcig ni ras pa zer ba pho rnams 'bu ras rkang gos thog thag khra'i thag gu'i sna cha can gyi sham thab ras dkar sngon gyi stod gos gyon nas mi re'i lag tu bsil snyan te thogs pa bu med rnams stod 'thung thog 'go shus te gyon nas lag tu rnga chung re thogs nas dang po gzhas dang / gzhas ma gtam gyi khrab ston/bar du ka la dbang mo dang 'gro ba bzang mo sogs kyi rnam thar/'dzam pa rna chad sha pho ga ga 'bum chung skyid/ sngags pa/blam rgya rta ba man rta ba yan sogs ngo mtshar can gyi rol rtsed 'dra 94

min sna tshogs dang / mjug tu ras bza' mas 'gyur stabs dang /ras rgan rnams sgra snyan thogs nas kham gzhas bod gzhas sogs kyis mtshams bcad de ma ṇi'i sngo smon brjod mthar dgon pa dang /mi drag so sos kha gtags te g.yog pa dang / 'os 'tshams kyi gco/la ras sprod cing rten 'brel gyi brda' mtshams ci rigs ma dzad mthar bza' btung gi lton mo bkyag nas grol gyi yod/'das mchod skor/ bla gra gdan zhus dang rgya mchod sogs mchod pa dang / cho ga zhe dgu sogs spyi mtshungs yin/ dur skyed skabs khag gsum la dbye nas sa 'og sbas nas der dar lcog btsugs pa dang / khag gcig dur khrod du bya gtor byed pa'am khag gcig bla grwa gdan zhu byas te sdur zhu ba sogs bcas byed srol yod/skad rigs skor/ bod skad kyi yul skad sa cha so sor cung 'dra min yod pa yin yang rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs ltar yin mod/ 'on kyang snye bo ba'i skad mkhregs tsam yod pa gsham gsal/| snye bhe /ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃrje ༵ ༵/ / ṭwāṃ /snye bhe ༵/༷ lo la 95

a dar mgyogs snang / dgagarog yag phan shor/nang pag a la la/a pa/ a log 'goms/a dar/ mar rgya/a ne/ rta bshab/kreng mo/ a 'gis/nyog spu ga sgam gzhas/bcas zer sol yod 'dugathon skyed byed stangs ni phu la sa ma 'brog khul yin pas gtso bo 'brog las dang / mda' la zhing khul yin pas zhing las ni dus tshigs bzhi la dbye dgos pa bod zla 2pa'i mjug nas gsum pa'i tshes 7—ragayas g.yon la dus tshod nges can nyi ma'i ṭwāṃ'agro phyogs rtsi shing lo 'dab rgyas tshal sa gzhi'i drod tshad sogs snga spyodwang /ste/ /bye( the:drori mi 1zig zurang mjugasnur phyar 'gyang da pa dus da dam bzung gas zhang 'dabs dgos 'bru rigs dkar nag gi snga phyi'i gong rim 'bras bu smin mgyogs zhan la 'debs las dus tshod snga phyi dgos pa las de min dmigs bsal che ba med/ de min tshal zhing dang / chang khab bcas dus tshod so sor dam 'dzin byed nas hur brtson ngang 'debs srol yod pa bcas so/

mjug byang /lha ri rdzong tsho'i lo rgyus 'di dag 'tshol bsdu rtsom 'bri byed par lha ri rdzong 'brel yod dbu khrid nas thugs khur thob pa dang /nga tsho rang ngo'i mthong thos kyi rgyu cha phran bu'i khar rdzong khongs tsho khag gram rgya che bar ma ltos par lho snye bo nas byang smi thi bar shang tsho bcu bzhi'i nang 'gro skyod kyis 'di ga'i lo rgyus rgyu cha phran tsam gsung rgyu yod pa'i bgres po ser skya rnams la ched 'dri zhus rjes sla bcos su ma song bar slar yang mkhyen ldan 'ga' zhig la'ang 'dri bsdur yang yang bgyis te ma zin bkod pa de dag sa khul srid gros lo rgyus rtsom sgrig khang la phul nas bzo bcos bskyar sgrig cung zad byung rjes yang bskyar dag zhus rags tsam byas te lha ri rdzong tsho'i thog ma'i lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha 'di dra zhig grub khul byas pa lags 'on kyang nga tshor lo rgyus dang / rig gnas kyi shes bya'i chu tshad shin tu dma' stabs/ gang sar 'tshol 'dri phyin byung / phyogs tsam las khungs 'phel shod yag nyung nyung tsam yin pa de dag phyogs bsdud byed par skyar zlos sam/ dngos 'dzol 'gro nyen 'khyad cing /lung 'dren gyi yig rigs rnying pa med pa sogs kyi rkyen pas/ lo rgyus 'dir don 'dzol yod srid pa ma zad/ tshig nor sogs ma dag pa mang po yod nges pas mkhyen ldan gzigs po rnams pas dag bcos dgongs 'char lhug rtsol yod pa zhu/'chi med rdo rje dang / sngags ru lha bstan o rgyan bstan 'phel/ a ban mi 'gyur ye shes bcas nas 1992lo'i zla tshes la/97

zi / gig mi thogano// 1 ska rjengarnaldarkarna sgo sa nyu no bsgyu ya / / / / / //sgo/ tsāsgyuskanagasga tsasga/(blo mthun mang rje rta mgrin dang ngag dbang 'jigs sgrol sogs kyis rgyu cha gnang nas 'di ga'i lo rgyus dpyad yig khang gis bsgrigs pa )1 thog ma'i gnasatshul dbang skyur skor/sngon so ga rdzong ngam gzhis khongs sa tsho shog 4 ba gsam yod rig dzotshob rig pa re dkar sog gsum ste re shod zer ba rong po dang / dkar shod zer ba cung pa/ sog ni sog shod te bod sog pa zhes pa de yin pa dang / nye 'gram khyim mtshes nags shod dang rgyal shod rngul shod sogs yod pa red/ bod chol kha gsum zhes yon rgyal rabs kyis lung gis mngag pa'i dpal ldan sa skya'i dus su chol kha dang gnyis 'byed pa'i sa mtshams sog la skya mo zer ba de sog gi g.yag la se bo 'di rang yin pa lo rgyus mkhan po tshos zhal gcig mthun yin 'dug 'di khul ni chags snga tsam gyi yul sde zhig yin tshod la 98

bde gzar dang 'pho 'gyur gyi yul dus sna tshogs brgyud yod pa red bcings 'grol zin rjes dang nye dus 'dzugs skrun sogs byed skabs sog pa dang cung pa'i nang sa 'og nas thon pa'i dur sa rdo sgrum dang / mi rta'i rus pa go mtshon chag dum dang gser shog lta bu'i dngos po zangs snod bcas thon yod pa dang / de bzhin dgon shul mchod rten li ma bcas thon yod pa red/ 'brod zla dang smyos long shang khongs su mkhar rdzong rnying pa'i shul ro yod pa yin rgan pa kha shas kyi 'di khul gna' snga mor spu rgyal btsan po srong btsan gyi gong dang po zhang zhung khri sde'i khongs yin 'dra zer ba dang de nas sum pa'i ru yi khongs yin tshod 'dra gsungs/ khyung po'i lo rgyus yig rnying khyung rabs g.yu mgo ma las khyung po stod zhang zhung khyung lung dngul mkhar nas smad du yong nas gzhis chags rjes kyi rjes tsam zhig tu 'thum rje grags pa'i dus rdzong bco brgyad rgyab nas yul sde mang por dbang mdzad rabs yod pa'i nang ‘‘sog lha ri lha rtse lha mkhar gsum/ khyung po skyid kyi mkhar gsum brdung / mi dpon dar thogs brgya re 'tshogs/ kho ngar chen mang po g.yas ru phab zer ba 'dug pa'i sog lha rtse rdzong chags sa da lta yol nag shang gi nang yod pa'i mkhar rdzong shul yang sdad yod pa red/ yang lha khyung po rgyal ba'i dus la sog g.yag la se bo phyir bcad/ gzi nag po ger pa yan chad khyung po 'bum rje'i mu thur btab 7 zer ba 'dug pas khyung po rtseg rtseg (gra rgyas pa'i skabs ) sgang sog rdzong khongs dbang bsgyur byas yod bzo mchis der ma zad 'di yul de dus kyi dgon pa che shos de sog g.yung drung gling zhes pa da lta lha rtse rdzong gi yar 'gram cham mda' yar kha ru yod pa (da lta ba sog sa 99

mtshaca/sa ba chen longs ) de khyung po dang / zhu tshang gi gdan sa tig tig gcig yi/na pa'i dgon der grwa grangs stong phrag kha shas yod lugs bon gyi lo rgyus las gsal ba ltar khyung po dpon dgon gyi gdan sa zhig kyang yin 'dug sbra chen rdzong gi bgres song kha shas kyis sngar gtam shod rgyun du lha rtse rdzong khyung pos 'dzin skabs 'bum rje grags pa'i khrims tsha bo de lag len byed pas lha rtse dil bar nas 'grul pa skyod dus dos khal yo log rgyab pa dang / g.yag gi rnga ma g.yug na che g.yag gu 'phag rgyag dang rnga ma tsub khyor ’ gyi nyes khral 'gel gyi yod red zer srol gda'/yang phag gru bka' rgyud kyi mes po lta bu rlangs a myes byang chab 'dre bkol de re dkar sog gsam yal du phebs nas 'gro don riring rid mi rir mibaskyangs ba'i lo rgyus yod 'dug rlangs kyi po ti bse tu rgyas pa las (gangs can rig mdzod ) byang chub 'dre bkol sog tu byon pa'i skor 'khod 'dug pa ste che‘stom rgyang gis sog shod mtshal chen lha khang thang phul lta ston gyis yon nag lha khang gser tog dang rgya rgya brtsegs mchod rten ra ba dang tshong 'dus yangs pa'i gru bzhi phul zhes 'khod 'dug pa ma zad yang / yon bdag rdzong gis dkar shod gong rje thang gzu gom mda' bya mchu spu le spa ru rnams kyi lha khang phul nas bra mchod du zhus so zer ba 'dug rlangs byang chub 'dre bkol ni dus rabs snga tsam la byon pa zhig yin pas 'di dus nas re dkar sog gsum du lha khang dang tshong 'dus kyi bdag po rlangs lha rigs kyis gnang gi yod par snang / de rjes chos rje garla pa sku phreng gnyis pa nas btabs pa'i re dkar sog gsum du dgon pa mang tsam yod pa ma zad sog lcags zam zer ba de yang khong gis 100

btsugaca ‘ ska da 'dir shod srol la badma par grub rtsal thogs pa med pas khri rdo gnyis kyi khongs 'bing lcags thag sgas zer sa nas zam pa'i lcags thag gter nas bzhes te sog zam btsugs pa red/zer rgyun yod pa ma zad sog zam 'gram gyi brag la kudma pa bzhugs sa'i sgrub phug yod pa dang sog chu'i chu bdag dge gnyan chen mo dam la bzhag nas gsol kha mdzad pa'i gleng rgyun 'dug sog tsan dan dgon gyi lo rgyus nang 4 jing ger gnam gyi rgyal po'i dus su byung ba'i sde la re dkar sog gsum zhes 7sogs bkod 'dug pa dang hor tsho so dgu'i spyi khyab hor rgyal po'i lo rgyus yig rnying 'di zer 'dra ba zhes pa sogs kyi nang du 7gu rong o long thā ji gtsos a chen thor pa skya bdun chu yi srib rgyud nas song ba'i sog g.yung drung gling gi thad gar phyin pa dang bod kyi tshong pa hor skad shes pa 'ga' yis lo tsā bsgyur nas khyed rnams yul gang nas 'ong ba dang don ched ci'i phyir sogs dris par skya bdun gyis nged rnams hor yul nas khyed rnams mnga' 'o ga tu btsud la yong ba yin smras pa la bod kyi rang che'i mnga' zhabs su mi 'dzul zhes 'thab ya byed mdog byas kyang hor mi de tshos 'o na sngon du 'ban zhig tshug smras par bod kyis lcags khog cig la khrab gcig bkab ste sog chu'i phar kha ru bzhag pa la ju mur thu ran chis mda' zhig 'phang nas khrab dang lcags khog gnyis ka gtor zhing mde'u sne sa la khru gang tsam zug ste rkang pa gtad sa'i pha bong kha gsum du gas pa la deng sang yang skyer 'phrang gi pha bong kha gsum du grags pa de 'o mda' yi mde'u lug gi sog pa tsam yod pa sogs rtsal shugs mngon du thon pas 'thab par ma nus te yul gru de dag gi mi rje ru bkur bar khas blangs so zhes pa 101

'dug la de nas khong cham chu myo ra kha'i lha rtse rdzong bzung nas yul de'i kha btag bza' lcam du bzhes nas bam̐zhugs tshul 'khod 'dug nga ma zad hor gyi sa spyod pa ma nga tsam zhig gi bzhugs gnas lha rtse rdzong yin rabs gsal bar brten 'di skor dus skabs shig gi ring lha rtse rdzong ni hor khyung gnyis pa'i gtan gzhi yin 'dug skabs 'di dus hor tsho dang bod sog pa zhes pa kha kha so so ma yin pa tshang ma sog dus su sog po'i sde yin par mngon 'di nas khyung po yang hor tsho'i cha shas su gyur zin pa yin 'dugamatsho sngon ho shod tsho pa'i 'go dpon dgu shri han stobab/ cher phyin nas dge lugs pa'i rgyab rtsa ru bod skyod kyis dmag las thog sde pa gtsang pa bcoms nas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang blangs pa'i dus skabs 'di skor zhig nas te dkar sog gsum de sog po gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi sger sde yin pa'i shod rgyun 'dug la de nas sog mo chu 'o rin can zer bas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po la dbang rdo rje phreng ba zhus pa'i dbang yon du tsho shog 'di gsum phul ba red ces dang / yang 'ga' res gu shri han nas tā la'i lnga par khams rdzong drug phul ba'i nang gses shig red zer mkhan bcas yod pa red/ yang bod sog pas dus skabs shig la lha ldan smon lam gyi rjes mthud ya sor rdzong rgyab zhar 'khen nang 'dam rgya shod dang lhan du mi rta go sgrig dgos kyi yod 'dug pas sog po gu shri rgyud kyi sger sde yin pa'i grub byed du mngon de min sngar gtam gleng rgyun bgrang pa tsam las khungs gtug gi yig rnying ma mthong bas 'di tsam ma zad/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sku dus kyi dus mjug sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs tsam nas te dkar sog gsum de dga' ldan pho 102

brang pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung sde snying khungs shig tu 'gyur yod 'dug yang sngar gtam shod srol che ba zhig la gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i dus su sog ni mdo stod shog chen bco brgyad kyi gong ba srung 'brug mo 'khrungs sa'i sa cha/ yab skya lo ston pa'i pha mtsher skya lo'i mkhar dmar rdzong drug de sog gi glang dkar dil la chags (deng tsan dan dgon chags sa'i dil 'bur ) sru 'brug mo 'khrungs pa'i dus skabs su g.yag la'i rtse nas g.yu 'brug ngar/khu ru phrang nas khu byug grags lha lung nang nas lha rgyal 'then dar lung nang nas rgya dar blangs yod pa sogs byung rabs gleng rgyun yod pa ma zad/ khu ru phrang gi lam ltag la ge 'brug rnams gnyis kyi sku tshad red zer ba'i brag rdo dang rta rkyang bu'i zhabs rjes red zer 'phrang lam nang gi (rlangs 'khor lam )lam 'og gi zur du chu rdo'i thog gting zab po 'dug 'brug mo ngas pa'i mig cha zer ba la ra raXkhra'i 'gul la chu mig cig yod pa red gling skya lo tshang gi rta brang gong 'go bar gsum nas gong ma sog la yod pa dang / rta sa na dmar gzhung drug zer ba/ tsan dan dgon gyi 'gram/ phyis gser mgar thang zer ba de red sogs shod srol 'dug pa ma zad/ skya lo'i rdzong sog tsan dan dgon chags sar yod tshul tsam gyi ma tshad pa sngo lo'i mkhar de cung pa chos 'khor dgon chags sa der yod tshul dang / gro lo'i mkhar ni rong po rab brtan dgon chags sar yod rabs gleng rgyun yang yod 'dug 103

2 sa babs dang ri chuyul ljongs thon khungs sogasakyi skor/( 1) sog rdzong tsho'i ru babs ni deng nag chu sa khul nang nas cung kha dma' zhing gnam gshis snyom pa'i sa la brtsi ba dang spyir btang khyon yongs nas byas na sa ma 'brog gi sa khul yin rung rngul sog chu chen rgyud du zhing pa shas che ba dang / re stod dang dkar stod sog pa'i kha lung bcas su 'brog pa shas che ba bcas yin/ sog ni 'bri ru'i byang sbra chen gyi lho/ snyan rong gi shar lho/dpal 'bar gyi byang nub la gnas yod pa dang sa cha 'ga' zhig nas sbra chen dang 'bri ru gnyis dang sbrel nas chags yod pa red/da lta'i sog rdzong khongs ltar byas na rgya mo rngul chu'i rgyud lcam mda' dang sngon gyi 'dre dag dang rnam sdom ras gsum gyi sa deng gser khram shang khongs rgyud du som shing gi nags tshal chen po yod pa yin/ de min shug pa dang stag pa gzhan yang sdong thung gi shing rigs sna tshogs ni sa cha phal cher la yod pa yin rung shing nags gtan nas med sa yang yod pa ste/ yol nag dang g.yag la g.ya' nge bcas lta bu la med/ re dkar sog gsum gyi tsho shog chen po gsum de'i nang gi chags tshul ni dkyil du cung pa dang nub la sog pa shar du rong po bcas yin pa de gsum gnyam gshib tu chags yod/ cung pa'i dkar shod rgyud sogs sa cha mang por ri ni spang shug 'dres ma gzhung ni zhing thang zung 'brel/ sa lhad chung zhing nyams dga' ba'i sa zhig yod pa red la rong po sla mda'i ljang chu'i 104

phu rgyud sogs la sa kham yangs shing gangs ri dang rdza ri dgung la regs 'dra spang ljang dang ne seng 'khor ra 'khor yug tu yod pa'i sa skyid cig yin/ yang sa cha kha shas su 'brog la spang sna chu zug yus la rgya zhing mu med lta bu'i rnam pa yod pa red/ yang ri lung 'ga' re'i nang bye ri dang rdza rdos khengs pa'i sa lhad can dang /ri rong g.yangs gzar dog cing yar ltas brag dang mar ltar chu byas pa'i sa cha smyo tsam yod pa'ang yod/ ( 2) gnas ri 'am cung ming grags yod pa'i ri chu'i rnam pa sogs lam tsam smos na sog gi g.yag la se bo ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas ri yin par brtsi mkhan yod pa ma zad dkar phyogs skyong ba'i zhi bdag mthu bo che yin zer ba dang /'di ming 'di lo rgyus yig cha'i thog sog la skya bo zer ba ma zad/gling sgrung nang sog g.yag la se bo zer ba de min byang khul gyi gna' sgrung byang gi ri shi ri dkar dang ri dmar gyi sgrung gi ri bshad nang ‘ khal se sos se bo khrid 'dra de sog gi g.yag la se bo red 7zer ba yod sog smad nags sog 'dus rgyud khams srin mo rdzong zer ba gteng byang du ma'i lung las zin pa'i gnas ri de mdo khams stod kyi gsang chen rnying ba ba'i bstan pa'i bdag po lta bu khams nyi ma grags pa sprul sku rim pa'i gdan sa yin ('dir smos tsam las zhib cha lo rgyus gzhan nas gsal bas ma bgrangs ) dbrod rta'i khongs seng ge gnam mchong zer ba'i ri brag de la gnas brtsi ba da༅ /g.ya' nge'i khongs chu kron g.yu phug zer ba brag phug nang chu mgo dang de'i khrod g.yu yi rdo lcal lta bu dang chu gnas nya rigs sogs yod pa'i ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa red/105

cung pa'i nang dkar shod smad la ge sar sgrung nang gi ri bshad sna‘ka shod rang ma ris 'khrid 7zer ba de yod pa ming gzhan khra tshang g.yu sna'ang zer/ yang gzu rtsa ri rdo rje chos rdzong zer ba'i gnas ri deng sang yang bskor ba 'gro mkhan yod/ (de rnying ma'i bla ma cung ming gras yod pa nag po legs ldan gyis shing spre 1944lor gnas sgo phyes pa zhig yin ) gnas nang lha brag ngang rdzong brag dkar ldebs su yig 'bru dang g.yung drung mi rta'i rjes sogs rang byung yod zer spu la kha'i ri ming can bsangs gsol byed sa dgu chen gyi se ba stag rtse dang dgu chung gi thog la me 'bar zer ba yod/ rong po'i nang ban bon gnyis ga'i gnas rir brtsi ba'i spu rgyal gangs bzang zer ba'i lho ngos 'khol yod pa dang / rong po rang gi nang du dpal khyim rag pa skya bdun zer ba'i yul ri dang / dbang rgya rin chen bum pa zer ba yor ga ba dang / ljang gzhur po zer ba bcas kyi ri ming can 'ga' yod pa ma zad/ 'khyag sgang gi mtsho dkar mtsho nag gtsos mtsho yang re zung yod chu bo ni sog chu dang rngul chu dkar shod chu dang gzu chu re chu bcas yin/ gzhan yang 'grul lam rgyud kha rgyun du grags pa'i che‘ljang chu sngo mo'i khug so la bye mas mi brngubs rta brngubs yod zer ba dang yang che byang a ngu'i na 'khor gong ma nas rogs mi dgos ma lu dran sa med zer ba'i shod rgyun yod de bzhin yang ‘‘a ngu gong nas khyi nag rgod 'a nag rgod 'a rgyug rdza pho 'drog glang nge chag ’ ces pa'i bzhad rgad slong ba'i sgrung thung zhig kyang shod srol 'dug( 2) re dkar sog gsum gyi khul du rang byung thon khungs shing nags tog tsam yod pa ma zad/ rtsa che'i ri dwags sha 106

ba dang gla ba rna rgo gnyan sogs yod pa ma zad dngul chu rgyud du rgya go ra yang thar thor yod/ gcan rigs ni gzig dang / gsa' gzig dbyi gsa' phar dred sogs yod la/ 'gangs che'i sman rtswa yang dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu dang rdza yung be smug bcas yod khar bod sman lcang bzhi rigs lnga dang rdo zho rigs lnga zil pa lnga bcas mang po yod pas ma tshad rdo rgyus dang mthing rgyus sum tig srol lo dkar dmar bang dkar sogs sman sna bcu phrag mang po'i sman rtswa yod pa red/cung par g.yu o sngo la'i ri rgyud du zha nye'i gter kha yod tshul gleng rgyun yod pa dang gzu do khang nang gi chu gzhung du rang byung gi mtshal dmar po rgya mtshal cog la nang bzhin zhig yod pa red/lag shes thon dngos sogs nas rdza kho'i khog ldil dang me 'khor rdzis kho sogs spus dag tsam bzo thon yod pa las gzhan gyi lag shes thon dngos ha lam med pa rang yin 'dug 'on kyang so so'i dgos mkhor shog bu spus zhan phran bu bzo gi yod 'dug2 rdzong cho'i 'go pa dang shogakha'i sgrig ming sogs kyi skor/( 1) gu shri han gyi gra sa'i thob khungs 'bras har gdong khams tshan yin pa dang de'i bsdu las byed sgo'i stabs kyis gzhis ku'i ngo bo ldan zhing sog rdzong dpon gyi phyag sbrel mi 'gro har gdong khams mtshan gyi gra ba re gtong dgos pa dang gtso bo ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi khral bsdu khrims 'dom byed po mi 'gro drung kyus gcig gtong gi yod pas rdzong gi ngo bo yod stabs sog gzhis rdzong zer ba 107

red zer mkhan 'dug rung sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung 'og rdzong gzhis nang nas sog gzhis sdod yin pa las rdzong mi zer 'on kyang gzhis sdod mi 'gro de rdzong dpon gyi thob thang yod 'dug lo gsum re'i mtshams rdzong dpon brje len byed pa yin nam rgyun mi tshos sog rdzong zer ba las gzhis ga'am gzhis rdzong zer srol med rdzong ngo 'khor nam rgyun sog la sdod rung rdzong tshab zer ba cung pa rong po'i nang sa gnas de ga'i mi 'am rdzong gi zhabs 'breng gras rgyun sdod yod pa red/( 2 ) sog phogs khang zer ba yod pa de'i phogs dpon sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs gnyis yod pa red phogs khang btsugs pa'i skor la 〈〈bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs 〉〉'don thengs bcu gnyis pa'i nang 'khod lha me 'brug 1916mdo spyi bka' bla byams pa bstan dar nas mdo smad khul gyi phogs khang mkhan rim sbrel pos mi khyab pas hor tsho so dgu'i khongs dang sog nag chu tshun la 'brel mtshungs phogs khang lasar 'dzugs yod pa zhes tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum par snyan zhus ltar hor tsho khul dang sog nag chu gnam ru nag tshang tshun gyi byang rigs sa srung khag la sog phogs khang dang do dam mgron las sbrel po bsko bzhag gis rtsa ba'i phogs dmigs hor tsho khul steng chen dang / gser tsha/ 'bri ru khul bcas nas 'bab deb nang gsal gnas zhing thog phud kyi gzhung 'bab ji yod sog phogs khang du rgyag dgos pa dang phogs 'bru kha snon dgos rigs dwags kong rdzong gzhis khag nas 'don 'dren dgos pa bcas red ze 'khod 'dug pa bzhin no108

( 2) 'bri chu gser kha'i gser bsdud zer lo ltar gzhung gi phyag nang re drung chas spras te yong gi yod pa de a mdo rgan po'i sar sdod kyi yod/( 4) re dkar sog gsum gyi dang po bod sog pa la dud grangs lnga brgya skor yod pa der 'go pa lding rgan nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa red/ lding dpon gnyis yod pa ni dar ma lding dpon dang 'brug stag lding dpon zer bar skabs 'brug stag tshang la bu ma byung bas mag pa dar lding tshang nas yin pas rjes sor bod sog pa'i lding dpon gnyis ka dar ma tshang gi mi rgyud yin/ sngar dar ma lding dpon nor bu zer ba ming grags che tsam byung yod pa de chos la'ang mkhas po yod pas hor spyi mkhan chung grags rnam kyis dge bshes ar mgo can zer gyi yod pa red sog pa ya bzhi zer ba nang gses shog kha bzhi yod pa sba gzhus dang / cha 'og nyin pa/ sog rong bcas yin/ gong gsal sba zhus zer ba sba ba ni sngar sbra gur phub pa nas khang pa med pa'i sde dum gcig yod pa de dang sog dgon rdzong 'gram gyi zhol pa gnyis sdom pa'i ming la sba zhus gnyis zer nang gses shog gcig yin cha 'og zer ba ni (phyis mchod yon zer ba yin )sog dang nags shod rgyud du gnam sa yi ge ka mad kyi dbyibs dkar yod pa 'ga' zhig ste/ ka 'og dang la 'og cha 'og bcas yin zer srol yod/ sog pa ya bzhi'i rgan po nyi shu rtsa gsum yod pa ste/ sba zhus gnyis kyi rgan po a mdo rgan po dang /lde ru rgan po hor ru dang / se ru sbas bcas rgan po lnga/ cha 'og la dar ma rgan po dang / dpal chen/ khyung rgyud/ khong bong /snying pa bcas rgan po lnga dang sog rong shog la hor sde rgan po/109
