sis tsha/ cham phu/ rgyal pa/ ban tsha bcas rgan po lnga/ nyin pa shog la sder ru thob pa'i rgan po gsum dang rting pa/ ge ba/na man/ lha chen rgan po bcas bdun yod pas bod sog pa'i rgan lding nyi shu rtsa lnga zer ba de yin/ lding dpon gnyis smos ci spyir btarwa byas na gong gsal rgan po rnams kyang pha rgyud bu 'dzin gyi thob thang can gyi rgan chen zhe gcig red/ sog pa'i rgan lding la che bstod kyi gtam 'then skabs 6 sog ser po'i dus su rda rogs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rgya nag po'i dus su am pa nyi shu rtsa lnga bod sgang pa'i dus su rgan lding nyi shu rtsa lnga zer shod kyi yod 'dug de min sog tsan dan dgos par gtogs pa'i gra tshang nor ma zer 'dud dum zhig yod pa dang / har gdong khams mtshan gyi mgo btags dud kha shas shig bla brang mgo btags dud kha shas bcas yod pa'i de tsho'i 'go pa/ gra tshang nor ma dgon pas thad kur 'go byed pa dang / har gdong mgo btags la med nyag rgan po zer ba dang /bla brang mgo btags la dbyis rgan po zer ba yod/ kra tshang nor ma zhes pa de dang po dgon pa'i bka' 'gyur thebs rtsa 'dzin mkhan dud bdun yod pa nas 'phel te rjes sor bcu phrag kha shas tsam yod/ gzhan yang 'brug stag lding dpon la sgab skor dud dum zhig yod la/ dar ma lding dpon la yang sgab skor dud re zung yod/ bod sog pa'i lding dpon gnyis la go sa thob thang chen po /)// /rdo/rdo /byenge/ 1—nge /)pe/ /josgo /sheg /)pe/da skad las da sa su ma pa 'a na ra ba gsal sa 'dugalo ltar lding dpon gnyis dang / a mdo rgan po gtsos rgan chen kha shas bcas la bka' rgya gnam rten zer tā la'i bla ma'i bka' bzang dang byin mdud bcas yod pa'i bka' rgya re rtsal gnang yong 110

gi yod pa de bdag rkyen chen po red ces shod srol 'dug( 5) re dkar sog gsum gyi gnyis pa cung pa tsho shog la dud grangs sum brgya skor yod pa dang / spyi'i 'go pa bla lding dpon gsum zer ba yod pa dang po spu la bla ma ni sngar khyung po'i bla ma zhig de khul du byon nas da lta'i cung pa chos 'khor dgon gyi yar 'gram spu la kha zer sa'i ri ldeb kyi steng kha de ru sgar gur phug nas bzhugs skabs 'di dus sa der gzu ba dpon zhes pa gzhi bdag gi rdzus bur grags pa mda' kha dpa' rtsal mnga' snyems pa zhig yod pa des chu pha ri'i stod 'ge kha nas mtshan mor mda' rtsed rtsed par phar kha'i gur nang gi mar me bda' (gsod ) thub min gleng nas gzu dpon gyis mda' 'phang bas sgar pa'i khyung po bla ma gur nang bzhugs pa de bkrongs pa dang / 'di dus khyung po stobs shugs che bas bla ma'i mi stong la spu la kha'i sa sde khyung bla ma sprod dgos byung nas khyung nag bla ma der bzhugs pa'i sa ming blam dang thog nas spu la bla ma zer ba'i mtshan chags dpon spu la bla ma la blon bru span rgyas gsum g.yog kha la dud bdun zer ba byung tshul shod rgyun 'dug de nas sde'ang 'phel rgyas phyin yod pa dang / cung pa'i byang ngos kyi dgra sgo bkag par phan thog byung ba dang / dbang stobs btsan du phyin pa yul 'brog gi sa cha byung nas cung pa sde spyi'i 'go byed gras su gyur te bla lding dpon gsum zer ba'i bla ma de yin/ spu la bla ma bon lugs yin pa dang der dgon lag dang mtshan snyan chen po yod skad ma zad/ rtse bla brang thog kha'i bla chung sger btsan bcu gsum zer ba'i gras yin tshul gleng rgyun yod 'dug gong gsal mad 'a 'phen gyi gzu pa dpon de'i spyod pa'i rma/da' kazhu cung pa chos 'khor 111

dgon gyi mgon khang du yod pa'i gzhu de mthong ba tsam gyis ha las dgos pa zhig yod pa red/ (rig gsar bar sdad yod pa ) cung par bla lding dpon gsum gyi lding dpon de snga tsam nas yod 'dugagana' snga mor cung pa zer ba'i sde ming ma chags gong gzu ba'am dkar shod zer ba yin thog ma'i lding dpon gyi jus rigs cung pa yin stabs dpon gyi rus pa'i ming sde la thogs nas de nas bzung cung pa zer srol byung 'dugabla lding dpon gsum gyi dpon ni dus phyis tsam la byung skad de'ang dang po cung pa la spyi mi zer ba cig yod pa de'i mi rabs 'ga' zhig rjes me byi gangs mo che zer ba de byung nas phyugs rigs tshan chen shi bas gzhung khral 'jal rgyu'i khral mar dang 'gel sa'i khal ma med pa'i dka' sdug skabs spyi mi des nus bton khral bsdu'i mar mar stang bco brgyad byung ba kho rang gi g.yag dgu la bkal nas lha sar skyal ba'i byas rjes su sa gnas srid gzhung gis spyi mi de cung pa dpon la bskos nas bla lding dpon gsum gyi dpon de nas byung / cung pa dpon lding gi thob thang yang sog gi lding dpon dang phal cher 'dra bar snyams (gsal po ma nges ) cung par nang gses shog kha rgan shog bdun zer ba'am sa tshugs sgrig skabs bcu shog dgu zer ba yod/ shog dgu de spu la dang / dkar shod stod/dkar shod smad/ gzu stod/ gzu smad/ bdam zhus gnyis dbyis pa/ shog sum/ dbes pa bcas yin/ cung pa sde gzhung la ma the ba'i da dung chos 'khor dgon pa'i mgo btags dang / rag rdo bla ma'i mgo btags/ har gdong khams mtshan gyi mgo btags bcas dud 'ga' zhig yod/ rgan shog bdun 112

byas dus rgan chen bdun yod pa ni ( 1959lo'i gong tsam la ) spu la shog gi rgan chen jas sum ja phu/ gzu pa'i rgan chen maso shu blo gros mgo bshu shog gi rgan chen mgo bshu padma/ gla ru'i rgan chen mgo shu dbang chen/ mkhar sngon rgan chen khri btsan/ khro tse'i rgan chen khro tse tshe 'khel/ shog sum rgan chen rta gan a grogs bcas yin/ gong gsal rgan chen rnams mi mus rgyud bcas kyi rgan chen yin pa dmigs bsal gnas tshul lam/ mi khyim stong na ma gtogs rang sgar brje len byed pa'i rgan po ma yin/ sa tshugs 'dzin pa dang dpon dmag skyel sgrol zhu sgo'i 'gan 'khur bcu shog dgu yi mi ser nas yar 'os 'dems byed pa'am bla lding dpon gsum gyis mar kha theg 'khen pa gang yang rung ba'i rgan po re yod pa dang a ngu gong sa tshugs rgyun sdod zhal ngo zer ba gcig bcas yod pa yin/( 6) re dkar sog gsum gyi gsum pa/ rong po tsho shog la dud grangs bzhi brgya skor yod pa dang / shod srol la sngon spu rgyal btsan po srong btsan gyi blon po phyi blon btsan po rnam drug gi ya gyal rong po 'phrul gyi lde btsan gyi mi rgyud nas byung ba'i rong po bar nang sngon po zer ba gcig 'dam gzhung la chags yod pa de smad la yongs lam nas rgyud pa 'ga' zhig shag la gzhis bzung bas shag rong po zer sdod kyi rong po de byung ba dang / de nas mar yong nas ka chen sha la la sha ba la gnya' bcas te zhing smos par bsam gtan gangs bzang gi bdud mo rgu sgab kyis 'tshub slong byung bar de dang 'gran skabs grongs shor rung khong gi rgyud pa re shod la gzhis chags pas smad kyi rong po 'di yin de nas bzung sde ming rong po zer ba 113

yim tshu la rgan rabs la shod rgyun yod pa ma zad/ rong po dpon skyon ma zer ba gcig gis skabs der rgya hor gyi dpon chen la sa zhus pas smos khal gyi dor gcig sprad zer bar g.yag thang la gnya' bcas bshol bzung nas lcag gis grab kyin nyin gang bor song bas chags la nas sdom la bar du slebs pas re gzhung gong bo thob zer ba'i shod srol gda' rong pho la rang po dang / sla mda'/ zhol pa zer ba nang gses thog kha gsum yod/ de min dbyis stod dang /dris rong la rab brtan dgon pa'i nor ma zer sde dud 'ga' zhig yod/ 'go pa ni rong po dpon dang sla mda' dpon (sla mda' dpon 'di dpon las dma' ba dang rgan po las mtho tsam )rong po dpon la'ang sba rgan dang sba gsar gnyis yod/ rgan po mang rje dang / ba 'o du rgya kho yu nor 'grub tshang sogs yin zhing khyon sla mda' la rgan po gnyis/ zhol pa la rgan po gnyis/ rong po la rgan po bzhi bcas yod/ de min sog rdzong gi rdzong tshab gnyer pa zer ba sa gnas de ga'i khyim du dud chen po gnyis yod pa ste/'ug chung dang / bru tshang zer da dung ring po dpon gyi rgyud las 'chad pa'i dpon chung a nu bcu gsum zer ba gzhung khral phran tsam las mi dgos pa'i sger btsan 'ga' zhig yod pa red/ nam rgyun mi tshos rong ngo/ sde sder ma gang la dpon slo ma gang yod zer ba red/rong po dpon de sog gi lding dpon lta bu'i go thob yod 'dugaspyir btang rgan po ni khyim rgyud yin pa dang las go ma 'khor ba byung na ma gtogs 'pho len mi byed/ yang rta zam sa tshugs sdod sgrig skor la shog kha bdun dang phyed ka gnyam sgrub dgos pa'i de skabs sla rong shog gnyis dang / zhol pa shog phyed de thog hor tsho'i 114

khungs nas rnams tsha shog lnga sdom pa'i rong po shog kha phyed brgyad zer srol yod/4 khral khrims sogs kyi skon/( 1) re dkar sog gsum khral gyi 'bab gzhi skor sa brgya mgo zer ba dang de'ang mgo gcig nas brgya bar rgyu nor phyugs zog la phab nas brtsi dgos yod/ dper na rta re la mgo re rtsi ba dang / nor lnga la mgo re rtsi ba de bzhin lug sum cu la mgo re/ra drug cu la mgo re brtsis pa'i mgo brgya zin pa la brgya mgo yin pa dang brgya mgo'i a ma yang zer de 'dra 'ga' zhig yod par 'tsho mgo yang zer/ brgya mgo las rgal ba'i mtho shos la ru 'bur zer/ru 'bur zin mkhan gyi khral brgya mgo las rgal ba'i cha de'i phyed ka chag pa dang phyed ka brgya mgo'i thog la rtsegs kyi yod/ brgya mgo ma zin tsam la rab 'go gam rtse kog zer ba dang de nas 'bring po dang de nas 'bring smad mgo gcig kyang ma zin pa ni khral med yin pas rkang 'gro las lag 'don khral 'jal mi dgos/ gong gsal phyugs rigs mgo la phab grangs de cung rong gnyis la rtsis stangs phran bu ma 'dra ba las rtsa ba'i char gcig 'gyur yin 'dug( 2 ) khral 'khri yul de mi rgyu zogs gsum mam rke sgur leb gsum yin mi ni khral mi dang sa ni khral sa zhing ni khral zhing zog ni khral zog zer/ khral rgyug mi de rke rke'i mi yin la khral 'khri sa de leb leb kyi zhing dang sgur sgur gyi phyugs zog red da dung yang mkho 'byor zer ba gcig yod 'dug par rten mi tshang so so'i nang chas 115

rtsa che dper na me mda' dang sked gri khro zangs dkar dmar bcas la'ang mgo grangs phabs nas mgo zin par phyugs zog nang bzhin gyi khral 'khri 'di yod pa red/ khro snod che bzang gcig la khral mgo re thob pa dang me mda' re la'ang khral mgo re rtsi gi yod 'dug (khral 'khri'i sa zhing mgo la phab stangs gsal po ma shes ) gtam gleng skabs rgyu yod kyi rgyu khral rgyu med kyi rkang khral nus med rgyal po lo khral zer ba dang / yang sa rta gdan tsam la khral rta sga tsam 'jal mkhan yin zer ba red/ yang khral rigs bzhi gsum bcu gnyis de 'jal/ ar rigs drug gsum bco brgyad de rgyug zer ba sogs dpe gtam mang po yod ( 2) dngos gzhi'i khral 1sog gi bis mar zer te dkar sog gsum gyi gzhung dud yongs nas 'bri rer mar rgya ma gang re dang be'u rer mar rgyun gang re'i khral 'jal dgos rgyun do re la nyag gang re yin/ de ni lo ltar dbyar dus rdzong gi zhabs gras dang cung rong la yod pa'i rdzong tshab bcas nas khyim dud re re bzhin gyi sar skyod thog nor ro rgyag skabs be'u mgo grangs rtsi ba dang ro ma btags dus slebs na bis gdangs kyi snu lu la grangs rgyab nas mar thob rtsi srol yod/ ༅spus mar zer ba'i mar khral 'jal dgos pa de ni sde pa gzhung gis 'bri chu gser kha'i gser sdud zer ba dang thog tsho shog so sor spus gyur gyi rnam pa'i thog nas dngos po phran tsam sprod nas mar phon chen bsdu gi yod pa de rjes sor 'char can gyi khral zhig tu gyur pa yin 'dug 'bri gser dbyar dus khral sdud du yong skabs khral 'go 'phul mkhan gyi rgan po tsho la phrug thig ma'i lham rgyan re dang / spos chags re sprod kyi yod 116

pa/ dgos pa'i mkhan las la'ang dngos po'i gnang sbyin phran bu dang lha khang gi thug sbra kha shas brje ba sogs byed pa yin 'dug spus mar 'di khral mgo'i thog la 'bab gses byed cing brgya mgo rer gser kha'i mar rgya drug bcu re lnga thob/ 3 gzhung 'bri 'chi med kyi mar 'di sngon chu glang lu cun phyir 'bud 'khrug 'dzing skor hor tshos lu cun rgya la rogs ram byas pa dang lhag par sgang ga tha mas sde pa gzhung gis btang ba'i se ra mkhan po ngo 'khor sdeb bsad byas rkyen sa srid nas nag phabs te sgang tu tsho pa gtor ba dang ga tha nas gzhung bzhes mang po byas pa'i nor mang tshan zhig re dkar sog gsum thog 'chi med la bkram yod pa yin 'dug dper na sog rong rgan shog la gzhung gi 'bri bcu drug gi 'chi med mar 'bul dgos pa lta bu/ 4sog pa sa rta mar zer ba'i mar khral dgos 'di sngar sog po gu shri han gyis sger sde byed skabs rta sgod ma bzho nas a rag phab byad dam de 'dra'i rigs yin tshod zer ba las gsal po shod rgyu mi 'dug rta mar gyi khral 'di phran tsam las mang po mi dgos/5'dan chen zer ba'i 'bru khral dgos ('di'i 'byung stangs dang grangs tshad ma rtogs ) rdzong khral zer gyi 'dugadu dngul khral pho lo nam shar la spos mal rtsi dod zer ba'i khral dgos pa de yang dang thog gzhung spos bzo khang du spos nang blug byad gla rtsi khral 'bul dgos pa dang / rjes sor ri klung rgya sdems sngon rgya rtsa tshig rim byung rjes gla rtsi dngul sgyur nas sgrub dgos pa yin sog par sho ma thang sde 'thor ba'i khral lhad spyi thog tu 'khur dgos pas sho khral zer ba'i dngul zhig bsdu gi yod pa red/ 3chibs ra'i kheb zer dkar 'thag dang dkar tshags phying pa'i khral 8sgrig 'bul 1snyi/ — —

g.yogs dang ja lung thag khral 9thug res re rnam dang rnga ma'i khral sgrub dgos 10sog pa'i nang rdza chas thon sa nas rdza khral rdzong la sprod dgos pa de'ang 'bru la sgyur nas 'bru sprod pa red 11rdzong dang dgon pa'i tshogs shing sprod rgyu'i shing khral dgos tsan dan dgon pa la zhol pa phud pa'i shog res tshogs shing sdong rgyab bdun bcu don lnga re dgos pa sngon dang po rdzong nas dgon par tshogs shing gi shing phogs dgos rung bar skabs rdzong gis skabs 'khral ma sprad stabs dgon pa'i grwa pa 'ur nas rdzong khang bshu grab byas pa'i gleng rtsod byang rjes tshogs shing de rdzong rgyud ma dgos pa mi ser nas thad shar rdogon par shing khral 'jal rgyu bzos 'dug12sog lcags zam la zam srung sdod dgos pa dang 'grul ba byung rigs sa nas zam gla len te de dag na zam rgyun nyam gso'i dmigs dngul nges can 'then 'jog dgos pa dang de byings tshang ma rdzong la rtsis 'bul dgos yin 'dug sngar cung pa nas rtse pho brang gi span bad la gsol rgyu'i btsag gi khral dang / ba tsha g.yu shod nas 'bru spus dag thon gyi yod stabs rgyal ba'i gsol zhib byed byad zer ba'i nas khral nges can zhig sgrub dgos kyi yod pa de bar skabs cung pa'i dkar rong rgan po kom tsag can zer ba zhig byang ba des gzhung sar bcar thog dkar shod do mo'i btsag khung sdob nas btsag len rgyu med par chags pa ma zad ba tsha g.yu shod kyi ri bo nyil nas zhing kha gnon pas gnas tshul zhus par don smin gyis btsag khral dang nas khral de gnyis mi dgos pa byung ba'i shod srol yod/( 4) gong gsal spus mar dang bis mar gyi khral mar 'gro sa de khag gcig 'bras har gdong kham mtshan gyi tshogs thebs 118

sam mchod me khag gcig 'khrul bde le khungs la 'bul nas gtsug lag khang nang skor gyi rdo sgrum gru nar nang gi mchod me spar byad de bzhin rang khul sog tsan dan dgon dang / cung pa chos 'khor dgon rong po rab brtan dgon bcas phogs dgon gsum gyi — tshogs thebs sogs la 'gro ba yin rabs 'dug 'dir rdzong khongs kyi dgon pa gsum po der bis mar nang nas be'u yi mar 'bab tshang ma sprod pa red zer ba dang yang 'bab yongs kyi phyed ka sprod dgos zer ba shod mkhan mi 'dra ba gnyis 'dug la tsan dan dgon pa'i lo rgyus las ‘ lo ltar gzhung nas sog rdzong rgyud phogs mar mar rgya nyis stong lnga brgya yas mas dam 'byar rgya mar 'jal nas phogs 'jal len byed 7zer ba 'dug dgon gzhan gnyis po la'ang de bas nyung tsam re sprod dgos yod 'dug (khral len gyi rgya ma de khrom rgya las ldab kyi che ba yod ) ko 'be dkar tshag chibs gdan bzos nas chib ra las khungs su sprod pa dang thug sbra dkar nag rnga khral bcas ni rtse zhol las khungs su sprod dgos tshul 'dug yang gong gsal bis mar gyi 'bri mar las khag gcig ya sor khri pa'i phan dmigs zer rdzong drung 'khor de'i za sgo yin 'dug sog rong smad ka 'og sngags dgon gyi rdo rje rnying rdzong sgrub phug nang gi mchod me spar byad srin rdzong dkar me zer mar ltang gcig gnyis shig sprod kyi yod pa ma zad/ dgon pa gsum gyi mkhan pol mar khal 'ga' ri— sprod dgos yod pa bcas red/ cung pa'i gzhung rgyug mi ser mang shos shig nas chos 'khor dgon par gte zer ba'i 'bru dang /a la zer ba'i mar khral gzhan yang bka' 'gyur dang / mar me'i zhal 'debs zer ba'i mar bcas grangs tshad nges can zhig khral 119

thob che chung la gzhigs nas sprod dgos pa bcas red/( 5) sog pa'i lding dpon gnyis dang cung pa'i bla lding dpon gsum rong po'i dpon sogs dang cung pa'i rgan chen tsho dang de bzhin tsho shog rgan chen 'ga' zhig bcas khral 'jal mi dgos pa ma zad/ sog 'brug stag lding dpon bcas la sgab dud tshos gro ma dang / rtswa khral tog tsam sgrub dgos pa red/ 'on kyang cung pa dpon nas gzhung gi spus mar sogs mar khral 'jal gyi yod pa dang mi ser mang ches kyang mar khral dmar po 'jal ba de 'gro khungs dgon pa'i mchod thebs dang jo khang gi rgyun 'bar la 'gro ba'i rkyen gyis yin 'dug hor tsho'i khul nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol zin rjes sa gnas srid gzhung la 'jal rgyu'i khral rim bzhin bcad yod rung sog rdzong khongs nas 1959la ma thug bar sngar bzhin bsdu thub kyi yod pa red/( 6) gong gsal sa gnas srid gzhung la sgrub dgos khral rigs zhar chag mi chog pa yin/ khral bzo mgo rtsi ni spyir btang lo bcu gnyis re'i dus khral bzo chen mo re byed srol yod rung dus tshod de'i nang khral yas khrims yas phyin nas khral dud bud stong mang tsam byung ba dang / rgyu nor phran bu 'khel nas khral mgo gsar pa chags thub pa'i khyim dud bcas 'gyur ldog dngos gsal che ba byung ba'i gnas tshul 'og khral bzo mgo rtsi de snga bsnur yang byed srol 'dug mgo rtsi khral bzo chen mo ni rdzong ngo las gang rung dang /tsho shog gi dpon lding 'go mi las byed dgon pa'i mkhan po'i sku tshab bcas tshang 'dzoms kyis khral bzo byed pa yin/ spyi yongs kyi gzhung khral chag yang mi chog stabs nang khul tsho shog phyug dbul gyi 120

don dngos la gzhigs nas phyugs rigs mgo phabs kyi grangs/ tshad dang nang nor khral khongs su rtsi ba'i dam lhod sogs khyad par yod pa red/(7) re dkar sog gsum du khrims 'dom gyi dbang cha sogs gtso bo sog rdzong la yod rung tsho shog 'go pa dpon lding la'ang gang 'tshams kyi dbang tshad yod/ rgan po ni khral khrims kyi 'du 'god nang thad kur 'gan khur mkhan yin rgan pos kyang kho rang la gtug mkhan kha mchu chung rigs 'grig 'dom bzo dbang yod che ba gzhung lding dpon dang de nas rdzong 'dis 'dom gyi yod mi gsod rigs gzhung bsher khang nas bdag po byed pa las 'dom mi chog tsan dan dgon dang / chos 'khor dgon rab brtan dgon gsum rten tshig gi bdag po sa gnas srid gzhung gi phogs dgon yang dang gras khrims sgo rang btsan zer dbang shugs che tsam yod/ (8) ri klung rgya sdems kyi rngon rgya 'gal bar sha bsad sha ra dang gla bsad gla rtsi lene pa ma zad rgyu thog gi chad pa ja khag dgu dang / lus thog gi rtsa ra rta lcag 150bzhu ba red/ de yang rngon 'gal sa cha'i dpon dgon btsan los dang sngon par rgyab rtsa yod med khyad par che bas sngon khrims gcig gyur zhig med pared/ lha ri rdzong khongs mi ser zhig gis lab pa ltar na/ sog rdzong der sngon khrims lci po yod pas sngon pa khrims chad 'og ma thar ba dang mi shi khyim stong bu rgyud yul byol du 'gro dgos byung ba'i gnas tshul sgrung 'dra ba yang byung yod pa 'dug(9) yul mi sde'i skya lo sngon khrims zer dpyid kha zhing kha 121

btabs nas ston thog ma bsdus bar grong tsho'i nang res skor gyis khrims pa zer ba'i mi gnyis kyis zhing khar lta srung byed sus phyugs rigs zhing nang du shor na sug khral zer 'bru phul do re len pa de zhing kha'i bdag po la sprod khrims kyi nang nas skya lo sngon khrims 'di so nam par phan thog yod pas med thabs med pa la brtsi ba red/(1༷ ) sde gtso'i dpon lding la khral dud khyim bgos byung bar bgos phud zer spyir na bdam 'bri bdam khal sprod pa'i za sgo yod der 'go ba 'ga' shas kyis nang gyod rnyog gra che ba ma byung tshe bgos phud mi len mkhan yang yod pa red/5 ar 'ul sogs kyi skor/( 1) ar po sog zhol par ar chen drug bcu zer bas lo ltar rdzong gi zhing khar las ka rgyug dgos pa rdzong khang lta dgos pa dgon khang gangs 'phyag dgos pa de bzhin rdzong las sgrig 'bod zer ba'i 'bol gdan chib ra'i khral rta kheb bcas bzos dgos gong gsal rdzong zhing zer ba de mi ser dbar zhing don rtsod gzhi byung bar 'dom skabs rdzong nas zhing dum zhing gzhung bzhes kyis rdzong zhing gras su gtong gi yod pa rim 'phel gyis rjes sor rdzong zhing mang tsam yod pa red gra tshang nor mas tsan dan dgon pa'i gzhis ka bzhi la zhing las rgyug dgos bla brang mgo btags nas mkhan por g.yog rgyug dgos cung pa chos 'khor dgon gyi mchod zhing rnams dgon pa'i mgo btags kyis zhing las rgyug dgos rag rdo bla brang mgo btags kyis bla brang gi zhing las rgyug dgos rong po 122

rag dgon gyi nor ya khag gsum gyis dgon don 'gro skyod dgos rigs sgrub dgos pa dang dgon zhing ni gser khram dgon pa'i mgo btags pas las ka byed dgos/ bod sog pa'i lding dponoganyis la nyi mtshungs sgab dud tshos zhing kha gcod bsdu la ru gar (ar po )rgyug dgos cung pa'i spu la shog gis sru la bla ma'i zhing las sogs la ar po rgyug pa dang lding dpon la'ang nye mtshungs sde dud tshos zhing las ar po rgyug dgos pa ma zad bla ru rgan por 'dzam pa sgab dud kha shas yod pa des rtswa 'thu nyung sdud byed dgos pa red/ rong po'i dpon tsho la yang de bzhin mi ser nas zhing brnga sdu sogs la ru gar rgyug dgos/ gong gsal ar po la gla cha mi sprod cing lto 'bring tsam ster mkhan yod pa red/(2) 'ul lag sngar rta zam sa tshugs de lho lha ri mgo'i rgyud nas yin yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi skabs tsam nas byang lam 'di rgyud nas kyang rta zam sa tshugs btsugs pa der lho lam byang 'gyur zer chab mdo nas byang lam rgyud yar rtsis na lha sa bar sa lam nyin tshugs phal cher nyi shu rtsa brgyad dgu yin 'dug pa ste chab mdo nas bla mda' dang de nas la gong / de nas sngas mda'/de nas ba sha/ de nas the ru rta mda' dang gyang sngon/ sha ba la/steng chen/ gser tsha/ mkhar thang tsha 'bang sgang / spa rta sum mdo/ re chu mdo/ ya nga mdo/ spo tho lam mda' a ngu gang /ner khyim/ sog rkyang khyim/ ge dmar/ 'om cang /mchig tu nyin bar/ nag chu/ me rdo zha bar gsang gzhung sa tshugs/ na lung dkar mo/ com mdo/ pho mdo/ lhun grub rdzong / de nas lha sa yin 'dug gzhung lam 'di rgyud nas yong 123

mkhan che btsan dpon dmag gam a drung yan tshang ma re dkar sog gsum gyi sa khongs nas so sos sdod sgrig skyel sgrol zhu dgos pa dper na bod sog pas sog la rta zam 'dzin dgos pa dang mar der sdod sgrig gis yar 'gro nags shod ga dmar bar dang mar yong ye tha ner khyim bar skyel dgos cung pa nas spo tho lam mda' ste a ngu sa tshugs sdod sgrig rta zam 'dzin nas yar 'gro ner khyim dang mar yo nga khrom tshang ya nga mdo bar skyel dgos rong po nas re chu mdor sdod sgrig rta zam 'dzin pa dang yar 'gro ya nga bar dang mar 'gro spa rta sum mdo bar skyel dgos de'ang btsan po 'bab mang nyung gi rta khal grangs bcad lam yig ltar cung mang ba'i rigs rdzong skyel yin pas tsho shog mnyam sgrub dgos pa yod la rdzong khongs gzhan gyi sa tshugs bar skyel ring byed dgos sa skyel yi na zhag tshugs re bzhin rdal re rta zam rang gis der rta ring dang rta thung zer skyel ba yin/skabs re rong po dris rong rgyud nas rgyal rab thang du sa tshugs byed de skyod mkhan yang yod pas rgyal rab thang du sdod sgrig dgos sbra chen du skyod mkhan la sog pas drug cu'i mug rdza bar skyel dgos la/'bri rur 'gro mkhan 'bri ru bar skyel dgos pa'ang yod/ rong po'i rta zam sa tshugs 'dzin skyel sogs la shog kha phyed brgyad ces hor tsho khongs kyi nems tsha shog lnga ste nems tsha dang / 'dre dgasdom pa/ yangs pa/ res sum bcas kyang 'du dgos/ cung pa'i a ngu'i sa tshugs sgrig skyel la tsho khang khri rdo gnyis 'du dgos rung mi khal dngos su slebs mi thub pa shug gsab dang dngul sprod dgos pa red/ gong gsal rnams 1916me 'brug zhib gzhung 'dra drug gan don gyi dgongs don yin tshod/ rgyun sdod sa tshugs 124

khar rta zam 'dzin stangs ni tsho shog gi nang gses shog kha res skor gyi rta khal mi gsum gang 'tshams shig gtan sdod dgos shing de dag gis rgyun ldan btsan po nyung 'bring 'gro skyod la sdod sgrig skyel sgrol byed (btsan po zer ba sa gnas srid gzhung nas mngags gtong a drung yan dpon dmag phyin tshang ma'i spyi ming ) sdod res nas rgyab 'ub mi 'du zhing ar mi gtan ba'i khral chen dmag chen 'bab skabs tsho shog yongs nas sdod sgrig dgos pas gra 'grig min stabs nye 'gram mi ser gyi mgo sbra yang bshu nas sgrig chas byed dgos pa red/ sog pas 'ul res sdod skabs shog re'i nang rkang 'gro ni du ba gnam gtong sgyed spu sa rgyag gi dud mi re dgos/ ( 2) che btsan dpon rigs 'gro skyod la sgrig sgo rta thab zan shing mjal zhu sogs dang rgyun ldan rdzong dang khral len dpon las rigs la'ang mjal zhus gsol zhabs phebs rdzong sogs dgos pa spyi 'gre la zhib phra ma bkod/6 tshong las dang bun gtong dus ston skyu rtsal gom gshis sogs kyi skor/( 1) re dkar sog gsum gyi yul sde 'brog shas che sa nas dbyar dus 'bri tshwa thengs re len nas de thog bal mar pags rigs sogs zong chas khyer ste ston dus dpal 'bar dang steng chen rgyal shod bcas su 'bru sgrub thengs re 'gro srol yod pa ma zad cung rong gnyis nas mi khal cha rkyen yod pa tshos shing tshong yang nag chu kha la 'gro ba yin yus shas che sar rang 'bru spyod pa tsam las khal ma dang 'brog zong dkon pas brje tshong 'gro ba'i cha rkyen med stabs 125

tshong la mi 'gro/(2) rdzong dang 'bri chugaser kha'i khral sdu'i dpon rigs bcas kyi khral sdud dang tshong rgyag zung 'brel byed/ de tshos ma gzhi tshong gnyis mos ltar yin khul yang spus zhan sna tha dang ja sogs zong khug lus pa rnams 'tshong thub/ chod ngo srung ngo 'phen sogs byed nas bem thub pa byed kyi yod/( 2) sog rdzong khungs nas rong po sde dgon de tshong dga' che shos yin/ rong po rgyal rab thang du mdo khams kyi tshong rigs 'ga' zhig rgyun sdod kyis tshongalas gnyer gyi yod/ rab dgon spyi gso ni rim pas tshong pa stobs chen zhig la 'gyur nas rang rgyal gyi khrin tu nas phyi rgyal gyi ka sbug bar tshong skyod byed pa dang lha sa gtsos bod kyi sa gnas kha shas su tshong lag kyang yod pa yin/dge rgan ming thog gi gra ba 'ga' zhig kyang tshong dpon ji lta ba yin/sde yi dpon gnyer dang 'byor phyug tshos gcig stangs gcig byed kyis tshong gi 'khor lo bskor ba red/(4) phyis gdan sa nas btang ba'i dgon khag gi mkhan po'am zhabs gras tshos 'bri gser khral sdud pa'i lad mo byed de mi ser la tshong dang khe bun btang nas zhal rgyu nor la phyogs pa yin 'dug(5) dpon rigs dang tshong rigs spyi gso dang mchod gnyer bcas kyis mi ser skabs 'khral dka' ngal can la khung bu 'tshol nas rang nyid kyi ma rtsa 'phel phyir dngul bun dang 'bru bun sogs btang ba dang ma sod na skyed la skyed rgyag gis bun len mkhan dam sug tshud nas sprang po lag stong du gyur pa'am yul byo0/ 126

gnas spo bya dgos thug gi yod pa red la mtha' na rang rgyud kyi bu yang bu lon 'jal byad byas pa byung 'dug dper na/ lo rgyus 'di'i rgyu cha 'tshol sdud kyi skyar 'dri zhu sa sog g.yag la'i grong mi lo don drug la song ba'i bgres song bsod nams 'byor ldan khong yang chung dus pha mas bu lon ma sod skabs bun dmigs su rtsis nas 'bri chu gser sdud par sprad pa red gsung (phyis pha yul du bros yong ba red/ )(6) sde dgon mnyam 'dzoms mi 'du rta tshogs kyi dus chen ni sog tsan dan dgon gyi dbyar gnas chab bzhugs skabs dgon pa'i gur chen phub nas dbyar skyid gtong ba dang lhan du yul sde yang ltad mor 'du nas rta rgyug mda' 'phen gong 'gyur sogs rta rtsal sna 'ga' zhig ston srol yod pa red/ de ni dang thog bod sog pa sog po gu thi han gyis 'dzin skabs lha sa'i smon lam gyi rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen nang zhugs dgos yod 'dug pa de rjes su tsan dan dgon pa'i dar ma chos mdzad zer bas gong zhus don song lha skyod rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen du zhugs ma dgos pa sog rang du dga' ldan 'khel du zhugs ma dadagos pa sog rang du dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling gi chab bzhugs kyi dus dang bstun rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen gyi rnam pa bzhin byas na chog 'thus byung bar brten/ de tshun sog pa sde dgon nas tsan dan dgon pa'i dbyar gnas mjug dbyar skyid skabs rta rgyug zhar 'phen byedapol byung 'dug(7) cung pa chos 'khor dgon gyi dbyar gnas dgag dbye'i skabs dang bstun bkra skus thang du gur chen phub nas dbyar skyid gtong bsang skor byed pa dang rta rgyug mi rgyug zhar 'phen yub 127

'gyur shes rtsal 'gran pa sbod 'phen tsha kha lta ba sogs rtsed sna mang po 'gran pa'i yul sde yang der lta ba dang zhugs par yong srol yod/(8) rong po dgon sde'i dus ston che shos ni rab brtan dgon pa'i lo gsar kha zer ba de yin/ bod lo'i lo gsar skabs rab dgon gyis gar 'cham rgyag pa dang sde 'du dpon tshogs byed yul de'i tshong rigs khag dang phyogs gzhan gyi tshong pa yang mang po 'dzoms nas pags rig dang 'bu rdza/ sha ra gla rtsi sogs zong chas nyo tshong 'khrug po yod gar 'cham la lta ba dang lo gsar gyi gnang ba yod pas rol rtsed rtse ba sogs byed srol yod/(9) sgyu rtsal re dkar sog gsum khongs ras pa'i rtsa 'dzugs 'ga' zhig yod pa ste/ sog zhol pa'i nang yod pa dang cung pa dang rong po la'ang yod/ 1945lo skor cung pa rag rdo bla brang gis chos 'khor zhol pa'i nang nas na gzhon 'ga' zhig bsdus te lha mo 'khrab pa'i rtsa 'dzugs bzos yod rung yun ring po ma brtan par rag rdo sku phreng drug pa 'das rjes lha mo'i rtsa 'dzugs de 'thor pa red/ ras pa la bde rtsal gyi 'khrug cha thun mong ma yin pa yod pa ma zad da lta'i gtam brjod zlos gar ltar gyi rnam pa yang ston rgyu yod pas mi tshos dga' po byed pa dang 6 ltad mos mig gi bun lon sod pa zhig yod zer/(10)sngar grong tsho so so'i nang tshes bcu nyer lnga'i dus su ma ṇi rdo 'bum bskor zhor gro khrab pa dang gro shag rgyag pa glu len glu shag 'gyed pa shed rdo pang ba dang shugs g.yug pa sogs rtse mo rtsed nas thun mong gis ja thug bkol ba bcas byed pa red/(11) srol rgyun gnyen sgrig gnyen ya tsho shog nang khul 128

yin na gtam don gnyen bshad shod mi dgos ra sdus tsam byed srol dang / gnyen 4/ yu la gzhan dang tsho shog kha kha dpon lding mi che bla grags phan tshun yin na gnyen sgrig gra rgyal po dang gtam 'don gnyen bshad blo la 'dzin gnas gzhan phyogs non thabs kyi gzab gzab byed pa dang kha pho shed chen po yod pa red/( 12) 'das 'jug 6‘'grul 7 zer ba ('dir byang rigs rgyud du sna thab 7kyi 'brel ba zer ba dang gcig pa yin ) dud tshang phan tshun nam rgyun nye grogs kyi 'brel ba zab los la brten nas gshin po'i nang tshang du mar me 'bul yas mar dang dngul 'bru gang 'tshams sprod srol yod/ gal te phyogs gcig gi mi shi byung bar ma yag mar med de ma sprad na 66'grul bcad 7pa zer thabs sdug la brtsi ba red/ shi chos ni chos lugs grub mtha' ma 'dra bar byed srol mi 'dra yod pa de bzhin byed pa yin/( 12) skyes pa'i mgo lus kyi gos rgyan 'gyur ldog lo drug cu zin nye'i dran tshod la cung pa'i nang la dper mtshon na dang po mgo skra ltag phud sga dor zer ba gla nas ras dmar po 'am nag pos g.yog ste de thog a long phra can dang ba so'i mtheb skor dngul ga sgor chung bcas kyis brgyan skra gzhug nag po tong skud dam la ra mtha' na rgyun bu'i phya lo bzos nas mgor dkri 'gram skra mdun nas len bu lhas te g.yas g.yon nas dzar ba yin/ (kha shas kyis 'dzing mo thug nas gri g.yug kha bkye na phan zer ltag phud nang la lcags skud bcug pa yin ) zhwa mo dgun dus wa zhwa gyon zhwa tshad phru gang zer mdun ngos zhwa sgyur cung tsam gyis lhag ma ltag rgyab tu glu'aphyang ba/ dbyar dus 'bu ras a tis dmar smug mgo la dkri ba 129

yin/ rgyu zhan tsam gyis dgun zhwa wa zhwa gyon rgyu med rung / mgo ras dang og dkris tshar ru gru ling rgyag gyon gos kyi dbye ba phu dung sbom la thung ba/ rkang gos ha lam med cing mdun thu de tsam mi bsnor ba/ spus shub tsha ru 'am pags pa lung can sked par drangs/ sked rag gos sna ring po bcings lham thag lham mam ras mgo sna gnyis sam rgyu yod tshor ko mgo sna ril gyon bar skabs 'gyur ba mgo skra 'gram rtsa'i len bu bzhar ba dang / ltag phud thog rgyan mang po med pa/ g.yu byur gsu ma mas gzi byur gsum yang na g.yang ṭi'i ba so'i 'theb sgor gang red re las rgyag gi med pa/ skra gzhug dmar po chun po nyung tsam yod pa/ mdun skra thod rtsid nyung ngu bzo lta bkod pa cung gug pa'i bya mchu 'dra ba yod/dgun zhwa wa zhwa'i ring tshad sngar las thung zhing mtho gang sor lnga tsam yod pa de'ang mdun nas zhwa sgyur rgyag pa las rgyab la 'phyang rgyu med/dbyar mgo ras mi dkri zhing / dbyar zhwa phying zhwa dgra gtor ma rtse brno can rtser ras 'ja' sgrig pa/ rgyab nas an tsam sgyur ba'i mtha' rgyan nag po can de 'dra gyon pa yin/ de nas yang rgya gar dmag zhwa zer ba'i yang zhwa thon pas des de'i tshab byas te gyon lus gos phu thung sbom la thung ba de phra la ring bar gyur mthu ba bsnor che gos dung rkang nam zer ba gyon pas gos sna sked rag thung thung bsdams/ rkang nam 'bu ras dkar po 'am ras lug lan zer ba dkar po'i dor ma gong ba thung tsam dor sna ring po yod pa lham sgrog bsdams rjes spu thog nas mar lhug lhug tu 'phyang ba ras pa'i gos thung ltar yod/ lham la 'gyur ba cher med rjes kyi 'gyur ba/mgo skra thod sgo phyes te lcang lo rgyab tu lhas pa las thod rtsid mi 'jog 130

la/ skra gzhug dmar po 'am/ nag po sbom la ring ba'i cun po lci tshad rgya ma gang las brgal ba rgyag skra 'dzin dngul leb phra can nam phra med 'ur mthil gzugs kyis brgyan gos ni bar skabs ltar yin pa dang / gos thung rkang nam ni ras pa bzhin mi lhug par 'jug rta gyon mang ba bcas red/ 7 dmag don dang phyi nangadagra gyod che rigasasgor/(1) bod sa gnas srid gzhung btsan dga' kha bral—stobs shugs kyis chab srid dgos mkhor gzhigs te gzhung sde spyi mtshungs ltar re dkar sog gsum gyi yul dmag thengs kha shas bsdu gtong byas yod pa/ dper na sgang ga tha ma gtor ba'i nang phyin pa dang chu glang lor 'bri rur lu cun dmag la rgol skabs lho ngos rgyal ston gyi dmag dang byang ngos re dkur sog gsum gyi dmag byas te lu cun bar du gcur nas 'thab pa/ lcags ltag lor khyung po gser tsha'i tsha 'bang dgon du sa srung la phyin pa bcas byung yod/(chu glang lo'i rjes tsam la lho rta sho gsum dang rgyal ston yul dmag bcas khams 'dan ma dang skye mdo'i nang chen rgyud du skor skyod dmag las byed skabs re dkar sog gsum gyi dmag kyang phyin yod tshod las gsal po ma rtogs ) sngar sog pa'i dmag de g.yas ru'i dmag dpon dar ma dang g.yon ru'i dmag dpon 'brug stag red zer srol tsam las dmag dngos skyod skabs lding dpon mi 'gro ba yin 'dug dmag bsdu skabs khral mgo la gzhigs pa'i dmag grangs thob bgos byed nas glas dmag mi yan glas te btang gi yod 131

pa ngang de greri thogi gron tshang rma gla nga/da4// khra' du/da kyis 'ab/na le da dgos pa rang ra ngag rabri dwar la can dmag la 'gab skabs ri ring ri'iri rig sha sgorgan gtso ngang gra pa 'ga' shas kyang song yod pas dmag sar a mdo rgan po nga nga / grwa pa gcig gtsos te zung bsad rmas byung yod pa dang 'di dwas sog pa'i dmag mi beb chags tshe bkra zer bas nus pa gzar thon byung stabs rjes cu0/ sog rdzong khongs la rngon rgya ngam po je 'dra yod rung geb chags tshe bkras rang mos lngar ri dwags rngon rung rtsa ra mi byed pa'i dmigs bsal yod pa red zer /sgang ga tha ma gtor ba'i nang dmag mang shos cung pas btang yod pa de de gong ga tha dang cung pa dbar 'gal zla chen po yod pas yin 'dug ( 2 ) rong po dang khrom tshang bar gyi 'gal 'khrug hor spyi gsum pa g.yu thog pa (g.yu thog pa yin snyam pa las gtan po ma nges )steng chen nas lha sar skyod skabs rong khrom bar gyi gzhung lam zam pa chus khyer lam sgrol thub min skabs hor spyis khrom tshang tsho par zam shing mgyogs 'thus zam rgyag myur thon le shor med pa dgos lugs bka' baja byung bar khrom tshang gis rong po dris rong lung sdod nas rong dpon sba rgan tshang gi bla shing yin zer ba'i bkag shing nas zam gdung bzhi bcad nas bzhag par rong po'i pho gsar 'ga' zhig gis zam gdung de dum bu mang po gtub rkyen skabs 'khral zam pa ma thon stabs khrom tshang pas zhu gtug byas pa dang rong pos gser lam sked pa bcad pa'i gnad don lhags te hor spyi g.yu thog pa sa gnas 'byor mtshams rong po dpon gnyer bkug ste nyes pa rta lcag btang skabs rong po dpon rgan bstan rgyas grags pa nas mgo sgur nyes zhu ma byas par ngar gtam kha med mig 132

med gtong gi yod pa dang phyir log nas rong po dpon gyi bu ga 'jigs dang / sba rgan chos mdzad bcas kyis rogs pa mang po dang lhan du nang la 'ur rtsis byas par hor spyi'i sku srung dmag gis phyogs gcig nas rgya sgo dam por brgyab pa dang / phyogs gcig nas khong khro chen pos dpon rgan la rta lcag tshod med gzhus te phyir spred pas lo na mtho ba dang / khrag rlung 'bar nas mun ring ma brtan par rong po dpon rgan grongs pa red/ gru gnyer bas sdar skad rgyab pas ma shi tsam byung 'dug ga 'jigs can nas hor spyir kha gtad bcar te dem ji'i khul du bros rtsis gleng bar dpon rgan 'das khar nga yang ngar bas rkyen shi ba red/ khyod tshos sde pa— gzhung la kha gtad bcar na rong po sde dgon chags mi yong bas de 'dra byed mi 'os ze bshad skad 'dug skabs der khrom tshang span ne rgan pos rong pos ya med byed dogs byung nas 'khral thon byas par sba rgan ga 'jigs skya mi kha shas kyis rjes 'ded byas te chags la'i la gong nas rjes zin te khrom tshang rgan po de gar bsad pa dang /g.yog po skyab la bkug ste ro gzor 'khen bcug yod/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis rong khrom par 'gal ba dza drag byung nas dmag thug grab kyi gnas tshul byung ba'i skabs bod kyi bla chen kha bong kha byon nas kha mchu nang 'dom gyis mi stong 'bri thus brgyad cu sprad de rong khrom bar gyi 'gal ba zhi lhod gyur ba red/ ( 2) cung pa chos 'khor dgon dang rdo ba shog kha gnyis 'dzing rtsod mi bsad kyi don rkyen byung nas kha mchu gzhung gtug 'khel yod pa/ (4) mdo spyi bka' bla byam pa bstan dar skabs cung pa chos 'khor dgon dang hor ye tha dbar wa chen byis sba zer ba'i sa'i skor kha mchu byung ba/133 ——— —— — ——

(5) tā la 'i bcu sa/su ca nga meb rgyal nang sar phebs pa'i skabs skor du sog tsan dan dgon dang hor tsho'i glu ting phur gsum gyi bon dgon dbar ban de bu khral gyi don du kha mchu byung ba/ (6)sde srid sangs rgyam pa'i sku dus rong po rab brtan dgon dang lcam mda' dgon dbar dkor sa dge khongs kyi don du kha mchu byung ba/(7)yang bar skabs shig tu nis yer sa cha'i skor rab dgon dang 'dre dag tsho ba dbar kha mchu byung (〈) re dkar sog gsum gyi sde dgon nang khul du'ang cung par dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs bzhi bcu pa'i skor la mang rje sbra chen dang sbra chung bar 'gal 'khrug byung nas gnyis ka yul thon nas skye mdo dang 'brong stod so sor rgyab rten re bcol thog phan tshun gyi 'khon yod phyogs la dgra jag mi bsad sogs byas rjes sbra chung tshang chung pa'i 'go pa tshos nang 'dom bzos te slar tshur skyod gzhis chags byung ba red/ (9) cung pa'i rag rdo sprul sku dang chos 'khor dgon bar kha mchu byung nas gzhung gtug 'khel ba (10) lcags stag lor tsan dan dgon pas zhol rnying ma'i ka brgya sngags dgon thog gra ba 'ur nas gu gu'i sku gtor ba sngags dgon dang tsan dan dgon bar kha mchu gzhung gtug 'khel ba bcas byung myong ba de tsho 'gal rtsod che rigs sha stag yin//chos lugs dgon sde dang gragasayodami sna sogasakyisgon dang tshag cig kha shas bcas/rgyal dbang lnga pas btab pa'i sog gi dgon chen gsum ni sde 134

srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dga' ldan chos 'byung beeḍūr ser po'i nang 'khod 4bar kham byang rgyud sog tsan dan dgon dar lugs ka mi gtsang zhing chos rje gatho pa ljang zhabs su 'byon pa'i bya len mtshang skyel du ma zad sngar rgyun dpa' thal gyi byed spyod mang ba sogs sgo du ma nas gra rnying rnams phal cher 'khos shul sa kho sprel lor gsar du tshugs dga' ldan 'khel rgyas gling zhes sogaso //// //bye/ /spro(/ 11rdo/ /nges 1spro// 1)/ sgyu |da na gsum btab la da pa da sa gar da na da da na la sgyur lugs mngon 'dug de'i gong sog pa'i nang kur dgon gra phug zer ba dang / ka brgya ma zer ('di rnying pa'i gter chen nyang ral nas btabs yod pa )tsan dan dgon a ne nam gra ba 'dres pa rdza lding dgon 'brang ngur gong ma'i gdan sa/ da dung cham chu yar khar sog g.yung gling dgon bon lugs bcas yod 'dugasngar gyi gtam dper 4sog tsan dan dgon pa'i a ne de mi mi lo bsam nas rang lus mdzad ces pa de'ang 'di dus byung ba yin 'dug da dung 4sog rong gnyan sde yag kha 'dra/ a mchod thug pa yar 'dren zer ba'i dpe byung (de ni gras mjug nas yar thug pa drangs na gras 'gor slebs dus thug rdor sha dog thon pas red )kar dgon dang bon dgon gtor stong gyur nas dga' ldan 'khel gling du sgyur skabs gong gsal dgon khag gi nang rten dang dngos rdzas 'ga' zhig der gcig sdud byas yod 'dug pa dper na sog g.yung drung gling gi dngul sku ston pa gshen rab dang gshen lha 'od dkar gyi sku kham chen gser bris ma dung dkar rag gshog ma bcas dang rdza lding dgon pa'i 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i thugs dam rten spyan ras gzigs kyi sku li ma kur dgon brag phug gi mchod 135

rdzas kong bu dang mkhar sder ka brgya ma'i mgon po'i zhal thang sog rong gnyan sde'i rten gtso thub pa mi tshad ma/ a ne dgon gyi tsan dan ka ba sogs yod pa red dgon pa 'gyur ldog byung rung tsan dan ka ba de rang spyad pa'i yongs grags kyi ming tsan dan dgon pa'i tha snyad rang 'jags byung ba red/ cung pa'i nang chos 'khor dgon pa ma chags gong kur dgon rngod rtse zer ba yod 'dug la/gzu ba'i nang bon dgon zhig kyang chags myong zer/ kha shas kyis rngod rtse rdzong zer ba zhig gyang yod tshul gleng / nye dus dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs brgyad bcu pa'i nang chos 'khor dgon nyams gso byed skabs lha khang gyang rnying gi rtseg ldebs zhar ba phyi nang gnyis kyi lha ris rnying god thon yod pa red/ rong po rab brtan dgon ma byung dus kur dgon sa ma lcags ra dang ba gam rgyud du yang dgon shul yod pa ma zad dris rong du mkhar sngon dgon zer ba yod 'dug de yang kha dpe ru smyo mkhar sngon dgon pa yas kha la/ dung gar phu shed su che red ces zer srol mchis/ yang sog tsan dan dgon gyis rjes sor ser ba srung ba'i ser dung 'bud skabs sog zam yan chad la g.yung drung gling gi dung rag shog ma 'bud pa dang /zam pa phyin chad lhag dung skal babang dbang ldan gyi gter dung zer ba de 'bud kyi yod 'dug (lha gdung skal bzang dbang ldan ni tsan dan dgon dngos su phyag 'debs mdzad po rang yin pa ) yang tsan dan dgon chags sa'i glang dkar de'u der sngar 'brong ngur gong /bye/ (1) ༷dro/ chu ri re:bye che/rdo/rje//rje( bcardo ༷jo/ba gdan sa na stabs 'a nga ngu' sa srung nga ba na ra ba de rjes su dgon pa'i chos srung du rten srol 'dug sog rdzong khul gyi tsan dan dgon dang chos 'khor dgon rab brtan dgon 136

gsum la smad kyi dga' ldan rnam gsum zer snyan grags che tsam yod/de'ang dang po 'khel zhing rgyas pa'i sog 'phel rgyas gling / bar du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba cung pa chos 'khor dgon/ mtha' ma rab tu brtan pa rong po rab brtan dgon zhes zer srol yod/dgon 'di gsum rim bzhin phogs dgon yang dang po dang /gnyis pa/ gsum pa red/ yang zer srol la sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho a co gnas bskor ba'i chas spras te bod kyi dge dgon gang sar phebs skyod kyis de tsho'i chos spyod dang 'dul khrims la nyam zhib gnang skabs cung pa chos 'khor dgon pa de legs shos su gzigs nas phogs snon sprad pa red zer/dgon pa 'di rnams la tā la'i lnga pa'i shel bam drug pa'i rtsa tshig bdun pa'i rgyab snon zer ba'i gtan tshig yod la tsan dan dgon du lus phrug sum cu dang hor phrug sum cu zer ba'i gra khral sgrub lam yod pa zer/ chos 'khor dgon du cung pa smos ci khri rdo dang dmar khrom sogs la'ang gra khral skul chog gi bka' rten yod skad rab brtan dgon la rong po shog kha phyed brgyad nas ban de bu khral bsdu rgyu yod pa dang dper na nems tsha spang dkyil dgon gyi gra ba'i lnga cha gcig rab dgon du sgrub dgos zer rgyun 'dugagazhan yang dgon pa de tshor mgo btags mi ser yod cing /'brog sgra dang zhing gzhis rtswa thang bcas bdag rgyu yod pa ma zad/gzhung phogs kyang yod pa'i phogs gzhis zung 'brel gyi dgon pa yin 'dug 'di ga'i dgon pa'i nang gi rten dang brten pa 4mthong ba tsam gyis dad mos skyes dgos pa zhig yod pa red/dgon par chos khrims kyi sgrig gzhi cha tshang ldan zhing tā la'i bdun 137

pa rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos rtsal ba'i bca' yig yod pa de'i nang 'di ltar 4rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis gzhan gnod bzhi bcas spong bar khas blangs nas/ dgra la sdug las thongs pa'i pho rgod po/ rang gi sdom gsum yul nas 'don nyen gda'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gis khas blangs pa'i sdom gsum yul bton nas chags sdang gi kun nas bslangs te gzhan la gnod ci 'khyol byed pa dang rang la 'dod yon ri rab kyi gtos dang mnyam pa byung kyang ngom pa med pa'i srid zhen can la ni lus kyi rtags mi 'dra ba tsam las khyim pa kho na dang khyad med pas na/dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las tshul khrims 'di ni bde ba'i mchog tshul khrims 'di ni thar pa'i lam tshul khrims 'di ni yon tan gzhi/ tshul khrims 'di ni sangs rgyas rgyu zhes sogs nas dge 'dun pa'i bslab sdom srung lugs dang sgrig lam zhib phra bstan yod pa 'dugadagon lha sde'i bca' ya chos khrims zer ba ni bca' yig ltar chos khrims bcas ba yig la gzhig bzung sa yang de red/ dgon par chos 'dul ba bzhin lam bslab pa gsum la rting tshags shing mchogazi tsho zi dzozi tsho the:dro rjo garte ga ra milung sda snad gsum la zla sbyang nas sa brgyad kya dra mas ma sbag par dge 'dun sgrig 'og nas sangs rgyas zer ba'i dpe ltar bslab khrims mig 'bras ltar srung mkhan yang mang zhig mchis la de las ldog nas bstan par sma 'byin dang / khyim pa sun 'byin byed pa rtsod sna gyod gzhi 'dren zhing rtsing hral gyi spyod tshul gang byung can yang ma nyung tsam yod 'dugadagon pa 'di gsum gyi mkhan po rnams dang thog ser smad gra 138

tshang nas gtong gi yod 'dug pa de ni gu thi han gdan sa'i khungs 'bras har gdong khang mtshan nas yin stabs sog rdzong mi 'gro de nas gtong srol byung ba/ de nang bzhin sde srid sangs rgyam pa ser smad nas yin gshis 'di ga'i dge dgon gyi mkhan po yang ser smad nas btang don de yin 'dug spyir rdzong khongs mi ser nas nang bstan grub mtha'i nang gi ri bo dga' ldan par dad zhen che rung /sog rong dang cung par rnying ma'i grub mkhar dad zhen byed mkhan ma nyung ba yod la grong tsho mang po la rnying lugs kyi tshes bcu lha khang yod/spu la sde dud kyis ni bon chos la 'dod zhen byed pa bcas yin red dkar sog gsum gyi gra sa ni 'bras glo gling dang rgyud smad pa red/rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa kham mgar thar nas chib kha sgyur te yar lam 'di rgyud nas phebs yod pas dkar shod chos 'khor dgon dang sog 'khol rgyas gling bcas nas 'bul ba spam mtho phul nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btabs tshul dang cung pa lha dar dang hor chos 'bum nas 'bul ba phul tshul sogs rnam thar du gsal 'dug gzhan yang ched mngag gdan zhus sam/ phyogs phebs lam 'khel byung ba'i dbus gtsang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan yongs grags pa 'ga' zhig gis chos 'khor skor ba'i gnas tshul 'dug sog rdzong khul du spyir btang 'brog khul dang mi 'dra bar ser sa ha cang mtho zhing bla ma gra pa la 'jog sgo gzhan dang mi 'dra ba red/ yang rong po'i nang la bar skabs dud tshang sgo bshas spangs mkhan 'ga' zhig yod pa bcas de min sog khul du ka rog dang ka brgyad bcas rnying ma'i sngags dgon dang / zhwa ser dgon pa sogs dgon pa dang ri khrod 'ga' zhig yod pa lo rgyud 139

zur du 'don rgyu yin stabs 'dir ma bris/( 2 ) re dkar sog gsum gyi nang la phyogs gang spyi'i mi sna snyan grags che ba byung rabs mi 'dug rung cung zad 'bur thon gleng rgyu yod pa ni/ dar lding rgyal po zer ba dang / nor bu zer ba/ dar ma chos mdzad zer ba rong po dpon bstan rgyas grags pa/'ug chung mgon po nyi shar/ cung pa'i sngar gzu pa dpon dang de nas dkar rong rgan po kom tshag can zer ba dang / cung pa'i spyi mi dpon gnas 'phar ba de dang rjes kyi mang rje dar dga' bcas red/ dar lding nor bu'i shes yon la hor spyi grags rnam ha las skad dang / dar ma chos mdzad ni grags rnam gyi mgron gnyer byas pa dang sog par lha sar rdzong rgyab zhar 'khen 'gro mi dgos pa bzo mi de yin pa rjes su sa gnas srid gzhung gi zhabs sdod zhu rtsis skabs grongs pa red/ kham skyod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag 'gas tsan dan dgon par tshogs mjal zhu skabs dar ma chos mdzad gral mgo la med pa ha las pa red zer (bslab gral mtho po min pa yin 'dug ) rong po dpon bstan rgyas grags pa ni hor spyi'i rta lcag 'og grongs pa de yin pa dang mgon po nyi shar ni rong po'i gnyer pa yin la tshong dpon zhig kyang red/ des rab brtan dgon par gser zangs kyi rgyal ba byam pa thog rtsegs zin pa bzhengs pa sogs dgon par rten bzhengs dang / tshogs sbyar zhu mi yin bdag chen po zhig yin la/ dgon don blo 'dri byed sa yang red/ 'dir kha dpe yod pa ni/ a shar skor rgyug ling ling 'du gra tshom ba hrug hrag che le dri ma 'tshab 'tshab zer ba byang / rig rir rang zir ra༅ sngar cung pa'i gzu pa dpon zer ba de gzhi bdag gi rdzus bu yin 140

zer srol dang mda' kha dpa' rtsal 'gran zla med pa yin 'dugagong gsal khyung po bla ma bkrongs mkhan de red/ spyi mi dpon du 'khar ba ni khral khrims khur shes che la gong rim la sri zhu lhad med yin pa'i ming yod dkar rong rgan po kom tshag can zer ba des 'bru khral dang btsag khral mi dgos pa bzo thub mkhan mi ser nyam chung gi don sgrub pas ming 'dug la/ kho rang yang 'byor ba zhan tsam yin pas gyon gos bis gom gyi slog pa las med pa red/mang rje dar dga' ni dang po khral pa spyir btang ba nas dgra gyod mang po mgo la 'khel skabs mi zhum btsan shugs kyi byed las thon pa dang byang la 'gro skabs 'khor dud kyang mang tsam yod pa rjes sor pha yul log rjes cung pa'i mi grags dang / zhi ba'i bcings 'grol zin nas gzhung gis bkod sgrig dang rgyal gces gong rim mi sna'i gras yin pa bcas red/ sog dar ma lding dpon nor bu dang / tsan dan dgon gyi dar ma chos mdzad gnyis khyim gcig pha ma gcig pa'i spun mched yin rung sde dgon gnyis kha mchu byung skabs so sos kha 'dzin byas te lha sar gzhung gtug phyin nas nyin sar kha mchu rtsod pa dang dgong mo gnas tshang gcig yin pa'i spun gyi brtse dung sngar rgyun bzhin phan tshun brtsi bkur dang ha ha ho ho'i ngang sdod kyi yod pa red/ nyin zhig gdong gsher thug par lding dpon nor bu gtan tshig rno bas chos mdzad nas gtam lan ma thebs par ngar ngu shor/ de phral 'geb byed du ngas spun 'di lta bu'i bstan pa dgon pa la gyod 'dzugs mkhan gyi sdig lto can byung ba snying re rje zer bshad tshul gleng rgyu 'dug mthar kha mchu khrun chod kyis sde la cung zad rgyal ba'i chod khra thon/ mar lam yang 141

lding dpon skya ser kho rang gnyis lhan gcig yong / rgyun du chos mdzad las gus yangs po yod pas tshugs bab pa da gar bud shing 'thu rgyu dang skyod khar rta drel bsdu rgyu khong rang gis byed nas gcen po lding dpon nor bu la 'jog sgo shin tu che/ sog la slebs ran kha'i phyo tshugs khar dar ma chos 'dzad kyis/ do dgong nga ni dgon dang khyed ni nang la 'byor rgyu red/ gyod khra de lta yag cig ma byas na sang nyin dgon par gnas tshul zhib zhu mi rnyed zer nas spun nor bu las gyod khra tshur blangs na me 'gram du me bde bzhin chod /)sgo /re/ 1re//nye/ lha// 151 the:rdog la lta na sdad/ na nga da na ra bu rta bsdu bar ma phyin thabs med byung bas sgar du slebs nye'i mtshams/ glo bur du chos mdzad gza' nad lta bus lus 'dar lag nang gi yig cha me nang du shor nas 'tshigs pa ma zad gos mtha' med la thug nas ril yod pa lding dpon nas mthong bas nad dos drag gis spun chos mdzad 'jom sar 'jigs nas skyob thabs kyis nang du bskyal/rjes sor de ni dar ma chos mdzad g.yo thabs che bas gza' nad phog khul gyis kha mchu'i 'bras bu me la gregs sa zhig yin pa gzhi nas shes so/gzhan yang rong po'i dpon chung a nu bcu gsum gyi gras yin pa'i pā rgan yul pa stobs chung zer ba blo shed ya yud 'dzing la dga' ba zhig byung yod/ des chab mdo mtshan nyid tshong gi rogs su kong por tshong skyod skabs/ stong por skabs der kham sa ngan nas dongs pa'i jag kun mang po yod pa nas re ste g.yung drung zer ba'i khrom dpung gis stobs chung gi lag do nas rta drel kha shas rku 'phrog byas par rjes 'ded kyis sprang 'phrang nyis bar nas dod te 142

'dzing skabs stobs chung mi gcig gis re ste g.yung drung bcas mi bzhi bsad pa dang gsod stangs kyang ki res sna la sbod re brgyab nas mi re bsad pa red/ der kong po jo mo rdzong nas mi bsad khrims 'gal zer 'gug 'bod byung bar rdzong rtsar bcar nas jag rkun bsad par dpa' dar ma thob rung 'gug 'bod byed don med lugs brjod nas mgo bos yu rdung mang pos rdzong dpon khri las 'phang ba dang de nas lha sar phyin nas sag zhung la kong yul gnod 'tshe'i gzhi ma re jag gte bsad lugs zhus par ring min bka' 'gag nas jag bsad dpa' dar kha btags bkon pa dang kha —btags dgon bzhin ngang jo khang bar skor thengs gsum phyin pa'i dpa' gtam gleng rgyu 'dug stobs chung kho rang la bu med pa'i mag pa btsal bar rong po'i dpon gnyer la brjod pa/ nged tshang /je/ 11| /)(/)kyi /nge /re/ /)sgo //rto /ste/95 mag pa ga da sa pa ba/tam ga bsdo ba/sde/ma rwasdin dgos la rgyu nor can yang mi dgos/ nga rgas po'i 'dod pa ltar g.yul la dpa' zhing 'dzing la dga' ba ki ho ho zer dus sngon la slebs mkhan zhig btsal rogs zer gyi yod pa red/yang de dang 'dra ba'i rgod yum dang rgod rgan zer ba mi tshe mi bsad 'dzing rtsod la skyel mkhan yod pa red/ nam rgyun ge sar sgrung la dga' po byed pa dang sgrung yig klog skabs g.yul 'khrug drag po'i mtshams su glo bur du rtsar re langs nas yar 'gro mar 'gro'i ngang mna' chen po skyal ba dang sprags nga de dus med pa ci yin na zer ba yang yang gleng gi yod pa red/sog rdzong khong nas gso rig dang dkar rtsis gtsos rig —gnas dang chos phyogs nas snyan grags cung zad yod pa bka' chen 143

mtshams sa blo bzang bsam gtan zhu ba byung yod/ khong ni dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i nang bar bzhugs yod/de'ang darnga thog sngags pa yin pa dang / de rjes rab byung bsgrubs nas stag phu padma beedzar gyi slob ma dang mgron gnyer yang byed myong mkhas btsun gyi bla ma mang po bsten pas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas gang la'ang gzhan dring ma 'jog pa'i mkhyen spob ldan/ rgyun du bka' chen ri khrod du mtsham la bzhugs pas mi tshos bka' chen mtshams pa zhes 'bod sna yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ ma bsdus par yang rang bzhin 'du/ dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor zhes pa ltar sog shul smos ci phyogs gzhan nas khongs la bsten te yon tan sbyong mkhan mang po 'du/sog shod dang nags shod rgyud bcas la khong gis gso skyong gnang ba'i gso ba rig pa dang / dkar rtsis pa yig 'bri ba bcas gang sar khyab nas yod/ nye dus bar bzhugs pa ( 1991lor grong pa ) nag chu sa khul sman rtsis khang gi dge rgan bgres song a rig nor bu yang 'di pa'i slob ma yin/ yang sog rdzong dpon gzhung zhabs khri smon pas gtong skabs sog la slob grwa zhig btsugs par phan 'bras phran bu thon skad skabs der slob grwar phyin mkhan mi snas rjes sor dgon rdzong gi yig 'bri ba thabs chag cig byed thub kyi yod pa red/ rdzong lo gsum 'kho len rjes slob grwa de yang 'thor ba red 'dug yang shod srol la sngar lho lcags ra lding dpon zer ba khrims med lugs med cig yod par sog rdzong lcang dkar ngang ba zer ba der gong gi bka' don lcags lding med pa bzo dgos phabs par rdzong dpon gyis sog khul nas de don sgrub par khas len thon 144

ma ban yod med 'dri ska bas sog pa'i me nyag dar darnga/ra rngir bas kho nge sa 'jon par khas blangs/ der rdzong dpo na gyis jus bkod nas kho rang dang me nyag dar dmar gnyis po las rogs mi gzhan ngag med par rta shed bems dang sbrags lcags ra lding dngo na sar byi na nas skyabs bcol byed mkhan yin khul gyi g.yo sbrid gtong bas yid ches thob zla 2lhag tsam bsdad rjes nyin zhig kho rang gnyis kyis don chen gsang gtam zhu rgyu yod mdog gis lcags lding gcig po'i sar phyin nas g.yog po gzhan dag med skabs sog rdzong lcang dkar ngang bas gong gi bka' ltar khyod gsod par nga gnyis btang byung bas da ci ltar byed ces drang gtam brjod par lcags lding ngar rgod 'khrug nas lam seng rtsar langs kyis gri phud de gnam la 'phyar bas gri ring khang pa'i thog spang la thogs pa dang lhan du me nyag dar dmar gyis gri thung btsug nas lcags lding lnga lam du btang ba dang de bzo zer ba'i 'bod pa dang bcas phung ro de sgis khung nas dbyug pas lcags lding gi nang 'khor dang der yod grong mi tsho hang sangs nas 'dzing ba'i spob pa med par lam seng lug sha mgo 'byar mang po phul nas mgo sgus pa red zer med nyag tshang de dus kyi byas rjes la brten nas khral chag yod pa de rjes sor yang gnas yod pas gong gsal sgrung gtam lta bu de bden pa'i cha yang yod 'dug( 2) shod srol sogs tsag tsig kha shas bod sog par sngar nas yod pa'i khyim rgyud dud chen yin la bla ma'i rus kyang yin zer ba'i dud gsum yod pa ste ra gu 'brong lha gsum 7zhes pa de gu ni gu gu bla ma zer ba'i sger btsan bla brang lta bu zhig yod pa de sog chu'i smad du yod/ 'brong ni 'brong ngur gyi bla brang yin la sngon 145

dang po tsan dan dgon pa chags sa'i de'u thog yod pa dang rjes sor nags shod rgyud la song skad ma zad ba chen sa mtshams rdza gseb du'ang yod pa rjes su shul dong ba red/ lha ni lha gdung ngam rlangs kyi po ti bse tu'i nang lag a mes byang chub 'dre bkol sog la byon dus lha ston gyis lha khang 'bul tshul 'dug pa'i lha ston de rang yin nges stabs lha ston yang zer gyi yod 'dug de tshang khro phu thang la yod/ lha gdung skal bzang dbang ldan gtsos bla ma 'khrungs pa'i yab tshang yang red/ yang bod sog pa'i nang 'brug stag zer ba'i rus rgyud yod pa de'i shod srol ni 'brug dkar bla ma'i gdung rgyud/ 'brug ser sman pa'i gdung rgyud/ 'brug nag sngags pa'i gdung rgyud zer sngar bon dgon sog g.yung drung gling la 'brug stag gis bla ma byas skad la g.yung drung gling gtor rjes de ga'i nang rdzas rnga gshin rje'i brang khog dang / rkang gling rag kha ma/ klu 'bum bcas khyer yod pa 'brug stag dkar ser nag gsum so sor nang bgos byas pa'i gnas tshul gleng rgyu yod pa red/ mjug tu bod sog pa zer ba'i ming gi byung tshul lam tsam kha shas kyis hor tsho so dgu'i nang du bod sde sha sog pa'i dbyibs bam/ g.yag rog po'i 'dzi 'dra ba yod pa'i sog pa zer ba yin 'dug zer/ mang zhig gis ni chu bo'i ming de sde la thog pa dper na/ nags chu'i rgyud kyi yul sde la nags shod zer ba dang / sog chu'i rgyud kyi yul sde la sog pa zer ba/ de bzhin dkar chu'i rgyud la dkar shod dang re chu'i rgyud la re shod zer ba ltar chu ming sde la btags pa zhig red snyam/ 'o na chu bo'i ming sog chu zer ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhan 'brel rgyu med rung / sog chu'i rtse stod la chags pa'i 146

sde ni sog sde zer ba dang de'ang hor tsho'i khongs yin stabs hor sog sde ma zer ba dang sog chu'i smad la chags pa'i sde la bod sog pa zer ba dang de'ang sog sde nas bod sa gnas kyi sder 'chad pa bod sog pa zer ba'i ming de byung ba mngon zer ba bcas so/mjug tu sog rdzong tsho'i lo rgyus 'tshol bsdu ring rdzong u'i hru'u ci sku gzhon blo mthun mgon po lags nas thugs 'khur gnang ba dang / rdzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi sku gzhon mang rje rta mgrin dang /ngag dbang 'jig sgrol rnam gnyis nas zhib phra'i rogs las gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad 'di ga'i thog ma'i lo rgyus rgyu cha'i sa bon gnang mkhan gyi bgres song ser skya rnams par bka' drin che zhu/ nged kyis mkhasi pa dpyad can dang / rgas po rgyus can bcu lhag tsam la dngos rgyud nas zhib 'dri zhus thog lo rgyus yig rnying re zung nas lung 'dren btsal ba dang 'brel yod zin tho dang mi snas ngag rgyun bcas kyis kha bskangs nas dus thung nang 'tshol zin4phyogs bsgrigs byas pa yin/ 'dir thog ma'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad rgyu song tsang myur skyobs byas te thob pa'i nang snga rabs da rgyun gyi shod srol dang / khral bsdu'i rnam grangs zhib phra rigs tha na skabs de'i ngag rgyun gyi kha dpe sogs kyang 'dor du ma bra nas bkod yod/'on kyang dus tshod thung ba dang shes 'jug dman pa'i stabs kyis nyag nyog mang zhing de tsam 'brel mi chags pa a cang sgra don gang thad nas nor 'dzol yod nges pas mkhyen rgyus gnyis ldan rnams nas dag bcos dang dgongs 'char lhug rtsol yong ba zhu/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu pho sprel lo'i zla 2pa/ spyi lo'i 41992lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes la 147

)smo 1 za rmo zoju phro ska zlo za //sto 0 gu takajab / ka /byu kathu /(blo tshangs rgyal dang lo ba'i zla ba gnyis kyis rgyu cha mkho 'don gnang nas 'di ga'i lo rgyus dpyad yig khang gis bsgrigs pa )dang po/ rgya ston spyi ba'i lo rgyus/rgya ston zhes pa ni rgya yig ston pa zhig bod du phebs nas sa der gzhis chags par brten sa ming la rgya ston zer ba red ces gleng rgyun zhig yod pa dang / yang shod srol gzhan zhig la/ rgya bza' kong jo bod du phebs skabs sa cha 'di nas phebs yod pa dang / bu zhig 'dir bzhag pa nar song nas yar khrid de ston cho/ gsham pa dang / ston rten la lding tsho bco brgyad sprad pas rgya ston zhes pa'i ming de nas byung zhes zer mkhan yang yod pa yin/ der ma zad sa cha g.yangs gzar dang / lam 'khrung dog pas rgya bza' skyo nas shum par rgya mo ngu chu zer ba'i chu ming thogs pa dang rjes su sgra 'gyur nas rgya mo rngu chu zer ba red ces kyang gleng srol 'dug 'di tsho yig rnying lo rgyus dang mthun min gang ltar yang ngag rgyun gleng srol yin pas dor rkyang ma byas par dpyad gzhir bris pa yin/148

yul 'di nag sog rgyas gsum ste nag shod sog shod/ rgyal yod gsum gyi mdud mdo rgya mo rngul chu'i lho byang du chags yod/srid 'dzin gyi khyab khongs sgrig gzhi rgya ston la lding khag dgu yod pa dang spyi 'dom rgya ston rdzong (gzhis sdod ) ngam rgya ston sde pa zer ba yod pa dang tsho khongs su bla dgon nyi shu rtsa lnga yod cing / chos lugs ni bka' rgyud dang / rnying ma/ dge lugs/ bon po bcas grub mtha' bzhi yin/ me ser spyi'i them grangs chig stong lha ga tsam yod/'tsho rten ni/ gtso bo zhing 'brog yin pa dang / rngon las dang tshong las yang phran tsam yod pa yin/ thon rdzas ni zhing 'brog thon rdzas thog gcan gzan dang / ri dwags kyi lpags rigs/sha ra gla rtsi 'bu rdza bee smug nags las shing chas bcas yin/gna' snga mo bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i das sna bod yul ru chen lngar phye ba'i yan lag gi ru gsum pa'i lte ba rgyas shod stag pa tshal la bzhag ces pa'i rgyas shod de mdo stod shog chen brgyad kyi nang tshan yin pa 'di rang yin dgos 'dra stabs rgya ston gyi stod lding gsum gnas yul yang der yin pa/ dper na sngar ming dwa 'jags yin pa rgyas shod ban dkar zer bas mtshon nus/der brten 'di dus rgya ston de sum pa'i ru yi khongs yin tshod snyam/bod sil bu kha 'thor gyi dus su ni/ lho a rig khag gsum mam sde ba che 'bring chung gsum zhes pa des mdo stod kyi sa cha phal cher dbang bsgyur byas yod 'dug par rgya ston yang de gras yin bzo mchis/rgya ston nas chos phyogs kyi bla ma grags can byung myong ba 149

radaper na rje mar pa lo tsa'i slob ma rgya ston zhig po dang / ārya pa rol ba'i rdo rje'i dus rgyal ba'i lung zin rgya ston chos kyi bzang po dang / 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i dngos slob rgya ston blo bzang grags pa sogs byung ba lta bu yod/srid kyi thad nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta 1642lo'i gong du rgya ston drung pa zhes pa dpon rabs nyi shu tham pa byung yod (kha shas kyis bcu gsum red kyang zer ) 'dir rgan rabs nag rgyun du sdad pa'i ming nges tshod ni drung shākya dza sha dang drung byang chub rnying po/ drung rgya ra khra/ drung ngag dbang chos ldan/ drung padma badza bcas red/ drung rabs nyi shu pa ste drung pa rting ma ni ngag dbang bstan skyong zhes/ bod kyi gtsang pa sde pa padma bstan skyong dbang po dang dus mnyam yin/rgya ston drung rabs kyi srid kyi dbang cha ni/ khrims sgo rang btsan yin pa (khrims chas lag cha dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur ma byas par sdad yod )dang drung pa'i pho brang gi mtha' skor nas lcags ri mthon po'i nang du sku srung rgyun nyar dmag mi bdun cu yod pa steng khang du dmag mi sdod sa dang / 'og khang du dmag rta 'dog sa yod pa/ 'khen mdung che chung gtsos pa'i mtshon cha sna dgu/mi rer lcags kyi ya lad cha tshang bcas yod 'dug cing nyin mtshan dus drug tu pho brang gi yang steng du so lta mi drug yod pa/ 'dogs khyi brgyad/ yan khyi brgyad/ pho brang nas brag dmar la brgal te nyin bskor thub tsam gyi sa nas drel lnga re bkal te drung pa'i gsol rgyu ༷na da/༵ /ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ //sa de pho la bradīl deji bsdi shā zheṭwāṃn mi(ba 'a /༷ ༵ 150

yod ('di rgya ston drung rabs dang bla rabs kyi gdan sa lho bde steng dgon zer )hor tsho so dgu'isnyikhyab rgyal rabs nas rgyal thog gnyis pa/ thig mur gyi sras 'bring ba u yug rgyal gyis rgya ston sde pa'i sras mo gu ru skyid khab tu bzhes zer ba hor rgyal rabs kyi yig rnying nang gsal 'dug pas drung pa mi rabs su yin ma shes rung / hor dang rgya ston gnyen mtshan yin pa bstan 'dugayang hor gyi rgyal rabs dgu pa thi ji lha rgyal dar gyi dmag dpung ri che nas yar lam rgya ston la byung bas phaspya ston drung pas rta brgya phul nag slon gnyis kyis mdzo brgya phul zhes gsal rgya ston drung rabs nyi shu pa/ ngag dbang bstan skyong skabs kur dge bar gyi 'gal ba drag po byung nas sog po gu thi han gyis dge lugs pa'i rgyab rtswar /// /chen /༷/ 155 /// /rje//tre/ btsa/dmag dpung ga sa na da nas da lhags sa da ga nga pa rtsa med gtong skabs rgya ston drung pa bstan skyong pas 'gog rgol med par gu thi la mgo sgur nas kha dbang yongs rdzogs phul bas srag the /1—1 btsa/ 1)/ / blo /blo/ /spro/ :ste/'a na ma byung 'dug sa mar nga sa 'a ra ba snang tshul la yid 'byung skyes nas rab byung bsgrubs thog gcig shur dzo ceno :re:rdokhye1 /rdo bya: tshe(yul kha sa pa da ga tu sku ma gas bar bzhugs pa dang /sku srung dmag rnams grwa pa byas te bde steng dgon du chos grwar྾bzhugs/ de nas bod sa gnas su dga' ldan pho brang pa'i sa gnas srid dbang btsugs shing / ching gong ma'i lung gis rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos dbang bsgyur skabs rgya ston pa lo shas sog po /rkyen//re//// ////)spro ///rdo /gri/gu ra na pa nas khams nga lhan du sa gnas da gzhung gi gzhung sde rnying khungs su bsgyur ba dang / sngon du drung pa ngag dbang bstan skyong gis dwangs blangs kyis chos yon gnyis (tā la'i 151

dang gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gnyis ) la kha dbang phul bar mnyes pa'i gzigs gsos su drung pa'i sku srung dmag mi bdun cu de grwa pa byas par bde steng dgon de phogs dgon du bsgyur nas grwa pa bdun cu la phogs sprad pa dang / so lta ba mi drug ma ṇi rgyang 'bod du bsgyur ba 'dogs khyi dang / yan khyi bcas la'ang khyi lto'i thebs rtsa gzhung phogs sprad pa bcas byas/ sku srung dmag grwa pa bsgyur ba'i mi bdun cu de bsdad na rtse drung bdun cu dang / song na a drung bdun cu yin zer ba'i 'ur bshad kyang byed srol chags/'di ni rgya ston drung pas yar zangs dkar gang phul bar mar skyogs dkar gang gnang ba yin zhes grags (gzhung phogs su mar dang sha 'bru ja tshwa bul bud shing bcas yod/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i sku ring nas rgya ston la sgo khra them bsher byas ra skor lug la phabs lug skor nor la phabs/ nor skor rta la phabs/ mkhar gzhis rta khal la phabs/ rta bdag dang / khal tho zhes pa gcig nas bzhi bar dang rta bdag khal tho med pa la lag yan zhes khral 'bab skor gzhi khag gsum bzos pa sogs byas te rgya ston gyi yong khral de rtse sku bcar mkhan po'i thab rten du sbyar 'dug rgya ston gzhis sdod ces la (rdzong yang zer )rtse bla brang thog kha'i jo lag re btang gi yod pa red/ rdzong jo lag blo bston zer bas mi bsad don rkyen byung stabs de nas gzhung 'dzin du gyur nas drung rigaca/ ser skya re yong gi yod pa red/ rgya ston gzhis sdod dam rdzong byang nas de'i gnas sa yang sngon drung pa'i skabs bde chen lhun grub rnyang yin pa nas tshur rgya mo rngul chu'i rgyud sa steng zhes par spos yod pa yin pas sa ming rdzong la thogs nas rgya 152

ston sa steng rdzong zer srol mchis/ sngon rgya ston drung pa mtshams sgrub ngang sku tshe 'das rjes yang srid rtsal nas sprul sku khri bkod byas pa de bde steng spul sku dang po blo bzang rgyal mtshan yin zer srol yang 'dug dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gong bde stong sprul sku sku breng bdun song yod/ drung rabs nyi shu bla rabs bdun rgya ston bstan pa'i gnas tshad yin zer ba yod skad/rgya ston lding dgu zhes pa/ stod lding gsum ste ban dkar dang / gur bzhi/ 'brong thang gsum/ smad lding gsum ste/lcags ru dang / gung ru/ shog lnga gsum bar lding gsum ste/lcam mda'/ shog chu/ shog drug gsum bcas tsho shog dgu yod pa de yin/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mdo smad sa mi zhib gzhung byed skabs lcags rta lor zhus khang gsar dang / sdom ra khang gsar gnyis kyis rgya ston du zhib deb bzos pa'i nang 'khod lding dgu la khyon thems grangs dgu brgya lhag tsam yod pa yin 'dug gna' —snga mo rgya ston lding khag bco brgyad yod pa de ni lding dgu'i khar/stod nas nag bur sem gsum dang smad nas nem tsha shog lnga bcas yin tshod 'dug 'di tsho rjes ma hor tsho'i khongs su gyur pa ni hor lha rgyal dar gyis gcig gyur bzos pa hor rab lo rgyus las lam tsam gsal yod bzo mchis/ rgya ston lding dgu'i 'go dpon sa gnas srid gzhung gis mngags pa'i gzhis sdod (rdzong dpon ) ni spyi dpon yin pa dang /tsho shog so sor lding dpon re yod rgya ston lding dgu'i lding dpon rnams ni sde srid kyi a tham yod pa'i bka' shog gi bdag po btsan 153

dmigs can sha sta ga yin/ zhwa mo lcags mda' rag tog can gos chen gyis las gos rgya gri phur shub rta la thob sdom bcas yod pa'i mi mus rgyud bcas pha rgyud bu 'dzin dpon gnas 'thob mkhan zhe —gcig red/ 'on kyang ban sgar tsho ba'i 'go 'dom de lding dpon zer ba med la stag phu bla brang gi khyag mdzod (spyir btang byas na )grwa pa dge slong zhig gis byed pa dang de'ang lo shas nang brje len byed pa las mi rgyud 'ded pa de bas kyang ma yin/rgya ston pa'i khral rigs khyi khral dang nang khral 'jal dgos pa phyi khral dbyar mar dang dgun mar/ dkar sha dang / nag sha/rtsi khral dang spu khral/ re ba dkar nag phying pa dkar rtsag rta rtsi dmar bcas dgos/ mdor na sgrub chag 'jags gsum bsdoms pas lo 'khor rer mar lha khal dgu stong dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu bsdu 'jal dgos pa/ de'i nang dga' ldan rgyun ja 'degs khal bcu gnyis la ltang gcig byas pa'i mar ltang brgya tham pa thang skya gru phar phab dgos/ de 'phros bla brang thog kha la phul nas smon lam tshogs mchod gnyis kyi 'deb sdor dang / gtsug lag khang gi rgyun 'bar dmigs rten yin 'dug gzhan yang rtse phyag dang /chibs ra las khungs bcas su ther chen ther chung / dkar rtsagare snam bcas 'jal sprod dgos pa ma zad/ lo rer bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs shing gi rten mdzo so gnyis nas so drug bar dgu bcu thams pa bsdu 'bul dgos kyi yod pa red/'u lag rkang 'gro'i khral ni sngar am ban bod skyod skabs rgya ston pas ltar rdzong (dpal 'bar ) nas lha ri 'go bar rgya rta zer ba rta 'ul drug cu tham pa gtong dgos srol dang / am ban lha sa 154

nas rgya nag la mar phebs skabs tsha chu kha dang / rdo thug gnyis kyi sa gnas la zhag babs kyi sgrig cha'i nang dkar gur gsum/ nag gur lnga zan shing sogs lha ri bas sgrub dgos pa de byings rgya ston pas 'gan le zhu dgos yod 'dug rngod pa nas dkar gur gsum dang / nag gur bdun sgrub dgos ces pa shing bya'i bka' khrari dgongs don yin 'dug gzhan yang rgya shod ban dkar— nas shog drug bar rgya bod zhi drag dpon rigs phebs bzhud la gra sgrig dang / rta khal skyel dgos pa sogs yod/nang khral ni/ mchod khral dang / khrims sa bar ma gzhis lding bcas la 'bul sgrub dgos rigs rnams yin/ ban dkar dang lcam mda' gnyis mchod gzhis zer ba'i nang khral de gtso che tsam yod/ ban dkar stag phu bla brang de khrims sgo rang btsan gyi dmigs bsal dbang thob che tsam yod nga sa rgya ston rdzong la 'go phyed tsam las bstun mi dgos pa red/dmag gi skor/ sngar chu bya'i lam don zer ba khams rdzong khag nas rdzong res dmag mi nyis brgya gtong dgos pa sde pa gzhung gis spo bo ka gnam par dmag ma brgyab bar gnas mus dang /de rjes rtsis dpon lung shar sa gnas srid gzhung gi dmag spyi'i ska bas rgya ston pa nas dmag 127lha sar bsdus te sbyong rdar byed bcug pa dang / de nas yang yang gses dmag brgya tham pa dbam pa nas de 'phros phyir slog byas pa dang khams rdzong gi dmag gzhan dang lhan du khams khul rgyud du skor skyod byed pa de dus dmag 4dpon shag zur dang / 'do zur gnyis yin pa bcas red/ 155

gnyis pa/ nang gses ban sgur bcas cho ba'i lorgyus/'bri ru rdzong khongs ban dkar shang ste de snga'i rgya ston lding dgu'i nang gses ban dkar dang / gur bzhi (shel sku lding tsho )gnyis dang / sog rdzong khongs lcam mda' shang ste de snga'i lcam mda' lding tsho dang / dkar mo shang ste de snga'i rngul chu rgyud lcags ru lding tsho bcas rgya ston tsho bzhi'i lo rgyus rags tsam brjod par/ 1 ban dkan tsho panang gses dang po ming gi skon/ban dkar zer ba'i gdags gzhi 'di rjes grub kyi ming zhig yin pa las/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming ma yin pa dang de'ang 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas byung tshul dang / 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas byung tshul gnyis ka shod rgyu yod pa gang yin dpyad par 'os/'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa ni/ ban dkar dgon pa chags pa'i sa dbyibs de me tog padma dkar po 'dab brgyad ltar yod stabs ban dkar ma yin pad dkar yin zer ba yig rnying du yod lugs gleng tshul yod pa red/ 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa ni/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dga' ldan chos 'byung du/ rgya shod ban mkhar zhes 'khod yod pa dang / srid kyi yig rigs mang po'i nang ban sgar zhes 'khod yod pa gnyis kur ban gyi tshig grogs su sgar dang mkhar zhes zer ba yod pa mkhar ram sgar ni gzhis byes kyi 'du gnas yin cing ban mkhar dang / ban sgar la dpyad cing rgyas shod bon lung skya mo zer ba'i sngar gyi yul ming dang sbrel na 156

gna' snga mor rgyas shod du bon chos 'ba' zhig yin pa nas kudma bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa dar nas tshur phu sgar gong gi ming 'brel kur dgon 'ga' zhig gcig sdud kyis chags par bon lung skya mo la ban gyi sgar byung bas ban sgar zer ba yin pa dang / rim pas dga' ldan pa'i dgon chen chags stabs sgar de mkhar la sgyur nas ban mkhar zer ba yin tshal 'dod pa bcas red/ rjes sor —/)// rjo ga/)pe/ smyo ga ridang /dro/ zurang /༷re/ngas grags kya nga na 'dra 'a la gnyas ka bsdus pa ban dkar zer ba de spyod kyi yod pa yin/ — —nang gser gnyis pa blarabs dang dpon rabs skor/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i slob ma byi'u gnas brtan nyi mas kur dgon lnga gcig tu sgril nas rab byung brgyad pa'i ya sprel 1488lor/ ri bo dga' ldan pa'i dgon pa ban dkar rnam rgyal gling btab pa dang / dgon bdag bla ma/ dbon po byam pa thog med nas/ gtsang pa rab 'byam pa/ a mdo klu 'bum bka' bcu sogs dang / de nas khyab bdag stag phu gu thi'i dbon rgyud zhabs khum pa/ stag phu bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chos rgyal bstan 'dzin/ bkra shis chos rgyal/ blo bzang bstan 'dzin stag phu mthu chen blo bzang 'jam dpal/ blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ 'phags pa rnam rgyal/ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho thub bstan bstan 'dzin bcas ban bkar stag phu sprul sku sku phreng rim byon gyis ban dkar dgon sde skyong ba yin/ stag phu zhes pa ni dang thog gi bla ma rnams skyid chu 157

shar kha'i dbus sto da stag phu chos sde zer ba'i gdan sa skyong mkhan yin stabs dgon pa'i ming de bla sprul gyi ming du 'jags pa zhig yin/ ban dkar bla sde dgon gsum ni rgyas shod kyi lte ba'i sa gnas su chags pa yin pas/ rgyas shod ban dkar zer ba mdo dbus stod smad bar gsum durlung star khyab pas mi shes mkhan med pa yin/ ma gzhi ban dkar tsho shog de rgya ston lding dgu'i khongs gtogs gzhung sde stod lding gsum gyi dang po de yin rung / thob khungs dang srid dbang gang gi thad nas gtso bo ban dkar stag phu bla brang gi mchod gzhis 'bras blo gling grwa tshang dang / 'brel ba zhig yin pas rgya ston rdzong la 'go byed tsam las bstun mi dgos pa yin 'dug ban dkar stag phu sku thog gong ma mang por mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms shing lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rgya rgyas thog rgyal khab dang / bstan pa sems can gyi don du mdzad rjes ma smad pa bzhag gnang yod stabs/ gong ma bdag po chen pos rtsal ba'i gser yig gi bka' shog dang bod bzhugs blon chen am ban gyis gnang ba'i bka' shog sogs yod pa dang / bod sa gnas kyi tā la'i bla ma gong sa lnga pa chen po'i she bam dang drug pa'i rtsa tshig bdun pa'i rgyab gnon gtsos bka' gtan shin tu mang po yod pa'i rgya bod yig tshang na bdag po red ces yongs grags su gleng tshul yod/ bka' rten gtso bo re gnyis ban dkar stag phu dang /nag shod stag phu gnyis thun mong gi yin pas lo gsum rer nyar res byed dgos pa yin 'dug ban dkar stag phu bla brang la bka' shog sgam chung 12yod zer/ bka' rten bzhugs yul bla brang nub gzim chung gi sgo span rgya yig gser mdangs can shing 158

brkos byas pa yod pa yin stag phu chos rgyal bstan 'dzin gyis lha ri dgon pa dang / kong po bla ru dgon/ rngod a rig dgon bcas skyong gnang ba bee ser las gsal ba ma zad stag phu sku thog gnyis kyi ring cang pa chos 'khor dgon yang skyong gnang yod 'dug ban dkadzo stag phu sprul sku'i thob thang dngos ni bod kyi sprul sku 'bring ca tho'i go gnas yod pa dang / 'bras spung tshogs chen sprul sku'i gras red/ 'dir dmigs bsal gyi bka' gtan tshig mang po yod pa ni bar kham bla sprul nang nas 'bur thon zhig yin 'dug la/khrims sgo rang btsan gyi dbang cha yod cing / stag phu sprul sku'i phyag mdzod de ban dkar sde dgon srid kyi dbang sgyur byed po yin la/ 'di la sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse drung kyus ma'i go thob yod pa red/ rgya ston lding dgu'i lding tshogs skabs ban dkar stag mdzod de rgya ston rdzong dang kha sprod du sdod pa dang / gdan thob mnyaca pa yin/ ban dkar stag phu sprul sku'i 'og tu sku phreng bzhi tsam song ba'i bla dga' zer ba'i sprul sku chung ba zhig yod pa red/'di 'bras spung blo gsal gling gi grwa tshang sprul sku'i thob thang yod/srid kyi thad nas ban dkar bla sde dgon gsum gyi gtso bo'i dbang cha de gong gsal stag phu bla brang gi phyag mdzod (rgyun du stag mdzod zer )de yin pa dang de 'og bla brang gnyer pa/ gnyis/ de 'og rtsis drung gnyis de nas dgon pa'i las sne gnyis/ shog kha'i brgya mgo brgyad kyi rgan po brgyad bcas yod/ stag mdzod ni lo gsum re nas brje len byed pa dang / spyir btang byas na ban dkar dgon pa'i grwa pa rgan gras chos srid kyi shes bya 'jon nus gang —'tshams ldan pa'i dge slong zhig yin dgos pared/ 'on kyang 159

dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul 'og mi skya re gnyis kyi stag mdzod byas myong yod/ nga tshos shes tshod kyi stag mdzod kha shas tsam grangs 'dren byas na/ ja ba dge slong stobs 'byor dang / snyag dge slong yon tan/ de bzhin ting yon tan dang / mdo mdo/ rna mo kun rgyas/ bstan 'dzin ri dbang / bar skabs stag mdzod klu sgrub dang ting ma'i skya bo'i stag mdzod ya bo thar pa bcas red/de tsho'i nang mdzod zur sku gshegs zer ba sngar stag mdzod dus legs po yod skad dang / snya ga yon tan 'jon po yod skad/mdo mdo drang po yod skad/ thar pa lhing po yin skad/ ting yon tan zha nye'i 'bug yin skad ces gleng / gnyer pa gnyis de yang lo shas nas brje len byed srol dang / mi 'gro ser skya gang rung yin rting ma'i gnyer pa ser mo ba mtsho mdo ngag dbang sangs rgyas dang / skya bo mi drag a su dbang ldan gnyis red/ rtsis drung gnyis (rtsis pa dang drung yig ) ni khyim rgyud kyi mi drag yin pa kha yang dar rgyas dang / ja ba rgyal mtshan zer/ kha yang dar rgyas de gtam yig rtsis gsum gang spyir 'jon po yod pa'i shog kha phan tshun la ming grags phran bu yod pa yin/ las sne gnyis ni sde dgon lhan rgyas skabs dgon pa'i 'thus tshab yin pa dang / brgya mgo'i rgan po brgyad ni khral dud res skor las pha rgyud bus 'dzin gcig kyang med pa bcas red/ ban dkar stag phu sku phreng bcu bzhi pa thub bstan bstan 'dzin (lo rabs drug cu pa'i nang 'das ) phyag ri'i bla ma glang nag gter ston gyi sras gsum byung ba'i gcen po yin/ glang nag gi sras gsum ka bla ma yin pa 'bring po kham rgya ston sprul sku dang / chung ba ban dkar gyi bla dga' sprul sku thub 160

bstan ye shes yin/ ban dkar gyi sprul sku che chung gnyis spun mched yin stabs thog mar bla grangs 'dod gcig yin/ stag phu thub bstan bstan 'dzin ngos 'dzin gnang mkhan rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho yin pa dang / dbu skra phul sa yang der yin/ dgung lo chung dus 'bras spung du chos bzhugs gnang nas/ 'dan ma stong dpon rin po che yin 'dzin du bsten pa dang / thad ma'i dpe khrid pa me nyag skyor dpon gyis mdzad de gzhung bka' pod lnga la bsan bsam gnang nas dge bshes kyi mtshan rtags bzhes pa red stag phu sprul sku'i yab bla ma glang nag ba 'das rjes ban dkar dgon gyi grwa klu sgrub zer ba skya babs nas sprul sku'i ma yum mkha' 'gro bkra shis dang lhan du sdad pa dang /klu sgrub 'jon nus yod stabs ring min bla brang gi nang dbang che shos 'dzin mkhan du gyur pa dang snga rting gis stag mdzod kyi las 'gan yang khur yod cing / rting lce khar bla brang gi nor ma bdag gis byas/ stag phu thub bstan bstan 'dzin gzhis dgon du phebs nas chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa mi dman tsam ngang / nyi — mtshungs phar tshur la phyogs phebs lta bu gnang mus mtshams dgung na dar la babs skabs khri babs te lcam bzhes pa red/ khong la mi chos kyi shes nus gtan nas med cing / rgyud ma bcos byis pa'i ngang tshul ltar bkag med kyi spyod tshul shugs 'byung du lhug por gnang mkhan zhig red/ klu sgrub kyis sdug tsub chen pos sprul sku sdom pa gtong sa dang ring min bzhugs grogs byed rtsis yod pa'i dbul phongs kyi bu mo mkha' 'gro mtsho mo zer ba de'i sna breg pa red/sprul skus gnas tshul de mkhyen 'khral sku rlung bzhes te klu sgrub la 161

phyag 'jug gnang ba dang / mkha' 'gro mtsho mo la sems gso'i rgyu dngos sprad pa bcas byas/ de rjes klu sgrub nas gur bzhi lding dpon gyi bu mo 'od ldan zer ba sprul sku'i lcam la bsus pa red/sprul skus rgyun du dbul phongs grwa pa dang / nang g.yog sogs la bla brang sbug gi grwa chas dang dngos po sprod kyi yod par dgon sde'i 'go byed kha shas kyi blo la 'bab kyi med pas bla mar gsal 'debs zhus rung gsan 'jog gnang gi med rkyen khong tshos sku gzhogs (sprul sku )kyis de snga'i bla rabs nas bsags pa'i nang dngos med pa bzo yi yod tshul gleng nas bla dgon dbar phran bu'i 'gal ba byung khar/ skabs shig bla brang gi tshem po rgyag mkhan gyi gra par dgon pa'i dge skos nas skabs 'khral dgongs pa sprod rgyu byung min la brten bla brang gis dge skos la nyin phyag gsum gyi nyes pa btang bas rkyen byas bla brang dang / dgon sde'i 'go pa tsho'i bar 'gal zla rim bzhin 'phel nas mthar lha sar zlos gyar thug pa red/thag chod kyi nang don gsal po ma shes kyang grwa tshang phyag mdzod zer ba 'bras blo gling gis btang ba'i chos mdzad grwa pa zhig ban dkar la 'byor nas der dgon sdes za sgo gang 'tshams sbyor dgos pa dang / las don ni rang sger khe tshong bun gtong kho na byed kyin lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i lo dkyil skor lo shas sdad nas yar log phyin pa red/ go tshod du da dung sprul sku gnyis la phogs rgyag rgyu byas tshul yod 'dug pa de ltar lag bstar byed rgyur sde dmangs nas mos mthun med cing sprul sku phogs len pa byas na ban dkar sde dgon gyi skyabs yul bla sprul ma yin pa'i bzo dod stabs de ltar mi 'os zer ba'i gleng phyogs byung stabs/ don de lag len du bstar med 162
