pa yin skad 'dugabod zhi ba'i bcing 'grol zin pa nas da bar bla brang gi sprul sku chung ba bla dga' thub bstan ye shes mdo smad mnga' khul khongs steng chen don gcod las khungs su wang si ling gi sku mdun du bcar nas bod ljongs bcings 'grol gyi bya gzhag la ma skul dngas blangs kyis brtsi bkur zhus par gzigs skyong thob pa dang / nang sar lta skor byon pa steng chen don gcod las khungs kyi kho'o krang gi go ming bzhes yod/ de rjes ban dkar dgon gyi dbu mdzad rnam grol sogs kyis sprul sku rnams gnyis la dad 'bul bshags phul byas stabs sngon 'gal rim gsal gyis sngar rgyun rnam pa sor chud pa 'dra bo byung yod/nang gses gsum pa/ 'og sde dngakhal khrims sogs kyi skon/ban dkar tsho shog gi mi ser sdod gnas lte ba ban dkar dang / gdong bde skyid/ gzi mer stod dbu gzhung dang chis rong / sis mda' khyi bcas kyi sa lung gtso byas pa'i rgyas shod kyi gang sar yar gyi nag bur sen gsum/ mar gyi gur bzhi rgyab kyi bom phan sogs kyi tsho shog dang 'dres nas sdod pa yin/ thon skyed ni zhing 'brog gnyis ldan gyi sa ma 'brog gam rgyas chu'i rgyud klung gzhung grong tsho rnams yul shas che zhing / ri khrod lung yan rnams su 'brog shas che ba zhig yin/ ban dkar la dud grangs nyis brgya yas mas yod pa dang khral shog brgya mgo brgyad yod/ khral che shos kyi brgya mgo'i a ma ni chis rong mong nyo tshang dang gdong rgyang ya bo 163

tshang gnyis yod/ sngar chags kyi khral dud rnying khungs kha shas tsam grangs 'dren byas na u gzhung nas tsho mdo dang / ru tshang / ring tshang sogs dang / chis rong nas mong yo dang / mdung ru/ za zhing sogs gzi mel nas zla rug dang / hor/ ral pa tshang sogs/ gzi stod nas rna mo dang / snya ga kha yan sogs/steng ser nas ba ba dang / ga gzi/ lha bzo tshang sogs/gdong mda' nas ja ba dang / a bur bya rdzi tshang sogs/ gdong nas rgya 'o dang / tshugs gsar chu ru sogs/ bde skyid nas a log dang lo che chung sogs/ zla mdo nas srib ja ba dang / sdom 'khel sis mda' phyi nas/ san tsha dang / rgo ba/ yor sgang ba sogs/ de bzhin da dung ya bo 'brog pa dang / za zhing ya bo/kha yongs sogs yin pa red/ban dkar mi ser nas khral la phyi khral dang bar khral nang khral gsum 'jal dgos pa yin phyi khral bod sa gnas srid gzhung la rgya ston lding khag spyi 'gre ltar dbus 'bul gyi mar khral mar khal stong phrag yas mas dang / ther che chung ko 'be sogs ban dkar sa gnas su rgya ston rdzong ngam rdzong tshab 'byor skabs 'jal sprod dgos pa red/bar khral ni ban dkar bla dgon thob khungs 'bras spung blo gsal gling grwa tshang la mar ldang chig brgya bzhi cu zhe brgyad dang /gro ma zam drug rus zhib dos po bzhi bcas khyon khal rgyab brgya thams pa de lo ltar mi khal bla brang gis gtong nas lha sar 'bras spung bar skyel dgos (ban dkar mar chung zer ) nang khral ban dkar stag phu bla brang la/ ldom bu sha khral zer ba khral dud che chung 164

la gzhigs pas dud res mar rgya bcu yas mas dang / lug sha khog re 'jal sprod dgos pa ma zad/ bra nas zer ba zhing yod tshang mas bra min re nas 'bru phul drug re 'jal dgos/ gzhan yang 'bud shing gi khral dang / sngo rtswa'i khral/ skya rtswa'i khral bcas sgrub dgos de min da dung zhing yod tshos ston khar sngo ra khang skor snga gcod zhu rten khrims 'jog ces pa'i mar dang kha btags 'bul dgos pa dang / khyim dud tha dad song bar bla brang la zhu gtug byas na bgos phud kyang dgos kyi yod pa red/ shel sku lding zhabs kyi rtsa rlung sgur gsum nas blo gling gi she yod mkhan dud res stag phu bla brang la mar phud zer ba mar rgya do re dgos pa yin/ gong gsal ban dkar mar chung zer ba 'bras gling la 'bul dgos pa'i mar khral de'i 'byung stangs ni/ sngon stag phu sku thog gong ma (su yin ma nges )zhig khams 'brog la phyogs phebs gnang bar 'bul zog mang po byung ba de kun 'bras spung blo gling grwa tshang la phul bas blo gsal gling nas nor rnams ban dkar sde thog tu khral mgo'i thog la bkram nas lo ltar 'chi med kyi mar bsdu rgyu bzos te rus pa mdel zug tu gyur ba de 'dra yin 'dug 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gis kyang khri ru zla mang gzhis ka zer ba zhing son khal 50skor dang / khang pa bcas stag phu bla brang la sprad pa yin 'dug khri ru zla gang gzhis 'dzin bla brang gis grwa pa re btang gi yod pa red/bla brang la 'am dzi rag tog yan khyon snye ma dbra mig brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod pa'i sa zhing yod par (dbra mig rer nas gro 4—7bar yod/ der zhing las ar po dgu khral rgyug dgos pa ar po chad na lus thog 'gram lcag bzed dgos pa las rgyu thog gi ar 165

chad 'jal sa yod pa ma red/rgyas shod du tsho shog gzhan dag gi sa zhing nang la'ang stag phu bla brang gi gte zhing yod pas gte 'bru len sprod dgos pa yod/ban dkar ni lho lam gzhung lam rgyud kyi sa tshugs yin stabs der skyod che btsan dmag dpung a drung bcas che chung tshang mar ban dkar mi ser nas sdod sgrig dang / yar skyod gsa' mda' dang /yar 'gro ya mdo bar sa skyel dgos pa ma zad/ khyon che'i rigs rdzong skyel ru bzhi zer ba sogs shog mnyam rub kyis skyel sgrol dgos pa yod/ mdo spyi khongs kyi tshwa sho zer ba zhig kyang bar skabs nas ban dkar la gtan sdod kyi tshong 'grul khag nas tshwa shos bca' khral len gyi yod pa red/ skabs shig tshwa sho kha tsha bo zho rags yod pa/dper na/ bu dzum gyi mi dge 'dun zer ba des ban dkar gyi sman pa o rgyan lha dar sar sman len par chu rtags khyer nas 'gro skabs shig tshwa shos tshong par dogs nas bkag pas dge 'dun gyis rdzing (gcin pa )la sho khral ga tshod dgos sam ces bshad tshul gleng rgyun yod pas don du mi rkyang yar 'gro mar 'gro la'ang gla rtsi 'tshong mkhan yin dogs kyis bkag nas brtag dpyad byed kyi yod pa red/rgyal shog yul gyi skya lo sngo khrims ni tsho shog so so'i khongs khe gtsang yul grong rnams tsho shog de dag nang nas khrims bsdams pa dang / grong tsho 'ga' zhig la ban dkar dang nag rog bu dzum gur bzhi bcas tsho bzhi'i sa zhing yod pas de gar gong gsal tsho bzhi'i bla dpon bzhi lhan nas skya lo sngo khrims kyi spyi gan bzos thog mnyam sbrel gyis khrims 'gan khur dgos pa yin/ de'ang thad ga'i 'gan gtso ban dkar stag mdzod nas len gyi yod cing /166

zhing gcod skabs dus tshod gtan 'khel gyis dpon khag gzhan tshor brda tho skyel dgos pa dang / de 'khral des rang khongs mi ser la ar brda gtong srol yod pa red/ban dkar lte ba'i sa zhing gnas sa zar chu man dang klu mkhar yan la zhib cha'i khrims pa grong tsho so sor yod rung sngon khrims kyi khrims pa gtso bo dgon pa'i grwa pa dpon g.yog lnga yod pa zhing gcod khar gang sar skor yong bskyod kyi yod pas de dus zhing gi 'khor yug tu sbra gur phub mi chog pa yin/ skyon chag song ba'i thog la thog skyis gsab rgyu sogs thag gcod byed kyi yod pa red/zhing skor skabs khrims pa dpon g.yog lnga pos ldom bu ba 'dra ba'i mgo la sgar zhwa gyon pa dang a drung 'dra ba'i rta la ling shang 'dogs pa yin/ nang gses bzhi pa/ rig gnas lag shes tshong las sogasakyi skor/1 ban dkar du bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la brtson nas spyi tshogs la nus pa sgrub mkhan ma nyung tsam yod pa ste/ bzo rigs lha 'bri ba dang / 'jim bzo ba drug bdun skor dang /gso rig sman pa lnga drug skor/ skar rtsis lo tho'i sa ris thebs mkhan re gnyis tsam/ yig 'bri bris pa snyan sum spyod mkhan gsum bzhi skor/ gser dngul bzo ba dang / lcags bzo ba/shing bzo ba/ gyang mkhan rdza mkhan bcas bcu grangs shig bcas yod pa yin ban dkar dgon la/ rig lam bshad grwa med kyang gdan sa 'bras spung du mtshan nyid bslabs nas chu tshad gang 167

'tshams yod mkhan re shas byung yod/ de rmi/na ོ/nga rig mtshon pa'i chos phyogs kyi don dam lha dgongs can yo da nges ma zad/zlos gar mtshon dgon par gar 'cham dang / dmangs khrod kyi ras pa sogs kyang khung ldan yod pa yin/gong gsal nang nas shog phan tshun bcas su cung ming grags yod pa ni/ snga rting gis dper na sman pa dge slong mthong grol dang / o rgyan lha dar lha ris ja ba bkra dga'/ shing bzo 'bras dkar mag pa/ gyang mkhan a mgo dang / 'do ba/ dngul bzo shung lung mgar ba sogs yin/2 phyogs gzhan gyi kha rgyun du 6‘rgyas shod ban dkar ar co'i pha yul red/ zhag gsum sdad na mu ges shi sa red/ lo gsum sdad na tshong dpon 'gyur sa red zhes zer srol yod/ban dkar du khams kyi tshong rigs gtan sdod byed mkhan dar rgyas dgon pa'i spyi gso dang / hor pa 'jam dbyangs tshe ring de bzhin rab dgon spyi gso bcas yod la/ sa gnas de ga'i tshong pa ja ba bstan sbyin dang / dmar rtsa tshul nor/ 'dul 'dzin dang /bsod grags sogs yod cing cha rkyen phran bu yod pa'i skya ser tshos tshong gnyer byed rgyur shin tu dga' la/ tshong lam yang rgyug po yod zer sro0/ yod/ tshong pa tsho'i sa nas bun len skabs zla srang skar skyed yin/ de min mi ser nang tshong pas ja dang 'bru snga skur byed nas dbyar dus su dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu dang / rdza yung sprod chad byed pa dang ma sod na rgya gar tshong skyed zer ba'am/ skyed la skyed sgril gyis skyo ba rnams skyo thog skyo bzhag dang / phyug pa rnams phyug thog phyug bzhag 'gro ba'i rnam pa thon gyi yod pa red/ khral khrims 168

kyis mnar ba dang / ha bun ma sod nas chags gnas bral te yul byol du phyin mkhan ni zam ma chad pa yod pa red/2 gyod kha mchu'i skor sogs phyis su byung ba'i ban dkar bla brang dang / sde dgon dbar gyi nang gyod skor gong du lam tsam gsal pa ltar yin la de min phyi rgya nas byas na sngar ban dkar dang /sen tsha gnyis sa mtshams skor ching rgyal rabs kyi dus mjug tsam du sen tsha dpon bsod nams lha rgyas lo nyi shu'i thog bod bzhugs am ban gyi byams thag 'jus nas bde sdug zhus par de don zlos gyar khrun chod du sem tsha ba cung tsam rgyas bas shod srol yod/ yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang sgyur mjug nag shod tsho ba srid skyong stag brag gi sger sde byed skabs rdzong tsho'i sa mtshams dbye 'byed skabs ban sen gnyis kha mchu byung bar ban dkar stag mdzod klu sgrub nas stag phu bla brang gi bka' rten rnams rin chen rgyan spras te dre'u la bkal nas gtan tshig spyan 'bul gyis ban dkar stag phu bla brang la yig nag chu bsher du ma song ba zhig dang / srid skyong stag brag bla brang la sku don 'grub pa zhig thugs rjes gzigs zer nas skabs der 'gyed zhib dpon rigs la skyabs rten 'bri thus ma mang po'i skyabs 'dzin phul bas mthar 'bri ru nas 'dom khra thon stabs ban dkar ba cung zad rgyas 'dug zer srol yod/ dang po sen tsha g.yang shod du mda' dpon zhwa sgab pa gtsos 'gyed 'god dpon rigs rnams kyi mdun du sen tsha dpon rgan bcar nas gyod don zhu skabs 4rgya am pa drin can de'i sku dus zer ba brjo da par tshig mtshams 'jog long med par zhwa sgab pas rgya mi drin can zer ba 'os min rdzab chen red brjod nas bgres po zhib sa nas phyir 'bud 169

btang ba ma zad nyes pa yang btang yod pa red/ yang sngar khri rdo dpon kre'o be cang skya ser nang ma mthun skabs sa zhing mang tshan zhig 'bras spungs blo gsal gling la phul bar blo gling grwa tshang nas ban dkar stag phu bla brang la sprad pa dang / ban dkar bas gzhis khang skrun nas khri ru zla gang gi gzhis ka zer ba zhig yod pa de/lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i dkyil du sog sde dpon nor bu tshe ring gis drag chas spras pa'i ab phrug bcu lhag khrid nas zla gang gzhis 'dzin ban dkar bla brang gi grwa pa zhig yod pa der khri rdo gnyis sog sde'i yus pa red/ zla gang gzhis ka 'di ban dkar bar bdag pa'i dbang cha gang yang med da nas bzung tshur len rgyu yin gzhis ku'i lde mig sprod dgos zer nas btsan shed kyis khri ru zla gang gzhis ka zer ba zhing son khul 5༷skor dang / khang pa sbrags ma sog sde dpon nas 'khrog len byas song ba red/ de skabs ban dkar stag mdzod ya bo thar pa yin pa 'di ni mi gzhi 'jam la lhing zhing gdong gtug g.yol mkhan zhig yin pas rjes sor kha mchu gtug rtsis tsam nas thad kur ya lan gang yang ma speb par dbyug bzhag pa red/ yang sngon dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs nyi shu pa'i g.yas g.yon du rta zam sa tshugs sgrig skyel rgyu'i skor rta spyi mkhan chung 'jam dbyangs blo 'khel gyi mdun du ban sen gnyis dang / nag bur gnyis bar kha mchu thug pa'i gnas tshul byung myong yod gdong bsher byed mkhan ni ban dkar gyi 'u ra bstan 'dzin zla ba dang /bu dzum gyi dpon ru blon rgan g.yung drung tshul khrims gnyis yin skad de'ang 'grig 'dom mgyogs po byung ba dang / kha mchu thug pa'i dus mtshams de rang la ma gtogs lar nas rgyas shod kyi tsho shog 170

phan tshan nam zhag rgyun du nye leb leb dang / shag sgor sgor /gri/rdo ri shu /)pe/ zhe jig rjo ga ༷༷// /dīpe/ma da na sbyan bdag bcas kya 'a la rgyun chags na pa ma zad/chos lugs grub mtha' mi gcig kyang / stag phu sprul sku la dad gus che zhing sde phan tshun brtsi 'jog dang / bsam shes sems khul bcas kyi rnam pa mtshon rgyu yod cing / mthun lam bzang po'i lo rgyus rgyun mthud byung yod pa ni gtso bo rang yin/ 4 ban dkar dgon sde'i dus chen che shos ni cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lnga nyin rnam rgyal gling dgon pa'i bco lnga mchod pa dang / tshes 1〈la gar 'cham chen mo/ tshes 19la byams pa gdan 'dren tshes 2༷nyin stag phu sprul skus khrom dbang skur ba bcas byed pa de dag yin/'di skabs yul sde'i mi dmangs rnams gzab gos rgyan gyis spud nas rgan skyor byis 'khrid kyis 'du 'dzoms kyis dbang 'cham mjal srol yod/ de min 'dir yul gzhan dang 'dra ba'i rta rgyug dus chen sogs yod srol med/ 'on kyang tshong rigs dang 'byor hrag rnams kyis rta 'gros ma la shin tu nas dag 'dod chen po byed pa red/ yul 'dir rta rgyug ma zer ba de tsam btang srol med la brtsi thang yang chen po med/ rta 'gros ma ni 'gang chen de lhag med pa zhig la brtsi zhing rin pa phon chen sprad nas zing rta 'am kong rta 'gros ma nyo ba red/ tshong pa 'jam dbyangs tshe ring gi du 'dzin zer ba'i zing rta 'gros ma der zi ling nas ja sgam 40tham pa sprad nas nyos pa red zer sngon 'jam tsho'i rkyang phrug zer ba'i rta de rgyas shod yul la skad grags yod/ rta des ban dkar nas lha sa bar nyi ma bdun gyis slebs tshul gleng rgyu yod/171

2 shelaskulding zhabasaskyar bzhi cho ba/(1) tsho ba'i chags stangs dang / yal ming thogs lags ring ringadapon rigs byung tshul sogs/tsho ba'i grub gzhi gna' snga mo nas chags pa'i rgyas shod bon lung skya mo zer sa'i yul sde'i ru ma ma nyams pa gnas pa de yin skad/bar skabs rgya ston lding dgu'i dus stod lding gsum gyi ya gyas yin/chags yul ni nub ban dkar dang 'brel zhing shar 'brong thang dang 'brel/ lho ban dkar dang nag rog tsho bar 'brel/ byang khrid rdo tsho ba dang 'brel ba zhig yin spyir btang yul ni rgyas shod dkyil smad klung gzhung du chags shing 'brog ni zlas dang ya nga ya khog khri ru be yag sogs phu rag lung yan rnams la gnas yod/yul grong 'ga' zhig ban dkar dang 'dres nas chags pa yod la bu dzum dang nag rogs tsho ba'i sde dung kyang tha thor 'dres sdod yod pa yin bcings 'grol yar sngon tsam la shel sku lding zhabs thems grangs phyed nyis brgya yas mas tsam yod/ tsho shog 'dir ming gnyis yod pa ste sgur bzhi zer ba'am shel sku lding zhabs zer sgur zer ba ni grong tsho'i ming yin pa dang de'ang 'di ga'i sa khongs zlas mda' ru rgya ston rdzong gi gzhis ka yod par der las khral rgyug mkhan grong tsho bzhi yod pa der dmar thung sgur bzhi zer gyi yod pa ming 'dis tsho ba spyi la bkab ste spyi ming byas pa zhig yin/ sngar tsho 172

shog 'dir nang gses grong shog dgu yod pa dang thems grangs gong las mang ba yod rung rim pas khral lcis mnan rkyen grong shog gcig bud stong du phyin pa dang rjes sor khyon sgur bdun dang bcu shog gcig grong tsho stong shul nas khral dung lhag ma gcig tsam bcas yin shes sku lding zhabs zer ba ni sngar gyi ming yin la de'ang dpon ming sde la thogs pa zhig yin 'dug bon gyi bla ma'i gdung rgyud mdo khams zhig po bco brgyad kyi ya gyas shel zhig blam zhig gis kong po bon ri nas rten dri med shel sku zhes pa gter thon par brten de tshun shel sku blam zer ba'i ming 'jags pa dang / khong gi rgyud pas sde 'di ba'i 'go dpon byas par sde ming la shel sku lding zhabs zer ba'i ming byung ba red zer srol 'dugashel sku lding dpon gyi mes po dang po stong chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi gdung las grol ba shel zhig gnam gsas rgyal po mdo padma nas mdo stod khams kyi zor ra yar khug la byon nas yul de'i lugs gnyis skyong mkhan du gyur ba dang brag glang chen 'dra ba'i yang steng du mkhar rdzong ngam rje khri btsan zor ba btabs na bzhugs (da lta'ang thog brtsegs gnyis mthong rgyu yod dang po thog brtsegs lnga yod zer )shod srol la rtse po ta la 'bo gang tsam chags dus/ rdzong ngam rje khri btsan de bre mang tsam chags yod zer/yang gleng tshul gzhan zhig yod pa ste rdzong ngam rje khri btsan 'di sngar gling ge sar gyi 'bum pa'i nang blon dpa' la mi spyang —dkar po'i rdzong yin zer srol dang sngon lding dpon yul pa tshang la khrab rmog dang mda' gzhu gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yod pa de dag 4173

ridapa' la'i go mtshon red ces shod rgyun yod/gang ltar shel sku lding dpon bla dpon sbrags ma mi thog rim can gyi gan mal mkhar de yin pa pho ngar grong la yod/ shel sku tshang lo rgyus ring po yin pa'i shod rgyun du gnam la snga ba nyi zla skar gsum/ sa la snga ba ko rag shel gsum ste ko bo dang rag shi shel sku gsum yin zer 'di gsum rgyas shod bon lung skya mo'i rus chen blam snga thos la brtsi ba red de bzhin thi na blam mi dgos le/ stong dmu tsha gyer med kyi gdung 'dzin/ gson na dpon po mi dgos le/khrims sgo rang btsan gyi bdag po thel sku gnam gsas rgyal po yin zhes che stod kyi gtam gleng 'jags yod/ 'di khul cung zad chags snga ba'i rdo steng dgon gtsos dgon pa kha shas yod pa de dag gi dbu bla yang shel sku gnam gsas rgyal po'i rgyud bcas nas byed kyi yod pa'i bla dpon sbrag ma yin pa dang / srid kyi thad nas rgyal ston lding dgu'i nang chen shel sku lding dpon zhes sde srid a thams can gyi bka' gtan tshig mang po yod pa'i bdag po yin tshul gleng rgyu yod gnam gsas rgyal po'i gdung las byung ba'i bla dpon sbrags ma'i shel sku blam smon lam bkra shis dang nam mkha' 'od zer de nas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rnam rgyal tshul khrims/ grags pa rnam rgyal khro bo rgyal mtshan sogs gdung rgyud shel dkar gyi 'phreng ba bzhin ltar la rgyus pa byung bas ma tshad bar skabs sras rgyud mang du 'phel nas khyim dud kha shas su gyes sngar gnas 'phrang bar grong dang yag rong skyes nang gnyis la lding gzhis phyed phyed bgos te khag gnyis byung dang thog lding 'gan gtso bo skyes nang bzhugs mkhan gyis khur rung de rjes mi dus 'pho 'gyur byung gshis nang mol gyis 174

shel lding lte ba 'phrang bar shel sku'i 'dzin rgyu byas te bka' rten yang de gas bzung nas mi rabs mang tsam 'das rjes slar yang 'phrang bar shel lding tshang dud khag gnyis su gyes te gcig gis zlas po ti nang lte ba bzung nas 'brog pa gtso bo byas gzhan zhig sngon gyi 'phrang bar rdzong ngam rje rang la gnas te yus pa gtso bo byas pas shel sku lding dpon yus 'brog gnyis zer ba byung / phyi nang nye phyogs dang dpal 'byor sogs kyi rkyen pas lding 'gan gtso bo shes sku 'brog pas len gyi yod pa red/ 'phrang bar rba ta tshang zer ba — yas bud phyin pa'i khral zhing lding dpon lus pa tshang nas blangs te de'i thob khral yang 'jal gyi yod pas de tshun lding dpon yus pa la tha ra tshang zer mkhan yang yod/de rjes shel lding 'brog pa'i lding dpon stag la dbang rgyal spun mched la bu med stabs lha sa nas gzhung zhabs sku drag gnam sras gling si 'i mi rgyud tshe brtan dngos grub pha bu lding dpon 'brog pa'i gzhis 'dzin byas te spom pa dang rdzong 'og gzhis gnyer dang sgur bzhi'i lding dpon gcig rtso sa byas pa red/'di'i mi rabs gsum pa sgur lding tshe dbang rgyal mtshan da lta nag chu sa gnas srid gros kyi u yon yin lding dpon 'brog par shel sku'i gdung rgyud chad nas gnam gling du tshe dngos pas lding dpon byas pa nas sde ming dang lding ming sgur bzhi dang sgur lding zer ba las shel sku lding dpon zer mkhan med pa ltar gyur yod pa red/ 'on kyang lding dpon yul pa sngar bzhin shel sku'i gdung 'dzin ma chad pa yod cing phyogs gcig nas tha ra tshang gi khral 'jal zhing khral pa'i rnam pa yod la phyogs gzhan zhig nas ma rdzong 175 —— ———

ngam rje khri btsan bzung nas lding dpon yus pa'i ming tsam 'dzin mus dmangs nas brtsi thang 'jog sgo nges can zhig yod pa yin sgur bzhi tsho bar 'go mi las byed ni gtso bo lding dpon 'brog pa dang de nas lding dpon yus pa tshang blon po klu mkhar ke ru tshang dang /'phrang bar bar ma tshang / rgan shog brgyad kyi rgan po brgyad/ klu mkhar bcu dpon dpon ru tshang bcas dang da dung mi drag bon ri tshang dang / mgar ra tshang sogs 'ga' zhig yod/(2) khrularigs sgrubazugasogasakyi skor/—rgya ston lding dgu de bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung sde rnying khungs yin zer nas khral rigs sgrub rgyug dmar ba'i tshad la 'dzin gyi yod pa red/ dbyar la dbyar mar zer ba sa dang phyugs rigs la rtsis nas mar khral bsdu ba dang dgun la gte zer ba sa zhing la rtsis pa'i khral 'bab mar dang sha dang ko ba sogs bsdu gi yod 4 red/shel lding mnga' khongs sngon shog dgu yod kyang ra rog grong la lu khral 'jal mkhan dud gcig ma gtogs med de'i nang dmar thung sgur bzhi'i dbyar mar ga mar gyi khral de sa gnas ya nga mdo la bsdu ba dang chabs cig rgyas shod smad ya grong ya nga ya khog gzhi 'dos la phyin gyi nyin mar nyin 'gyur bsdu ba yin/ don mar ni 'bri grus ma re nas mar nyag gcig yar ma gnyis re nas mar nyag gcig yar nyag la rgya gang phyur ba 'os 'tshams re bcas bsdu dgos/ stod rtswa yag sgur gsum ste rtswa yag dang dngul kho/ sha 176

dil bcas grong ba gsum der 'bras zlo gling gra tshang la 'chi med she mar gyi mar khral 'jal dgos pa'i ga mar de ban dkar sa gnas su rgya rdzong la 'jal sprod dgos pa ma zad/ ban dkar bla brang la'ang 'chi med she mar 'jal dgos/ klu mkhar bcu shog gi ga mar de bcu dpon gyis bsdus te rdzong la sdeb 'bul byed na byung 'dzin dam 'byar ma len srol yod/ 'di skabs ban dkar bla brang la dud res mar rgya do re mar phud zer ba 'bul sprod pa yin ('chi med blangs med mkhan gyis 'bul mi dgos ) ga mar de rtswa yag sgur gsum la thob che ba yod dud che ba res mar rgya 7༷skor 'jal dgos/dgun dus gte mar zhes pa'i khral de sa gnas zlas mda' la bsdu ba gte mar de smad dmar thung sgur bzhi la thob mang ba yin pa'i dud gcig gis mar rgya 4༷yas mas 'jal dgos/ lding 'og na gte sha zer ba lug sha mgo 'byar dang / tshag sha zer ba nor sha bcas mang tsam 'jal sprod dgos/ de min ko tshar zer ba'i 'bri ko nis 'byar dang / thel chen zer ba'i g.yag ko bcas bcu phrag kha shas dang gzhan yang bsdus pa'i khral mar gyi mar ltang skogs pags kyi ko ba sogs mang tsam dgos kyi yod pa dang ri dwags rgyag mkhan gyis spu khral yang sprod dgos pa red/ sgur khongs zlas mda' ru rgya ston rdzong gi gzhis ka son khal 5༷skor 'gro mal yod pa de ga'i gzhis gnyer nas dmar thung sgur bzhi'i skya lo sngo khrims la do dam dang ya nga mdo'i rtswa rwa la do dam byed kyi yod pa dang sgur bzhi bas der 'bru skyung 'debs sdud sogs kyi las khral rgyug dgos/ ar po nyin gcig chad na ar chad 'bru bre gang re 177

'jal dgos pas gzhis gnyer nas ar chad mang tsam yong ched las ka dam 'dzin mi byed par ar po nyin grangs mang po la mi gshig pa red/ des zhing pa'i zhor las la'ang gnod 'tshe 'gro yi yod pa yin/ dper na shod srol du ‘ zlas mda'i ar po sod thub pa sis mda'i sis bo (gle bo ) zla thub pa/ spang ya ma'i bya gang (bya gag ) gsod thub pa bcas 'dra yong gi ma red zer ba kha dper 'jags yod/ lo ltar ston rgyab du gzhis gnyer dang zla ded bcas sgur kho gso sor ar chad bsdu ba 'gro skabs mdun me sel ba'i khral dgos pa 'bru la phabs nas ar chad dang mnyam du bsdu ba red/de min ban dkar bla brang la 'bras spungs blo gsal gling gi gte zer ba dang ban dkar dgon pa'i mchod khag spyi chung ba'i gte zer ba gzhan yang mi shi bsngo rten zer ba deb 'khod khral la 'gyur ba lo ltar bsdu ba yin/ da dung rang yul dgon pa'i mchod khag gte bcas dgos pa ma tshad/ dpal 'bar rdzong khongs lcags ra dgon pa la'ang sa zhing gi gte 'ga' zhig dgos pa yin/ sngar ma'i gtam dpe ru/ skal pa bzang po'i sten mo de dus tshod ngan pa'i gte la 'gyur zer ba ltar bla dgon la 'bul ba bsngo rten bzhag pa deb la bkod nas rjes sor khral la 'gyur ba red 'dugade bzhin sgur bzhi phyin rgya ston rgyud du rgya rdzong dang bde steng bla brang gnyis kyis rta 'ded nas snol za ru 'jug pa'am snol rin len pa bcas kyang byed pa red (zhing bar gyi rtswa ) rdzong dpon brje len mtshams lding dpon dang dgon khag gis bka' rten gyi rten zer ba khal che khal re rdzong dpon la sprod dgos pa red/178

shel lding khongs rta zam sa tshugs 'dzin sa ya nga mdo yin pa der grong shog brgyad nas rta zam srung dgos pa dang yar skyod ban dkar bar dang mar 'ongs 'brong thang ngam lha khang thang bar skyel dgos/ de min shog res zer ba btang thung yig skyel sogs kyi bya ba sgrub mkhan sdod res kyang dgos pa yin/ dmag sgar ram che btsan khag 'bab skabs gtan 'khel grangs tshad ltar phon che ba yin na 'brong sgur lding khag gnyis rub kyis yar 'gro 'brong thang nas gsa' mda' bon dgon bar skyel dgos pa yin/ skabs der ban dkar ni sen tsha lhan du yin pa dang nag bur gnyis lhan du yin pa bcas ru bzhi zer srol yod/ mdo smad sa dbang sogs phyin 'gro skabs rta mang po dgos par ban dkar nas rta rnams dpal 'bar bar rdzong skyel yin pa dang khal dos ni lding skyel byed pa yin/ de min khams rdzong gsum gyi dbus 'bul ni shel lding gis zlas mda' nas ban dkar bar skyel dgos pa yin/ rgya ston rdzong gi dbus 'bul ni mar rkyang de 'brong sgur gnyis kyis 'brong thang nas ban dkar bar skyel ba dang ban dkar ba dang sgur khongs rtswa yag sgur gsum klu mkhar bcas kyis ban dkar nas u brag lung mdo bar skyel dgos pa yin la mar phud pa'i dos yan rnams 'ul thung rgyud kyi skyel dgos pa bcas red/ me 'brug 'dra drug gan rgya'i bgos don zer ba rta 12dos yan dang / rta dos 2༷0phyin 'brong thang pas gsa' mda' bon dgon bar skyel dgos pa dang /ban sgur gnyis kyis gsa' mda' nas lha ri mgo bar skyel dgos pa zhig chags yod pa/ de skabs nag bur sems gsum nag tsho spyi 'dre las rang sa nas skyel mi dgos pa byung yod 'dug rgya ston 179

rdzong gi dbyar mar lha sar skyel skabs ban dkar nas lha sa bar lding dgus lding khag res mi re lag do btang dgos pa red/lho bde stong dgon gyi khang dmar lha khang zer ba de dang chu mdo'i mchod rten bcas gsar bzo 'am nyams gso skabs sgur bzhi tsho pas der ar po rgyug dgos kyi yod pa dang / sgar kho stod kyi rtswa yag sgur gsum dang klu mkhar bcas kyis bab dekar du sa tshugs sgrig khang rgya khang zhes pa dang rgyas chu'i zam sa ban dkar rgya zam zer ba bzo skabs su'ang ar po rgyug dgos pa red/shel sku lding dpon la lding zhabs grong shog res ar po mi re dbyar smad yung sdom 'bal skabs nas bzung dgun stod 'bru brdung ma tshar bar btang dgos/ gal te mi ma phyin na ar chad 'bru 'bo drug re sprod dgos/ lding dpon dang rgan po bcas lding 'du 'gro ba'am sde don phan tshun skyod skabs lding rgyag zer ba mar dang dngul bsdu dgos pa phal cher lo rer thengs gnyis nas gsum tsam bsdu yi yod pa der 'don rgya log po 'am 'don rgya gang re gang red cig bsdud kyi yod pas log po bsdus na mar rgya 56dang gang re bsdus na mar rgya 28red/ de bzhin dngul 'don rer dngul srang 1༷—15bar tsam yin/yang sngar lha sa'i grwa pas bal po'i tshong pa bcom 'phrol byas pa zer ba'i rkyen las bal por dngul khyon chen sprod dgos pa de'i dmigs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khral chen 'phar ma bkal ba sogs la brten mi sel nyams thag srab nas bug pa dang 'phra nas chad pa'i dpe bzhin 'gyur nas sgur khongs ya nga dang ra rog klu mkhar bcas nas khral dud mang po zhig yas 'thor song ba dang tsho 180

shog gzhan khongs su gyal ba kong po sogs la lho mjal gnas mjal gyi mi tshe skyal nas pha yal la log med pa bcas kyi gnas tshal byung riring ri su yod/skabs de dus nas dmar thung khral nag dgu rtsegs yin tshul mi ser nyams chung tshos rtag tu gleng ba yin/gong gsal mi ser 'thor 'khyams song ba nas ra ron grong nas phyin pa'i kong por 'khyams sdod mkhan gyi bud med gcig gis kong por gnas mjal yong mkhan gyi pha yul ba zhig la ‘ 'om dzi thang gi 'bod rgyang de sdad e gda' chu ran phu yi rlung dmar de sdad e gda' 7ze dris yod pa red/ de ni rtag par 'om dzi grong nas khral khyer shog mi 'du 'dzams shog ces bos bos nyid kyi bsun snang blor 'jags pas rkyen gyis yin 'dug/sheg /sdi// / // /byenge/ /sdi// /rdo// ////la nga mnga' ngas khral gas rkang 'a lag 'a na rtsis gzhi bzung sa 'don zer ba dang de'ang zas 'don dang mgo 'don gnyis yod/ zas 'don de rgyu dngos kyi khral rigs geshag sa yin pa dang / mgo 'don ni rkang 'gro'i khral rigs gshag gzhi yin/ sngar shel sku lding zhabs la 'don 29yod pa yin 'dug rung khral khrims ma 'khyogs par mi ser yas 'thon du ma zhig byung rjes rjes sor zhib gzhung skabs 'don 27bar nyung du phyin yod pa red/ zhib par sgur shog so sor 'don grangs gtan 'khel yod pa dang de la gzhigs nas rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs rnams 'don thog nas zhib phra gshags pa bcas red/rgya ston rdzong 'og dmag khral bsdud skabs shel lding khongs dmag grangs nges can re skabs skabs su btang dgos pa 'di dus 181

rdo steng dgon gtsos 'di ga'i khongs kyi dgon pa dang shel sku lding dpon bcas nas dmag mi gcig re'i dmag khral sgrub dgos kyi yod pa red/(2) phyi gyod dang nang gyod che rigs skon/(1) dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs gnyis pa'i nang skor la shel lding mnga' khongs zlas lung par 'brong thang tsho pa'i khyim dud 'ga' zhig babs nas sa rtsod byung bar sgur bzhi pas rgya rdzong la zhus nas sgur 'brong lding khag gnyis kyi sa gyod de rgya ston rdzong gis 'dom thabs byas kyang ma 'grig pas shel lding blon po bar ma tshe lha khyung po steng chen du phyin nas hor spyi grags rnam la bde sdug zhus kyang bdag sprod de tsam ma byung mus grags rnams grongs pa dang thugade nas lha sar kha mchu gzhung gtug byas pa red/ gyod gtug 'gro mkhan shel lding phyogs nas lding dpon stag lha dbang rgyal dang skal bzang bstan rgyas mchod gnyis dang mi drag bon ri rta mgrin lha rgyal dang / mgar ra 'od gsal bcas yin pa dang / 'brong thang phyogs nas lding dpon nor bu dbang 'dus dang / wa ru bsam 'byor ldan/ bsag ra nag lo bcas yin pas lha sar yun ring kha mchu rtsod nas sdad mthar zlas lung pa de sgur bzhi'i sa khongs yin pa sngar mus gtsang chod byung yod rung / gyod yun ring po'i ring lding dpon stag lha dbang rgyal grongs pa dang / gyod gron dngul dngos phon chen btang dgos byung ba red/( 2) shel sku lding zhabs dang hor tsho'i khul gyi khri rdo shog 182

bar drel bee yag gi sa rtswa'i skor sngar gleng rtsod 'ga' zhig byung rabs yod pa dang bar skabs nang mol rang bzhin gyi thog nas 'grig chags byung yod pa yin skabs der khri rdo'i 'gan khur sba rgan nya rgyas zer ba des sgur bzhi'i mi drag rnams dang kha rtsal 'gran nas gtan tshig rdon pa'i gtam su bzang blta dus bon ri rta mgrin lha rgyal gyi gtam la mgu thag chod nas lkog rgyu khos 4da spag za na rgas po ko zhar des za sa gda' zhes bshad skad 'dug( 2) nang gyod/ skyes nang pa (phyis nag rog tsho khongs su gtogs pa'i shel sku blam zhig )dang sgur bzhi lding dpon gnyis 'om dzi thang 'go'i zhing thang nag ma zer ba spang gsar smor ba'i don rkyen gyi kha mchu byung yod pa red/(4) skyes nang sa shes rab phun tshogs (skyes blam tshang nas zur du gyes pa zhig yin )kyis bka' shog gi dam rdzus bzos pa'i don rkyen thon par rgya ston rdzong gis zhib dpyad rgyud nag chur byang spyi'i sar rdzong rda byas pa dang byang spyis byed po smos ci sgur lding tshe dngos dang nag dpon don chos dngul kho dgon pa dang bla brang gi mi sna sogs kyang 'gug 'bod kyis khrun gcod bka' bcad byung bar shes rab phun tshogs ja yul rdzong la rgyang 'bud btang ba dang de tshang gtsos thag zhor breng drud kyi khyim dud lnga pa'i kha dbang ོgzhung bzhes btang ba sogs byas pa dang / shes phun gyi spun skyes blam tshe dbang dpal 'bar nag med rung btson khang du bcug nas tsha 'dri'i 'og khrims 'das song ba dang / gyod don des rkyen shes lding mnga' khongs kyi mi ser nas dka' gron chen po 'khur dgos byung ba bcas red//83

(4) chos lugs dgon sde'i skon/shel lding tsho khongs su chos lugs grub mtha' ban bon gnyis ka yod pa'i nang bon lugs cung mang ba yin dgon pa ni dmar thung sgur bzhi'i khongs sdo steng dgon (bon ) dang ya nga bya mda'i btsun dgon (ban dge lugs ) gnyis yod pa dang rtsa yag sgur gsum dang klu mkhar bcu shog gi nang du dngul kho dgon dang klu mkhar dgon (bon )gnyis chags yod/ gong gsal bon dgon gsum po de snga tsam nas chags pa zhig yin pa dang dang thog phyag 'debs mdzad po g.yung drung bon gyi grub mtha'i khrod nas phyi dar gyi skyes bu dam pa mtshan yongs grags can 'ga' zhig gis btabs skyongs gnang ba zhig yin 'dug rung bar skabs yul dus bde gzar dang skyong pa po'i 'phrin las sogs la brten chags dar nyams gsum gyi lo rgyus byung yod pa yin/(zhib pa dgon pa'i lo rgyus las gsal )rdo rting dgon sngar gyi dus skabs gang 'tshams shig la rdo rting sman ri btam zhes pa'i snyan pa yod pa dang dgon bdag dbu bla shel sku dang bru tshang gnyis gas gnang gi yod skabs dar rgyas che ba'i skabs yin par snang / be yag blam dang nang gyod byung nas shel bla yag mda' khar spos pa nas bzung cung zad nyams pa'i gnas tshul byung yod/ phyis kyang mu mthud shel sku bla khag gis skyong gnang ba yin klu mkhar dgon zhu btsun g.yung drung khrid 'od nas btabs rjes sog g.yung drung gling gi dgon lag lha bu zhu khyung gnyis 184—

kyis skyong gi yod tshod la de'i rjes mthud khyung nag spu la blam nas mu mthud kha 'dzin gnang ba zhig yin 'dug dngul kho dgon ni dang po kyu ra rnal 'byor gyis btabs rjes yun ring tsam sa gnas 'di ga'i rus rgyud blam ko bo nas skyong gi yod tshod 'dra zhing rjes sor khyung po ri khrod me ston rnam gnyis kyi slob ma stag zhig rin chen dbang ldan gyis skyar spos nyams gsongs nang zhing ri khrod slob rgyud nas 'dzin pa'i sta dgon lha bu gnang yod 'dug gong gsal gyi bon dgon gsum phyis tshor khyim gyi dgon pa gra ba rnams dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa srung mkhan yin/ ya nga byam mda'i btsun ma'i dgon pa ni sngar dang po 'debs mkhan mkha' 'gro bsod nam dpal 'drel yum sras dang btabs rjes dus yun gang 'tshams ring snga 'gyur rnying ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa yin 'dug rung de nas rnying dge zung 'brel dang de nas yang ri bo dge lugs pa'i grub mthar gyur ba dang kha 'dzin yang ban dkar bla dgon nas gnang srol byung 'duga'adir gnas chen ya nga byam mda' zer gnas dgos zung du sbrel ba'i snyarna pa yod pa dang byi ba lo'i sa zla'i gnam gang gi dus chen lo skor can la slebs skabs nye mtshungs kyi rdzong yul khag nas kyang gnas mjal 'gro mkhan ma nyung tsam yod pa bcas yin dgon —'di'i blam yang sngar rnying ma'i skabs 'di ga'i rus rgyud blam min nam snyams pa'i bon ru dang khra bcas kyi nang nas thon pa'i rab byung sa gang red kyis blam gnang gi yod 'dra/ kha rgyun du byam mda'i blam khra bon gnyis zer srol yod/rgya ston rdzong sar lha sde dgon khag rnams tshogs 'dur skyod skabs gong gsal ser khyim gyi bon dgon gsum po der mthong chung 185

dang ngan smras byed mkhan yod cing / skabs der chos lugs grub mtha' la'ang dbang sgyur byed mkhan dang bya yul lta bu'i gnas babs yod pa las grub mtha' 'dra mnyam zer ba bsam yul las 'das pa yin stabs 7rgyas cham sku cham dang sprang cham yam nad kyi dpe ltar yong gi yod pa ni rgyun ldan zhig red/(5) rgyas shod yul gyi ri chu yul ljongs sogs lam tsam bcas/rgyas shod ni rgyas chu zhes pa'i chu bo nub nas shar du rgyug ste rgya mo rngul chu la thug gi bar gyi yul der rgyas shod ces zer/ dper na nag chu'i rgyud du nag shod dang sog chu'i rgyud du sog shog zer ba ltar yin/ yul 'di'i stod la nag shod tsho dgu'i nag bur sen gsum dang smad la rgya ston lding dgu'i ban sgur 'brom gsum bcas khyon tsho shog drug chags yod/stod la 'brog shas che zhing smad la yul shas che rung spyir btang sa ma 'brog la rtsis kyang rung ba zhig yin/ yul 'brog dbar gso skor skabs nyin lam kha shas 'gro dgos/ thon skyed ni zhing 'brog yin cing zhor las thon khungs phun gsum 'tshogs po yod/ dper na 'bu rdza be smug brko 'thu dang rngon rgyag gla rtsi dang sha ra lta bu/ de min yul thon gyi lag shes bzo las/ yul gyi snam bu srab 'thag a 'dong gi mig nang 'gro ba zer ba'i ming yod spus ldan 'thag thon yod la spyod chas shing chas 'dra min bzo thon yod la/ rdza chas dang / thon skyed dang 'tsho bar mkho ba'i mgar thon lcags chas sna tshogs bcas yod pa yin/186

yul rgyas shod lung pa 'di nangs kyi dus su spu rgyal btsan po srong btsan gyi skabs sum pa'i ru yi 4lte ba rgyas shod stag pa tshal la bzhag 7ces pas bod yul ru chen lnga yi ya byas zhig yin pa dang /yon rgyal rabs skabs bod chos kha gsum gyi nang mdo stod mi yi chol kha'i khongs su gtogs yang mdo khams sgang drug ces dbye skabs rngul rdza zas mo sgang gi char gtogs yin par grags/ de bzhin mdo stod shog chen bco brgyad dam shod chen brgyad zer ba'i nang nag sog rgyas gsum 'di shod chen bco brgyad kyi gos kyi gong ba lta bu yin zer srol mchis/ lo rgyus kha shas nas gsal ba'i ‘ khams kyi zor ba yar khug 7zer ba de rgyas shod kyi yor khug grong rgyud la ngos 'dzin byed srol yod pa ma zad sngar sa der yol sgang sde pa zhes pa btsan phyug 'dzom pa zhig mi rabs du mar chags gnas byung tshul sngar gtam gleng rgyu yod/ shog 'ga' shas kyi sde dud rug sdod byed pa'i 'om dzi grong rgyud de rgyas shod kyi 'bru g.yang len sa yin zer srol yod/ yang padma lha yi thang yig las 4byang shar sbas yul lung gsum ljongs 7zer nag sog rgyas gsum ni lung gi zin pa'i yul yin par bstan yod/rgyas cha'i stod la cha phug g.yas g.yon dbas gsam yod — 7ri pa riring ri pa ri mi dbus chis kyi rgyud bu dzum tsho ba chags/ der sa 'dzin ngo mtshar can gsa' phu mgon lha dkar po'i 'am lho yi 'dzam bu sgu ri gtsos gsa' yi nor bu bcu gsum dang chis kyi rin chen bcu gsum zer ba yod/ g.yas phyogs bkra shis lung gi rgyud du nag rog tsho ba chags yod cing der sa 'dzin mdzes brjid ldan pa ni rgod phu bkra shis dar rgyas gtsos rgod kyi dar rgyas bcu gsum zer ba yod/187

g.yon phyogs ya gong lung pa'i rgyud la sen che tsho ba chags yod cing der sa 'dzin rngam brjid can jo bo g.yur drung dgra 'dus gtsos/ya gong drag rtsal bcu gsum zer ba yod/ rgyas chu'i klung gzhung dkyil smad rnams su ban sgur 'brom gsum gyi tsho shog chags yod cing der sa 'dzin lhun chags can ni zla khyims jo bo mo nam dang rtswa yag bya khyung mo nam gtsos mo nam smug mo mchod brgyad zer ba yod/ gong gsal gyi sa 'dzin rnams ni rdza gangs g.ya' brag gi lhun po dgung la reg pa'am bzo dbyeb khyad mtshar can ljon shing sna tshogs pas mdzes brgyan spras 'dra yod pa dang khyad par du gsa' phu dang rgod phu sogs la ri mtsho zung sbrel ya mtshon che ba'i ri dbyes dang mtsho ma dngas yod cing sgrub rigs kong mas byin kyis brlabs pa'i gter gnas la brtsi zhing mjal skor bya mkhan yang yod/ sa 'dir phyin pa tsam gyis nyams dga' snang dang ltas pa tsam gyis spro sangs snang gi tshor gtang shugs su skye ba zhig yod pas/ deng yul skor spro 'khyam bya gan byas na'ang lo ba zhig yod pa bcas yin/rgya gshod yul du ri skyes rtsi shing rtsa che'i rigs dang rtsa che'i srog chags dkon rigs kyang ma byung tsam yod rgyal shod stag pa tshal zhes ming don mtshungs pa'i shing stag pa'i rigs kyis khe g.yod cing sngar snga mor shog bu de tshang mi thon pa'i skabs shing 'di ga'i shun pa la chos yig 'bri nas stabs bde'i kha 'don byed kyi yod pa yig 'thor de gras phyis su'ang 'thong rgyu yod/gzhan yang rgyal shod yul du chis mda' klu di'i rdzong / de'i spus rdzong / g.yang shod mkhar mdung ma/ mkhar skya thang mkhar 'ba' krus mkhar ro bcas mkhar rdzong rnying pa'i rtsegs gyang shul 188

'ga' zhig yod pa de dag dus skabs gang gi skabs kyi mkhar yin min shod rgyur gang yang mi 'dug rung tshod dpag byas na dus tshod snga tsam dus dbang sgyur pa'i btsan mkhar yin par snyams lo rabs bdun cu pa'i nang sen tsha chus kyi khang pa gsar skrun skabs sa 'og nang sngar gyi dgon shul khang no thon pa'i nang thog g.yam jo mo zhes pa'i rdza g.yam bshu can mang po 'dug pa de dag lo brgya phrag gsum bzhi'i gong skabs kyi khang pa min nam snyams pas 'di dus rgyas shod yul gyi khang pa'i dbye kyang rgya nag nang sa'i bzo lta'am gtsang zha lu dgon pa'i khang dbye dra ba yod tshod 'dug yang sen tsha chu ma 'ju'i mar nang rgyud lam bzo 'am zhing bzo byed skabs sngon gyi dur sa yang thon yod pas / nang sa'i dpon dmag gam sog po'i dpung sde dmag mi grong pa'i dur sa yin tshod dam yang na de dus yul srol la phung pos sbas byed kyi yod pa gang yin bcas zhor du zhus pa sogs skabs 'dir rgyal gshod dam rgya ston khongs ban sgur shog gnyis kyi lo rgyus rags rims tsam 'di 'di mtshams nas rdzogs khul byas pa lags/ lcam mda' dang rngul rgyud lcags ri shog gnyis kyi lo rgyus da lam 'tshol 'dri'i skabs khungs 'khel gyi sa bon ma 'byor bas rjes sor zhi nang 'tshol 'bri bya rgyu las da res 'di nang bsdu thub ma song bas gzigs pa pos dgongs 'gal med pa zhu/ gong gsal lo rgyus 'di ga'i rgyu cha mtshon bsdud nang dpal ::rdo /khro/ ༷/1 /khye/ /ce/ rtse:/ /rdo/ /bye/ (15'babasdo nga da sa kru'u sku ga na zhang brgya na dbang mchog nas rtsa che'i rgyu cha gsung gnang byung bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu bcas yin 1992lo zla 9par/ 189
